About us
HighLevel is an AI-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate and scale. Today, HighLevel supports SMBs across 150+ countries, fueling community-driven growth rooted in real customer outcomes.
To date, businesses operating on HighLevel have generated over $7 billion in ecosystem value, demonstrating the impact of shared infrastructure at scale. By centralizing conversations, automation and intelligence into one system, we help businesses move faster, reduce complexity and execute efficiently.
Behind the platform, HighLevel powers more than 4 billion API hits and 2.5 billion message events daily. With 250 terabytes of distributed data, 250+ microservices and over 1 million domain names supported, our architecture is built for performance, resilience and long-term scalability.

Our people
With over 2,000 team members across 10+ countries, HighLevel operates as a global, remote-first organization built for speed and ownership. We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home.

Our impact
Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1.5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact. We’re proud to be a part of that.
Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts

Who You Are: A relationship-driven, results-oriented sales professional who thrives on creating new business opportunities and building meaningful connections with prospective partners.
Energized by environments where identifying opportunities, developing relationships, and pursuing new business are part of the daily rhythm. Equally comfortable with proactive outreach, networking, referrals, and in-person industry events as tools for building a strong pipeline.
Thoughtful in approach, taking the time to understand a prospect's goals before recommending the right opportunity. Self-motivated, persistently professional, and adaptable, with the ability to independently research companies, engage decision-makers, and manage follow-up without losing the human side of the conversation..

lists.content:
Business Development & Prospecting

  • Identify and develop new business opportunities with marketplace companies and prospective sponsors and exhibitors, with accountability for pipeline and participation growth.

  • Conduct targeted outreach to new prospects, existing leads, and companies within specific geographic markets

  • Research prospective companies and identify relevant decision-makers

  • Build and maintain a strong pipeline of qualified opportunities

  • Develop thoughtful, personalized outreach and follow-up strategies

    • Relationship Development & Networking

  • Build strong relationships with prospective sponsors, exhibitors, and industry contacts

  • Attend approximately 1 to 2 external industry events per month to network, prospect, and develop new business

  • Represent the company and its events professionally at external and customer-facing opportunities

  • Leverage networking, referrals, and existing relationships to create new business opportunities

    • Sales & Opportunity Development

  • Understand prospect goals and recommend sponsorship and exhibitor opportunities that align with their objectives

  • Communicate the value of event participation, including access to a highly targeted audience, decision-makers, industry credibility, and strong attendee engagement

  • Independently manage assigned sponsor and exhibitor opportunities, engaging the Senior Manager for complex or strategic opportunities.

  • Develop increasing independence to own  strategic opportunities and the full sales cycle as the pipeline grows

    • Pipeline & Market Development

  • Maintain accurate prospect and opportunity information in the CRM

  • Track outreach, meetings, qualified opportunities, and pipeline activity and adjust outreach and sponsorship strategies to improve performance.

  • Work toward defined business development and pipeline goals

  • Identify opportunities to expand sponsorship and exhibitor participation within new geographic markets and target segments

  • Share insights from prospect conversations and external events to support new business identification

    • Collaboration

  • Partner closely with the Senior Manager, Field Event Sales to align business development activity with overall sales priorities

  • Collaborate with internal teams to support prospects throughout the sales process

  • Develop increasing independence and ownership as knowledge of the business, event portfolio, and sales process grows

• Highly proactive approach to business development and prospecting

  • Strong relationship-building skills with the ability to establish trust across a wide range of stakeholders

  • Comfortable networking and building connections in both formal and informal settings

  • Ability to understand prospect needs and match them with the right opportunity

  • Thoughtful persistence and strong follow-through without being overly transactional

  • Entrepreneurial and curious mindset with the ability to identify and pursue opportunities independently

  • Strong organizational and time management skills

  • Clear and compelling written and verbal communication

  • Results-oriented with a focus on building meaningful pipeline and long-term partnerships

  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment while collaborating effectively with the broader team

  • Familiarity with Google Workspace, CRM and email tools, Slack, and AI-powered productivity and research too


    • Experience/Education/Certifications Required:

  • 3 to 5 years of experience in business development, sales, partnerships, account development, or a related field

  • Bachelor's degree preferred or equivalent practical experience

  • Experience in event sales, sponsorships, exhibitor sales, or the events industry preferred

  • Proven ability to manage a sales pipeline and develop new business opportunities

  • Experience engaging a range of decision-makers including company owners, partnership leaders, and business development stakeholders

  • Experience in a remote or distributed work environment is a plus

  • Willingness to travel to internal events and approximately 1 to 2 external industry events per month

lists.content:
Key Responsibilities

  • Coverage: Own the rate at which new subscribers engage with Customer Success at all. Getting customers into the motion is demand generation against an installed base, not a delivery-capacity problem.

  • Trial-to-Implementation Handoff: Own the conversion of customers who meet our Trial Experience team into customers who go on to work with Implementation — a joint metric with the Trial Experience organization, and one of the largest single opportunities in the customer lifecycle.

  • Customer Activation: Build and lead a team running prioritized, stage-based outreach on customers who have stalled — ranked by customer value rather than worked first-come.

  • Journey & Messaging Design: Own the end-to-end first-90-days journey, touch sequencing, and channel mix across human, in-product and automated touchpoints, along with the messaging that carries it.

  • Lifecycle Expansion: Own expansion revenue for the customer cohorts that sit outside account management coverage, working to a clearly defined cohort boundary.

  • Deflection Quality: Own both the rate at which our AI assistants resolve customer needs without a human and whether those customers went on to activate and how they rated the experience. The second half is the part most organizations never measure.

  • Activation Scorecard: Build the per-customer stage scorecard — a small number of monitored stages per product, green or red per customer, anchored to the company's funnel definitions rather than invented inside Customer Success.

  • Enablement: Own advisor and customer success manager ramp, and a coaching curriculum built from recordings of our actual top performers rather than from theory.

  • Experimentation Discipline: Instrument every play with a hold-out group and a kill date, and shut down the ones that do not beat their control.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Product Growth, Marketing, Revenue Growth, Support and Revenue Operations on lifecycle channels, cohort boundaries, funnel definitions and platform fixes.

  • Other duties may be assigned and/or modified as business needs change.

    • What Success Looks Like

    First 30 days. The activation team has names in seats. The highest-risk customer cohort — small, currently reached only by accident — is a standing, queryable list surfaced to the people who can act on it. You have a defensible point of view on why engagement has been declining and why so few trial-stage customers reach implementation, built jointly with the Trial Experience team.

    Days 31–90. Two outbound plays are live with hold-out groups, so lift is measured rather than asserted. The first-90-days journey is mapped end to end with the messaging gaps named. Post-deflection activation and satisfaction are instrumented and reported for the first time.

    Days 91–180. Engagement and the trial-to-implementation handoff are both visibly turning. Lifecycle expansion is producing measurable revenue in its cohorts. Every play that did not beat its hold-out has been honestly killed.


    What You'll Bring

  • 10+ years in growth, lifecycle, customer marketing, activation or post-sales revenue roles, including 4+ years leading a team.

  • You have built a lifecycle or growth motion against an installed base from nothing and carried a number for it — activation, adoption-driven revenue, or cohort expansion. Acquisition and top-of-funnel demand generation is a different job.

  • Experience with product-led or usage-based businesses where revenue only exists once consumption happens. Consumption-based adoption should already be an obvious concept to you.

  • You are analytically self-sufficient: you write the query, define the cohort and design the hold-out yourself rather than waiting on an analyst to tell you whether a play worked.

  • You have designed a customer journey as a system — sequencing, channel mix, messaging — not just executed campaigns inside someone else's.

  • Experience carrying a metric jointly with a peer organization you do not control, and making that partnership work.

  • You can tell the difference between a problem your team can solve and a platform defect that needs a product fix, and you escalate the second with evidence instead of staffing around it.

  • Experience owning a customer experience or experience-quality function, or a compelling case for why you should.

  • Comfortable being measured on numbers that are currently unowned, unbaselined or near zero.

  • Experience serving SMB and agency customers at volume, rather than enterprise account-based motions.

  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, remote-first global environment, managing multiple stakeholders.

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in a SaaS environment.

  • Proficiency with standard business tools (Google Suite, Zoom, Slack), marketing automation and CRM platforms; familiarity with HighLevel is a plus.

Why this role exists : 

We are looking for a Director, Product Strategy & Operations – Product Adoption to drive how customers discover, adopt, engage with, and derive value from HighLevel’s products and capabilities.

This role will sit at the intersection of Product Strategy, Product Management, Growth, Customer Success, Data, and Operations. The primary mandate is to identify adoption gaps across the customer journey, translate data and customer insights into clear strategic priorities, and partner with product teams to improve activation, feature adoption, engagement, retention, and expansion.

This is not a traditional program management or product operations role. We are looking for someone who can combine strategic thinking, strong analytical depth, customer understanding, and execution to influence product roadmaps and materially improve adoption across the platform

Product Adoption Strategy

  • Define and drive HighLevel’s product adoption strategy across key products, features, and customer segments.
  • Identify the biggest barriers preventing customers from discovering, activating, and repeatedly using high-value capabilities.
  • Develop frameworks to measure adoption across the customer lifecycle—from onboarding and activation through sustained engagement and expansion.
  • Prioritize adoption opportunities based on customer impact, business value, and strategic importance.

    • Adoption & Growth Analytics

    • Establish clear adoption metrics and success criteria for strategic product initiatives.
    • Analyze customer journeys, funnels, cohorts, feature usage, and behavioral patterns to identify opportunities and friction points.
    • Partner with Data and Product teams to understand time-to-value, activation, feature penetration, engagement, retention, and churn.
    • Segment adoption by customer type, cohort, geography, product, and use case to uncover actionable insights.
    • Build executive-level visibility into product adoption performance and emerging risks.

      • Product Strategy & Roadmap Influence

      • Translate adoption insights into actionable product recommendations.
      • Partner with Product leaders to influence roadmaps based on customer behavior, adoption gaps, and business priorities.
      • Identify opportunities where onboarding, UX, education, packaging, cross-product journeys, or product capabilities need to change to improve adoption.
      • Develop business cases for high-impact adoption initiatives and help teams prioritize investments.

        • Cross-Functional Execution

        • Partner closely with Product, Design, Engineering, Data, Marketing, Customer Success, Support, and Revenue teams.
        • Drive cross-functional initiatives aimed at increasing adoption of strategic product capabilities.
        • Create clear ownership, operating rhythms, metrics, and accountability for adoption initiatives.
        • Ensure product launches go beyond shipping by defining how new capabilities will achieve meaningful customer adoption.

          • Customer & Market Insights

          • Develop a deep understanding of customer needs, workflows, pain points, and reasons for non-adoption.
          • Combine quantitative product data with qualitative customer insights to identify root causes.
          • Partner with customer-facing teams to establish systematic feedback loops into Product.
          • Benchmark adoption and customer experience against relevant SaaS and technology platforms.

Success in this role will be measured by the ability to:

  • Increase activation and adoption of strategic product capabilities.
  • Improve time-to-value for new and existing customers.
  • Increase feature penetration and depth of product usage.
  • Improve engagement and repeat usage of high-value workflows.
  • Reduce adoption-related friction and early customer drop-off.
  • Establish measurable relationships between product adoption and retention, expansion, and customer value.
  • Build a scalable operating model for measuring and improving adoption across HighLevel.

• 12+ years of experience across Product Strategy, Growth, Product Management, Product Operations, Strategy & Operations, or related functions, with meaningful leadership experience.
  • Strong experience driving product adoption, activation, engagement, retention, or product-led growth within a technology/SaaS business.
  • Demonstrated ability to use product and customer data to identify problems and drive strategic decisions.
  • Strong understanding of funnels, cohorts, segmentation, experimentation, retention, and customer lifecycle metrics.
  • Track record of influencing Product roadmaps and senior stakeholders without relying solely on direct authority.
  • Ability to move comfortably between executive-level strategy and hands-on problem solving.
  • Experience leading complex, cross-functional initiatives with measurable business outcomes.
  • Strong communication and storytelling skills, particularly when translating complex data into clear recommendations.
  • Experience with B2B SaaS, SMB products, platform businesses, or multi-product ecosystems is highly preferred.

About HighLevel:
HighLevel is an AI-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate and scale. Today, HighLevel supports SMBs across 150+ countries, fueling community-driven growth rooted in real customer outcomes.
To date, businesses operating on HighLevel have generated over $7 billion in ecosystem value, demonstrating the impact of shared infrastructure at scale. By centralizing conversations, automation and intelligence into one system, we help businesses move faster, reduce complexity and execute efficiently.
Behind the platform, HighLevel powers more than 4 billion API hits and 2.5 billion message events daily. With 250 terabytes of distributed data, 250+ microservices and over 1 million domain names supported, our architecture is built for performance, resilience and long-term scalability.

Our People: 
With over 2,000 team members across 10+ countries, HighLevel operates as a global, remote-first organization built for speed and ownership. We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home.

Our Impact: 
Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1.5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact. We’re proud to be a part of that.
Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts

lists.content:
The Director of SDET is a pivotal role blending strong technical depth with strategic and people leadership. 

You will own the quality engineering vision for the organization, mentor the next generation of SDET managers and leads, and champion the adoption of AI-driven tools and practices to modernize how the organization builds, tests, and ships software.

-> Quality Strategy & Architecture:
  • Own the end-to-end quality engineering vision, strategy, and roadmap across multiple product lines or business units
  • Establish quality gates, release readiness criteria, and CI/CD processes
  • Drive a "shift-left, shift-right" quality culture — embedding testability into design reviews and using production observability to close the loop
  • Conduct architectural reviews across new and existing products to proactively surface scalability, reliability, and performance risks
  • Evaluate and select tooling, frameworks, and platforms (open-source and commercial) that scale automation across teams
    • -> AI Adoption:
  • Lead the org's AI adoption strategy for quality engineering — building or integrating AI/ML-based testing tools to improve coverage, productivity, and defect prediction
  • Continuously evaluate and leverage AI for all aspects of Quality Engineering ensuring quality strategy keeps pace with how product is built
    • -> Stakeholder & People Leadership:
  • Partner with Engineering, Product, DevOps, and Security leadership to align quality goals with business and release objectives
  • Provide regular quality updates, metrics, and strategic recommendations to executive leadership
  • Define, set up, and monitor key quality and productivity metrics (KPIs/OKRs)
  • Lead succession planning and mentor SDET Managers and Leads to build the next layer of quality leadership

• 15+ years in software testing/quality engineering, including 5+ years in a Director or senior engineering leadership role
  • Deep expertise in test automation frameworks (Selenium, Playwright, RestAssured, etc.) and languages (Java, Python, JavaScript/TypeScript)
  • Strong understanding of CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Harness CI/CD), containerization (Docker/Kubernetes), and cloud platforms (AWS/Azure/GCP)
  • Hands-on experience building AI/ML-based testing tools that measurably improve coverage and productivity
  • Solid grounding in performance testing, security testing, and other non-functional quality attributes
  • Experience architecting test strategies for microservices, distributed systems, and mobile platforms

• Experience presenting AI or quality-transformation initiatives at conferences
  • Prior experience testing high-transaction SaaS platforms (CRM, Payments, Automation, Email, Fintech, or similar)
  • Experience building and testing AI products using Agentic AI, including evaluation frameworks
  • Contributions to open-source testing frameworks or published thought leadership on QE/AI trends

• Quality vision and strategic execution
  • Non-functional testing (performance, security, reliability) and continuous delivery
  • Operational discipline within a fast-paced, rapid release environment
  • Stakeholder management across Engineering, Product, DevOps, and business functions
  • Team building and mentorship
  • Data-driven reporting of quality and productivity metrics to executive stakeholders

lists.content: We're looking for an experienced Engineering Manager II to lead engineering for our Platform Services team - the team responsible for the shared infrastructure, internal tooling, and core services that other product teams build on. This is not a purely managerial role; you'll stay hands-on with architecture, code, and systems while owning team outcomes, delivery, and platform reliability at enterprise scale.

• Architecture & Scale: Own and evolve distributed systems architecture for platform services, ensuring they're reliable, extensible, and performant under enterprise-scale load.
  • Cost & Efficiency: Drive continuous cost optimization initiatives across cloud infrastructure without compromising reliability or performance - with measurable, sustained impact.
  • Execution & Delivery: Own roadmap planning, estimation, and predictable delivery for the platform team, balancing tech debt, new capabilities, and operational stability.
  • Reliability & Operations: Establish strong observability and incident management practices; ensure the team can detect, diagnose, and resolve issues quickly, and drive blameless postmortems that lead to real fixes.
  • Data-Driven Decision Making: Use metrics and data to prioritize, evaluate trade-offs, and report on platform health, cost, and team performance.
  • People & Culture: Hire, mentor, and grow engineers; set technical standards; build a culture of ownership and craftsmanship within the team.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with product engineering teams, SRE/infra, security, and leadership to align platform capabilities with organizational needs.
  • Communication: Represent the platform team's priorities, risks, and progress clearly to engineering leadership and stakeholders across the org.

• 10+ years of overall software engineering experience, including at least 2+ years in a Software Development Manager (or equivalent) role.
  • Expert-level proficiency in either Go, Python or Nodejs.
  • Prior experience managing a platform team, or having worked as an individual contributor on platform teams for at least 3+ years, at enterprise scale.
  • Strong hands-on orientation - comfortable reviewing code, debugging production issues, and going deep on architecture, not just managing processes. Candidates in a purely managerial (non-hands-on) role for the last 1+ year will not be considered a fit.
  • Deep, practical experience with GCP and/or AWS service management - provisioning, scaling, IAM, networking, and cost governance.
  • Demonstrated track record of driving cost optimization initiatives in an enterprise cloud environment, with measurable results.
  • Strong understanding of distributed systems architecture - consistency, availability, fault tolerance, scaling patterns, and trade-offs at scale.
  • Strong observability fundamentals - hands-on experience with tools like Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/OpenSearch, or equivalent, and a track record of building observability into systems from the ground up.
  • A data-driven approach to decision-making, prioritization, and performance reporting.
  • Proven experience in roadmap planning, estimation, and delivering complex initiatives on time.
  • Strong people management skills - hiring, mentoring, performance management - combined with the ability to collaborate effectively across engineering, product, and security teams.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to influence both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • AI-first mindset - actively using AI tools in engineering workflows in recent years; experience building or integrating agent-driven systems is a strong plus.

• A team of platform engineers building and operating shared services, internal platforms, and infrastructure used across multiple product lines.
  • Cloud infrastructure and service management across GCP/AWS, including provisioning, scaling, security, and cost governance.

We are seeking a visionary Engineering Manager to spearhead our WhatsApp Team — the engine behind one of HighLevel’s most explosive growth stories. For our rapidly expanding global customer base, this isn’t just a feature; it is their lifeline and primary gateway for engaging with their own customers at scale.
 
This team architecturally owns the entire WhatsApp ecosystem: frictionless onboarding, complex WABA management, template lifecycles, high-throughput message delivery, and the sophisticated usage metering that powers our monetization. Operating at the intersection of our product ambitions and Meta’s global business platform, you will navigate a high-stakes environment where roadmap velocity meets the technical rigor of massive-scale API integrations. external platform's rate limits, policy changes and API deprecations as by our own product ambitions.
 
With adoption outpacing original architecture, your mission is pure-play core engineering: re-architecting for the next order of magnitude. You will solve for extreme deliverability under bursty load, resilient webhook ingestion, and ironclad tenant isolation. Leading a world-class team of 8+ engineers, you will own the technical destiny of a product that is scaling faster than the market, partnering with cross-functional leaders to ensure reliability never flinches in the face of hyper-growth.

• Architect for massive scale: Own the high-level architecture and scaling decisions for core Phone platform components, including CPaaS abstractions, provider adapters, and shared messaging/voice APIs that support billions of monthly events.

  • Own Phone Billing end to end: usage metering, rating, reserve/commit lifecycle, idempotency, reconciliation, and audit trails for the Phone and WhatsApp channels - with zero tolerance for double-charging or lost usage

  • Lead the evolution of Trust & Compliance systems into a configuration-driven, rules-based platform that adapts to new regulatory and carrier requirements without invasive engineering change

  • Work hands-on with technologies like NestJS, Firestore, MongoDB, PostgreSQL, Redis, Queuing Systems, Data Warehousing Systems and Service Mesh-based microservices

  • Drive high-concurrency innovation: Lead the design and execution of cross-cutting initiatives to improve reliability, latency, and throughput across time-sensitive APIs and workflows serving millions of businesses.

  • Drive observability and resilience by evolving our monitoring, alerting (Prometheus/Grafana), and incident response strategies - including the financial invariants that must be alerted on, not just the technical ones

  • Leverage LLMs and AI tools to write, refactor, test, and debug code efficiently - while implementing guardrails to reduce hallucination and boost reliability

  • Partner with product, infra, security, finance and legal teams to ensure data integrity, access control, and compliance across phone services

  • Develop EM I leaders and senior engineers, build leadership pipeline, succession planning and raise the hiring bar

  • Participate in design reviews, deep dives, and on-call rotations to support a high-bar culture of accountability and operational excellence

• 9+ years of backend engineering experience with 2+ years of leadership, with a proven track record of designing fault-tolerant systems that operate at a scale of billions of hits or events.

  • Deep expertise in distributed systems, event-driven architectures, and asynchronous job processing

  • Demonstrated experience building systems where correctness is non-negotiable - metering, ledgers, billing, payments, or comparable transactional domains - with a working grasp of idempotency, exactly-once semantics, and reconciliation

  • Proven experience optimizing availability, performance, and reliability in real-world systems under load

  • Strong experience with relational and NoSQL data models (especially with complex transactional data)

  • Experience designing policy- or rules-driven systems that evolve with external requirements rather than hard-coding them

  • Familiarity with monitoring, SLOs, and root-cause analysis in production environments

  • Familiarity with hallucination mitigation strategies (e.g., code constraints, test scaffolding, embeddings, context injection)

  • Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills, including with Finance, Legal and external partners

  • A pragmatic, hands-on leader who balances long-term vision with iterative execution

• Experience with usage-based billing or metering engines in a high-volume product, specifically managing millions of transactional events per hour.

  • Exposure to telecom trust and compliance regimes - 10DLC, toll-free verification, TCPA/TSR, DLT, carrier filtering or number portability

  • Experience building provider-agnostic integration layers across multiple third-party vendors

  • Experience working with AI Tools, Communication APIs (Twilio, Plivo etc)

  • Contributions to open-source tools, internal platforms, or engineering blogs

We’re looking for an experienced Engineering Manager II to lead and scale our SDET team at HighLevel.

This is a leadership role responsible for driving our test automation strategy, quality processes, and engineering excellence across our products. You will lead a high-performing team of SDETs and play a crucial role in building a culture of quality-first, shift-left testing, and continuous improvement.

You will be responsible for strengthening our automation frameworks, improving productivity through GenAI tools, and partnering closely with development and release teams to deliver world-class software with speed and reliability.

• Lead, mentor, and grow a team of SDETs focused on automation, performance, and reliability.
  • Define and execute the end-to-end test automation strategy across web, mobile, and API layers.
  • Champion Shift-Left Testing and ensure integration of automated tests into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Collaborate closely with Dev Managers and Leads to improve release quality, coverage, and speed.
  • Establish benchmarks for automation quality, performance, and code standards across teams.
  • Build and optimize frameworks in TypeScript/Playwright, enabling scalable test suites and maintainable automation infrastructure.
  • Oversee release readiness, test planning, and quality gates for major product launches.
  • Drive initiatives to improve test productivity using GenAI/AI tools, including intelligent test generation and analysis.
  • Ensure strong coverage across functional, non-functional, performance, and security testing areas.
  • Provide architectural guidance on testing strategy, tooling, and infrastructure.
  • Inspire a culture of continuous improvement, innovation, and accountability within the SDET sub-department.

• 9+ years of overall experience in Quality Engineering.
  • Proven experience managing and mentoring a large SDET team.
  • Strong hands-on background as a Test Automation Architect, ideally in TypeScript and Playwright.
  • Excellent understanding of test automation design patterns, CI/CD pipelines, cloud environments (AWS/GCP), and development workflows.
  • Hands-on expertise with API testing, Performance testing (e.g., JMeter, k6, Gatling), and Mobile Test Automation (Appium or equivalent).
  • Strong believer in Shift-Left Testing, enabling early quality validation in SDLC.
  • Demonstrated ability to set up scalable automation frameworks and increase automation coverage.
  • Experience building testing infrastructure and pipelines for microservices or cloud-native applications.
  • Track record of scaling teams and processes in fast-paced product organizations.
  • Passion for mentoring engineers, fostering technical growth, and promoting a culture of continuous learning.
  • Enthusiasm for leveraging GenAI and AI agents to enhance testing productivity, efficiency, and intelligence.

Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience

lists.content:
• End-to-End Product Ownership:
  • Translate business goals into working, deployable systems
  • Define architecture, workflows, and implementation plans
  • Ship and maintain production-grade systems — not demos or prototypes

  • Rapid Prototyping & Iteration:
  • Turn ambiguous ideas into working demos within hours or days
  • Prototype using code, AI tooling, automation, or low-code systems
  • Validate through experiments and real user feedback, then iterate to production quality

  • Build AI-Native Systems: 
  • Design and orchestrate LLM agents, retrieval pipelines, workflow automation, memory layers, APIs, and guardrails. Build for resilience against hallucinations, model variability, and quality degradation over time.

  • Design for Scale, Cost & Performance: 
  • Reason through token consumption, inference cost, latency constraints, infrastructure scalability, and system resilience. The goal: systems that work efficiently at scale.

  • Operational Excellence:
  • Instrument systems with monitoring and telemetry
  • Build evaluation loops for continuous quality improvement
  • Automate workflows that increase engineering velocity
  • Maintain clear, repeatable documentation

• Demonstrated track record of shipping production systems
  • Strong systems thinking and logical reasoning
  • High ownership mindset; operates well with minimal supervision
  • Comfortable with ambiguity and fast iteration cycles
  • Experience with APIs, automation tools, or AI platforms
  • Ability to reason about infrastructure tradeoffs and system reliability

• Experience building LLM-based or AI-driven products
  • Familiarity with evaluation frameworks, monitoring, or instrumentation
  • Experience with data pipelines, analytics, or telemetry
  • Strong UX and front-end sensibility
  • Portfolio or GitHub showcasing deployed systems
  • Stack: React / Vue / Angular · Node.js / Python / Java

• Consistently reduces cycle time from idea to production
  • Ships production-grade systems, not experiments
  • Balances quality, latency, and cost in system design
  • Builds evaluation loops that improve product performance over time

• Massive Impact: Your work directly affects millions of businesses worldwide
  • High Autonomy: We trust builders to own outcomes, not just tasks
  • Remote-First: Work from anywhere; we measure results, not hours
  • AI-Native Stack: Latest tooling to accelerate building and experimentation
  • Builder Culture: We value speed, ownership, clarity of thought, and execution

About the RoleHighLevel’s Commerce platform is the system of record for how our customers sell — what they offer and how it is priced, how orders get fulfilled, and how money moves: payments in, invoices out, and books that balance. It spans product information, pricing, taxes, and channels; fulfillment and inventory; and the full finance stack of payments, checkout, invoicing, and ledger — together powering commerce for a global base of agencies and businesses operating at scale.
We are seeking a Group Product Manager, Commerce, to lead product across three connected verticals — Business Operations, Fulfillment Operations, and Finance — and the team of Product Managers who own them. You will set the strategy for the end-to-end commerce lifecycle, from catalog to cash, and be accountable for the coherence, reliability, and growth of the platform as a whole.
The ideal candidate is an experienced product leader who has managed and grown other Product Managers, and who can zoom from platform strategy down to the details of a pricing engine, a fulfillment flow, or a ledger entry. You lead through your team, raise the bar on product craft, and turn a broad, interdependent surface area into a clear, sequenced roadmap.
Your mission: To build a coherent, reliable, and extensible commerce platform — spanning what customers sell, how it is fulfilled, and how they get paid — and to build the team that delivers it, so HighLevel’s customers can run their entire business on us.

What You’ll Do
Set Commerce Product Strategy – Own the vision and multi-quarter roadmap across Business Operations, Fulfillment, and Finance, translating a broad, interdependent surface area into clear, sequenced priorities.
Lead & Grow a Team of PMs – Manage, mentor, and hire Product Managers across the verticals, setting a high bar for product craft and owning their performance, development, and career growth.
Own the End-to-End Commerce Lifecycle – Be accountable for the full catalog-to-cash journey — product information and pricing, fulfillment and inventory, payments, invoicing, and ledger — as one connected system.
Drive Platform Coherence – Ensure shared contracts like the analytics engine, layouts, and reporting are designed once and reused, so the verticals compose into a single, consistent platform rather than a set of silos.
Deliver Business Operations – Guide the PIM, pricing, taxes, channel configuration, loyalty, and analytics roadmap that lets merchants define what they sell, to whom, and at what price.
Deliver Fulfillment Operations – Steer fulfillment, inventory, and the upcoming warehousing, time-clocking, and metering charters so what was sold reliably reaches the buyer.
Deliver Finance – Own the payments, checkout, invoicing, and ledger/accounting roadmap, ensuring money moves securely and the books balance across providers and external systems like QuickBooks and Xero.
Own Outcomes & Metrics – Drive measurable growth in GMV, transaction success, merchant adoption, and reliability, using data to prioritize across a large and competing set of bets.
Partner with Senior Stakeholders – Work closely with engineering, design, finance, operations, and leadership to align on strategy, resourcing, and trade-offs, and represent Commerce in company-level planning.
Balance Delivery & Long-Term Bets – Keep near-term charters shipping on time while investing in the platform foundations that compound over the next several years.
Raise the Operating Bar – Establish the rituals, specs, and quality standards — discovery, prioritization, launch, and review — that make the team predictable, fast, and outcome-driven.

Who You Are
Experienced People Leader – You have managed and grown Product Managers, and you get energy from multiplying your impact through a strong, well-run team.Platform & Commerce Depth – You have led product across commerce, payments, fintech, or a comparable transaction-heavy platform, and understand how catalog, fulfillment, and finance fit together.
Strategic and Execution-Focused – You can define a multi-vertical strategy and still hold your teams to crisp execution, ensuring ideas translate into shipped, measurable impact.
Systems Thinker – You see the interdependencies across modules and design for coherence, reuse, and shared contracts rather than one-off solutions.
Outcome- & Customer-Centric – You balance business goals, risk, and trust, keeping the merchants who run their business on the platform at the center of every decision.
Highly Data-Driven in Ambiguity – You are comfortable prioritizing across a broad, messy portfolio, using data to make sharp trade-offs without waiting for perfect information.

What You’ll Bring
8+ years of Product Management experience, including 2+ years directly managing Product Managers, and 10+ years of total professional experience.
A track record of leading product across a large, multi-team surface area — ideally in commerce, payments, fintech, or platform/SaaS — with measurable business impact.
Proven people leadership: hiring, developing, and retaining strong PMs, and building the operating rhythm of a high-performing product team.
Strong platform and systems judgment, with the ability to reason about how pricing, fulfillment, payments, invoicing, and ledger interconnect.
Experience partnering with senior engineering, design, and business stakeholders to set strategy, secure resourcing, and drive company-level outcomes.
Bonus:
You have owned a commerce or payments platform end-to-end — from catalog to cash — at significant scale, and can clearly articulate your impact on growth, reliability, and team development.
Why should you join us?
At HighLevel, we foster an exciting and dynamic work environment driven by a passionate team. We believe in a collective responsibility where no task is considered someone else's job. Our unwavering focus is on providing value to our users, and we achieve this by delivering solutions swiftly through lean principles, allowing us to bring products to market in a matter of weeks rather than quarters. Every good idea is put to the test, ensuring that we maintain a high standard of innovation. We prioritise the well-being of our team, recognizing that by taking care of them, they can better serve our users. We embrace the concept of continuous and iterative improvement, understanding that progress is an ongoing journey. We are also a well funded & profitable company. 

Join us at High Level, and you will have the opportunity to learn the intricacies of scaling a B2B SaaS startup and develop impactful products that cater to the needs of our customers.
EEO StatementThe company is an Equal Opportunity Employer. As an employer subject to affirmative action regulations, we invite you to voluntarily provide the following demographic information. This information is used solely for compliance with government recordkeeping, reporting, and other legal requirements. Providing this information is voluntary and refusal to do so will not affect your application status. This data will be kept separate from your application and will not be used in the hiring decision.
We encourage you to review our Privacy Policy before submitting your application

We are seeking a Group Product Manager, Commerce, to lead product across three connected verticals — Business Operations, Fulfillment Operations, and Finance — and the team of Product Managers who own them. You will set the strategy for the end-to-end commerce lifecycle, from catalog to cash, and be accountable for the coherence, reliability, and growth of the platform as a whole.

The ideal candidate is an experienced product leader who has managed and grown other Product Managers, and who can zoom from platform strategy down to the details of a pricing engine, a fulfillment flow, or a ledger entry. You lead through your team, raise the bar on product craft, and turn a broad, interdependent surface area into a clear, sequenced roadmap.

Your mission: To build a coherent, reliable, and extensible commerce platform — spanning what customers sell, how it is fulfilled, and how they get paid — and to build the team that delivers it, so HighLevel’s customers can run their entire business on us.

What You’ll Do

Set Commerce Product Strategy – Own the vision and multi-quarter roadmap across Business Operations, Fulfillment, and Finance, translating a broad, interdependent surface area into clear, sequenced priorities.

Lead & Grow a Team of PMs – Manage, mentor, and hire Product Managers across the verticals, setting a high bar for product craft and owning their performance, development, and career growth.

Own the End-to-End Commerce Lifecycle – Be accountable for the full catalog-to-cash journey — product information and pricing, fulfillment and inventory, payments, invoicing, and ledger — as one connected system.

Drive Platform Coherence – Ensure shared contracts like the analytics engine, layouts, and reporting are designed once and reused, so the verticals compose into a single, consistent platform rather than a set of silos.

Deliver Business Operations – Guide the PIM, pricing, taxes, channel configuration, loyalty, and analytics roadmap that lets merchants define what they sell, to whom, and at what price.

Deliver Fulfillment Operations – Steer fulfillment, inventory, and the upcoming warehousing, time-clocking, and metering charters so what was sold reliably reaches the buyer.

Deliver Finance – Own the payments, checkout, invoicing, and ledger/accounting roadmap, ensuring money moves securely and the books balance across providers and external systems like QuickBooks and Xero.

Own Outcomes & Metrics – Drive measurable growth in GMV, transaction success, merchant adoption, and reliability, using data to prioritize across a large and competing set of bets.

Partner with Senior Stakeholders – Work closely with engineering, design, finance, operations, and leadership to align on strategy, resourcing, and trade-offs, and represent Commerce in company-level planning.

Balance Delivery & Long-Term Bets – Keep near-term charters shipping on time while investing in the platform foundations that compound over the next several years.

Raise the Operating Bar – Establish the rituals, specs, and quality standards — discovery, prioritization, launch, and review — that make the team predictable, fast, and outcome-driven.


Who You Are

Experienced People Leader – You have managed and grown Product Managers, and you get energy from multiplying your impact through a strong, well-run team.

Platform & Commerce Depth – You have led product across commerce, payments, fintech, or a comparable transaction-heavy platform, and understand how catalog, fulfillment, and finance fit together.

Strategic and Execution-Focused – You can define a multi-vertical strategy and still hold your teams to crisp execution, ensuring ideas translate into shipped, measurable impact.

Systems Thinker – You see the interdependencies across modules and design for coherence, reuse, and shared contracts rather than one-off solutions.

Outcome- & Customer-Centric – You balance business goals, risk, and trust, keeping the merchants who run their business on the platform at the center of every decision.

Highly Data-Driven in Ambiguity – You are comfortable prioritizing across a broad, messy portfolio, using data to make sharp trade-offs without waiting for perfect information.


What You’ll Bring

  • 8+ years of Product Management experience, including 2+ years directly managing Product Managers, and 10+ years of total professional experience.

  • A track record of leading product across a large, multi-team surface area — ideally in commerce, payments, fintech, or platform/SaaS — with measurable business impact.

  • Proven people leadership: hiring, developing, and retaining strong PMs, and building the operating rhythm of a high-performing product team.

  • Strong platform and systems judgment, with the ability to reason about how pricing, fulfillment, payments, invoicing, and ledger interconnect.

  • Experience partnering with senior engineering, design, and business stakeholders to set strategy, secure resourcing, and drive company-level outcomes.

Bonus:

  • You have owned a commerce or payments platform end-to-end — from catalog to cash — at significant scale, and can clearly articulate your impact on growth, reliability, and team development.

Why should you join us?

At HighLevel, we foster an exciting and dynamic work environment driven by a passionate team. We believe in a collective responsibility where no task is considered someone else's job. Our unwavering focus is on providing value to our users, and we achieve this by delivering solutions swiftly through lean principles, allowing us to bring products to market in a matter of weeks rather than quarters. Every good idea is put to the test, ensuring that we maintain a high standard of innovation. We prioritise the well-being of our team, recognizing that by taking care of them, they can better serve our users. We embrace the concept of continuous and iterative improvement, understanding that progress is an ongoing journey. We are also a well funded & profitable company.

Join us at High Level, and you will have the opportunity to learn the intricacies of scaling a B2B SaaS startup and develop impactful products that cater to the needs of our customers.

We are looking for an Implementation Advisor Apprentice to join our team for a structured 6-month apprenticeship. This full-time programme is designed for someone looking to build a strong foundation in software implementation, customer success, and technology-driven business growth. 

Apprentices will be training to become an advisor. They will work on real customer initiatives alongside experienced advisors, gaining hands-on experience in customer onboarding, implementation, business process management, software best practices, and change management. 

Programme Details

  • Work Type: Apprenticeship
  • Department: Customer Success
  • Sub-Department: Implementation Services
  • Duration: 6 months
  • Shift Timings:
    • 7:00 AM – 4:00 PM CST, Saturday–Wednesday
    • 11:00 AM – 8:00 PM CST, Saturday–Wednesday
    • 3:00 PM – 12:00 AM CST, Saturday–Wednesday
    • Monthly Stipend: INR 32,000
    • Location: Remote – India
    • Programme Start: October 2026

      • Responsibilities

    • Understand customer requirements, business needs, and pain points.
    • Support customer onboarding and implementation activities.
    • Assist in creating implementation and transition plans.
    • Support advisors in ensuring successful product adoption and customer outcomes.
    • Maintain clear documentation and communicate next steps to customers.
    • Assist with webinars, workshops, and customer education sessions.
    • Collaborate with internal teams to address customer requirements and implementation needs.
    • Stay updated on HighLevel product features and releases.
    • Support customers with basic implementation-related issues.
    • Build strong customer relationships and contribute to long-term customer success.
    • Continuously identify opportunities to improve the onboarding and implementation experience.

      • Requirements

    • Recent graduate in Business Administration, Commerce, Information Technology, or a related field.
    • Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
    • Basic technical understanding and willingness to learn SaaS products.
    • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
    • Ability to learn new tools, processes, and workflows quickly.
    • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a remote environment.

      • Nice to Have

    • Internship or project experience in SaaS, customer success, technical support, implementation, or consulting.
    • Familiarity with CRM or SaaS platforms.
    • Basic understanding of business processes and software workflows.

lists.content:
As a Lead Engineer, you will drive the technical direction for our AI-driven application-builder architecture, lead complex system design decisions, and serve as a hands-on technical leader and mentor for the engineers building AI Studio’s app generation engine, React website/app builder, design and component systems, domain publishing pipeline, and AI Agents. This is a hands-on individual contributor role — you’ll spend the majority of your time designing systems and writing production code — while partnering closely with product, infra, and design to shape the roadmap, raise engineering standards, and deliver intuitive, generative, high-performance user experiences at scale.

Architecture & Platform Ownership

  • Own architecture and scaling decisions for core AI Studio platform components (e.g., App Generation Engine, React Build & Render Pipeline, Domain & Publishing Pipeline, AI Content Systems)

  • Lead design and implementation of cross-cutting initiatives to improve system responsiveness, generation accuracy, and platform robustness

  • Build scalable, fault-tolerant LLM pipelines for content generation, layout creation, experimentation, and AI-driven user guidance

    • AI & Distributed Systems Engineering

  • Work hands-on with technologies like Go, NestJS, Node, PostgreSQL, Firestore, Vector Databases, Cloudflare Workers, Cloudflare KV, and microservices

  • Design distributed systems that handle high-throughput generative and analytical workloads while ensuring correctness and low latency

  • Build and optimize embeddings pipelines, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and multi-agent orchestration frameworks

    • Quality, Observability & Reliability

  • Drive improvements in observability using Prometheus/Grafana, OpenTelemetry, and structured logging

  • Establish and maintain SLOs for generation latency, correctness, model safety, and system uptime

  • Strengthen resiliency and failover strategies to ensure seamless user experiences during traffic spikes and model load variations

    • AI Guardrails, Safety & Tooling

  • Implement hallucination mitigation strategies (code constraints, structured outputs, model verification layers, retrieval guards, test scaffolding)

  • Collaborate with infra and security to enforce data governance, access control, privacy boundaries, and compliance around user-generated data

  • Leverage LLMs and AI tools to write, test, and debug code — while driving standards that ensure reliability and consistency across engineering teams

    • Technical Leadership & Collaboration

  • Mentor engineers through code reviews, design discussions, and pairing, leading by influence to promote technical excellence, code quality, and a high-ownership culture (this is an individual contributor role with no direct reports)

  • Partner with PMs, designers, and other engineering leaders to define long-term roadmap and deliver high-performing AI-powered application-building features

  • Participate in reviews, deep dives, and on-call rotations to maintain a culture of accountability and operational excellence

Core Experience

  • 6+ years of backend engineering experience, including distributed system design and high-scale platform development

  • Strong proficiency in Go (Golang) for building high-performance, concurrent backend services, alongside Node/NestJS experience

  • Hands-on experience building and operating edge/serverless services with Cloudflare Workers and Cloudflare KV (or comparable edge compute and distributed key-value stores)

  • Deep expertise in event-driven architectures, asynchronous workflows, and high-throughput data pipelines.

  • Strong command of relational (PostgreSQL) and NoSQL data models, query optimization, and complex transactional data

  • Fluency in LLM integrations, vector search, embeddings, RAG patterns, and generative AI frameworks

  • Familiarity with frontend architecture using Vue, and a solid understanding of UI/UX principles

    • Operational Excellence

  • Experience with monitoring, alerting, and incident response for production systems

  • Strong instincts for scaling, latency optimization, and reliability under real-world load

    • AI & LLM Safety

  • Experience implementing structured generation, verification layers, retrieval-based grounding, and guardrails to reduce hallucinations

  • Understanding of prompt engineering patterns, context injection, and model evaluation

    • Soft Skills

  • Exceptional communication and cross-functional leadership capabilities

  • Pragmatic decision-making with a balance of long-term vision and iterative execution

About Highlevel

HighLevel is an AI-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate and scale. Today, HighLevel supports SMBs across 150+ countries, fueling community-driven growth rooted in real customer outcomes.
To date, businesses operating on HighLevel have generated over $7 billion in ecosystem value, demonstrating the impact of shared infrastructure at scale. By centralizing conversations, automation and intelligence into one system, we help businesses move faster, reduce complexity and execute efficiently.
Behind the platform, HighLevel powers more than 4 billion API hits and 2.5 billion message events daily. With 250 terabytes of distributed data, 250+ microservices and over 1 million domain names supported, our architecture is built for performance, resilience and long-term scalability.

Our people


With over 2,000 team members across 10+ countries, HighLevel operates as a global, remote-first organization built for speed and ownership. We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home.

Our impact

Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1.5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact. We’re proud to be a part of that.
Learn more about us on our  YouTube Channel or Blog Posts

About the Role

We’re looking for a Lead Software Engineer to join our AI Studio Team, the group responsible for building AI Studio — an AI-based React application builder that generates production-ready websites and other React applications from natural language, which users can then connect to custom domains and publish live to the internet — from prompt-driven app generation, component and layout creation, automated copy/design generation, real-time preview and editing, to one-click deployment across our product ecosystem.

This team owns the intelligence layer that helps millions of SMBs build production-ready websites and React applications without technical expertise. The AI Studio platform orchestrates complex workflows across data processing, LLM-powered reasoning, code and component generation, design generation, and live deployment to custom domains. With millions of applications and billions of visitor interactions flowing through our systems, reliability, correctness, and performance are mission-critical.

lists.content:
• Lead the architecture and delivery of industry solutions, from understanding the customer problem with product and domain experts, through early experiments and validation, to production launch at scale

  • Make pragmatic speed vs. scale trade-offs: ship lean versions to validate with customers, then harden what works into reusable platform capabilities

  • Design a reusable "industry layer": configurable objects, workflows, templates, and automations that can be packaged per vertical without forking the core product

  • Build integrations with industry platforms such as food delivery services (Uber Eats, DoorDash), payment providers (Stripe), and booking and ticketing systems

  • Define standards for how industry features are versioned, rolled out behind feature flags, and rolled back across thousands of accounts and sub-accounts

  • Build reliable event-driven systems for real-time industry workflows such as orders, reservations, check-ins, and payments

  • Collaborate with core platform teams to expose safe, well-documented extension points that industry solutions depend on

  • Lead and mentor a team of engineers, working day to day with product and design, through technical direction, code reviews, and a strong focus on quality and reliability

  • Drive observability, performance, and error handling across industry workflows and integrations

  • Work with product and go-to-market teams to identify the highest-impact opportunities in each vertical, and measure success by customer adoption and time-to-value

• 7+ years of backend or platform engineering experience, with 2+ years in a technical leadership role

  • Deep experience designing configurable, multi-tenant platforms: metadata-driven data models, workflow engines, or templating systems

  • A track record of taking products or major features from 0→1 into production, including knowing when to move fast and when to invest in scale

  • A track record of entering unfamiliar domains, learning them quickly from experts, and translating that into solid technical designs

  • Strong product and customer sense: you connect technical decisions to business outcomes, not just system design

  • Experience building third-party integrations, including OAuth flows, signed webhooks, data sync, and error recovery

  • Strong understanding of security, scalability, and data isolation in multi-tenant SaaS environments

  • Excellent communication skills with both engineers and non-technical domain stakeholders

• Experience with vertical SaaS or industry clouds, such as Salesforce Industries, Toast, or Eventbrite

  • Hands-on work with food delivery, POS, reservation, or event ticketing integrations

  • Experience with payment flows such as Stripe Connect, deposits, and refunds

  • Familiarity with scoped permissions, event hooks, and audit trails

  • Experience packaging features as installable apps or templates for customers and partners

• Backend: TypeScript on Node.js with NestJS, building REST APIs documented with OpenAPI/Swagger

  • Frontend: Vue 3, TypeScript, Pinia and Tailwind, shipped as module-federated micro-frontends

  • Data and messaging: Firestore (including MongoDB-compatible mode via Mongoose), Elasticsearch and Redis, with event-driven workers on Google Cloud Pub/Sub and Cloud Tasks

  • Cloud and delivery: Google Cloud Platform, Docker and Kubernetes (GKE) with Istio, and CI/CD on Jenkins and GitHub Actions

  • Observability and quality: Prometheus, Cloud Logging and Sentry, and testing with Jest, Vitest and Playwright

We're hiring a Lead Product Analyst, AI Products to be the analytics owner and measurement lead for HighLevel's AI pillar -Voice AI, Conversation AI, AI Employee, and Ask AI. These products are shipping fast with limited analytics foundation underneath them; we would provide value by creating consistent instrumentation, agreed success metrics, and a rigorous read on adoption or quality. You'll build that from the ground up.

Your first job is to define the feature-level KPIs and success metrics each AI product is judged on. From there you'll own adoption and quality analysis and, partnering closely with the Experimentation & Causal Inference lead, bring rigor to measuring non-deterministic, fast-iterating AI features where a classic A/B read is hard. You'll work amid a data foundation still being built, consuming governed sources rather than rebuilding them, and raising the bar as you go. As the AI analytics lead, you set the measurement direction and standards for the domain and develop the analysts who join as it scales.

• Own instrumentation coverage for the AI pillar -define the events and properties each AI surface must emit, and drive them into the roadmap with PMs and engineering
  • Define feature-level KPIs and success metrics for Voice AI, Conversation AI, AI Employee, and Ask AI -what "working" and "adopted" mean, made explicit and trusted
  • Partner with the Experimentation & Causal Inference lead to design and read AI experiments, including measurement approaches for non-deterministic, fast-iterating systems
  • Separate real signal from instrumentation gaps, novelty effects, and data maturity in every read
  • Set the measurement direction and standards for the AI analytics domain -the canonical metrics and instrumentation contracts other teams build on -and mentor analysts as the pod grows
  • Translate findings into clear recommendations for AI PMs and influence the roadmap without owning it
  • Flag data gaps to Analytics Engineering and help shape the event taxonomy AI analytics depends on
  • Use AI tooling (Claude and similar) to move faster on exploration, documentation, and analysis

• 7+ years in product analytics, data science, or applied statistics, with hands-on ownership of a product area's metrics end to end
  • Strong instrumentation instinct -you've defined event tracking/taxonomy and driven it into a product roadmap, not just consumed existing tables
  • Ability to define success metrics for a product from a standing start and get stakeholders to adopt them
  • Fluency partnering on experiments (A/B design, guardrails) and interpreting results honestly
  • Strong SQL and working proficiency in Python; comfort in a Snowflake + dbt environment
  • Comfort working amid imperfect, in-progress data -you consume governed sources and help raise the bar rather than rebuilding pipelines
  • Cross-functional influence -you shift PM priorities without direct authority in a fast-moving environment

• Experience measuring AI/ML or LLM-based product features, including non-deterministic systems
  • B2B SaaS, CRM, or product-led growth background
  • Experience with conversational, voice, or agent/assistant products
  • Familiarity with Statsig or a comparable experimentation platform
  • Exposure to AI-assisted analytics workflows

lists.text: Success in this role looks like:
lists.content:
• The AI surfaces are instrumented to a standard that makes them measurable, with coverage gaps closed on a known schedule
  • Each AI product has agreed, trusted feature-level KPIs and success metrics everyone uses
  • Adoption and quality of AI features are understood by segment, not guessed at
  • AI experiments are designed and read rigorously despite non-deterministic behavior
  • AI PMs make roadmap calls off the analysis, and the pillar has a foundation the next analysts can build on

Application Security, Secure SDLC & DevSecOps

  • Lead Application Security initiatives across web, mobile, API, microservices, and cloud-native products.

  • Conduct architecture reviews, threat modeling, secure design and code reviews, and hands-on security assessments.

  • Identify weaknesses in authentication, authorization, tenant isolation, business logic, data protection, and API security.

  • Define practical security standards, requirements, guardrails, and reusable secure engineering patterns.

  • Improve security testing across CI/CD pipelines using SAST, DAST, SCA, secret scanning, container scanning, and Infrastructure as Code scanning.

  • Drive risk-based vulnerability triage and remediation in partnership with engineering teams.

  • Develop security automation and promote secure coding through developer guidance, documentation, and training.

    • AI Security Assessment & Adversarial Testing

    • Lead security reviews of LLM applications, AI agents, RAG architectures, machine learning services, and third-party AI integrations.

    • Assess AI architectures, including model APIs, data pipelines, vector stores, prompts, fine-tuning workflows, plugins, and agent tool chains.

    • Conduct adversarial testing for prompt injection, jailbreaking, sensitive-data disclosure, system-prompt leakage, output manipulation, insecure tool use, excessive agency, and model abuse.

    • Evaluate applicable risks involving data poisoning, model inversion, training-data extraction, adversarial evasion, and model exfiltration.

    • Test security controls such as guardrails, input/output filtering, access controls, human approvals, logging, monitoring, and abuse detection.

    • Develop repeatable AI security testing methodologies, playbooks, automation, and test cases using tools such as Garak, PyRIT, or similar frameworks.

    • Assess security and supply-chain risks associated with third-party models, AI platforms, and AI-enabled SaaS products.

      • Reporting, Collaboration & Leadership

      • Produce clear security reports containing evidence, risk ratings, business impact, and actionable remediation guidance.

      • Communicate security risks effectively to developers, architects, product leaders, and executive stakeholders.

      • Partner with external consultants, researchers, and bug bounty programs for specialized assessments where required.

      • Mentor engineers and help establish a security-conscious engineering culture.

      • Stay current with developments in Application Security, AI Security, and adversarial testing.

• 8+ years of cybersecurity experience, with deep hands-on expertise in Application Security, product security, penetration testing, or security engineering.

  • Experience conducting threat modeling, architecture reviews, secure code reviews, penetration testing, and vulnerability validation.

  • 1-3 years of AI Security experience, with AI/ML security, adversarial testing of AI systems, or applied AI research with a security focus.

  • Strong knowledge of web, mobile, API, and cloud-native security, including OWASP guidance and business-logic risks.

  • Strong understanding of authentication and authorization technologies, including OAuth 2.0, OIDC, JWT, SAML, and modern access-control models.

  • Hands-on DevSecOps experience with CI/CD security automation, SAST, DAST, SCA, secret scanning, containers, and Infrastructure as Code.

  • Practical knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes, microservices, and cloud security.

  • Demonstrated experience assessing or securing LLM applications, RAG systems, AI agents, machine learning models, or AI-enabled products.

  • Understanding of AI threats such as prompt injection, jailbreaking, data leakage, insecure tool use, excessive agency, model misuse, and AI supply-chain risks.

  • Familiarity with OWASP guidance for LLM applications, MITRE ATLAS, NIST AI RMF, and related AI security practices.

  • Programming or scripting proficiency in Python, Go, JavaScript, Bash, or a similar language.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• Experience building or scaling Application Security practices within a SaaS or product-led technology organization.

  • Hands-on experience red teaming LLM applications, RAG systems, AI agents, or AI-enabled products.

  • Experience developing security automation, internal testing tools, or reusable security guardrails.

  • Contributions to security research, open-source projects, bug bounty programs, or responsible vulnerability disclosure.

  • Relevant certifications such as OSCP, OSWE, GWAPT, GIAC, CISSP, or an AI Security credential.

• Lead end-to-end mobile testing and automation for iOS and Android applications (Flutter-based)
  • Architect, enhance, and own scalable mobile automation frameworks using tools such as Appium, Flutter Integration Tests, Espresso, Maestro Test etc.

  • Define and execute test strategies covering functional, regression, performance, reliability, and non-functional testing
  • Debug complex issues across automation code, application behavior, device/platform differences, and CI infrastructure
  • Own release quality, including automated regressions, risk assessment, and final QA sign-offs
  • Partner closely with Product, Design, Dev, and DevOps to improve testability and reduce production defects
  • Mentor and technically guide SDETs and interns; set coding, review, and automation best practices
  • Track and report quality metrics, automation ROI, and coverage to stakeholders
  • Continuously improve QA processes to reduce cycle time and increase confidence in releases

• 7+ years of experience in mobile testing and automation, with lead-level ownership
  • Strong hands-on experience with Flutter-based mobile apps and testing frameworks (Flutter Integration Tests, Appium, Espresso, Maestro etc.).
  • Excellent programming skills in Dart, Java, Kotlin, or similar
  • Proven experience designing and maintaining robust, scalable test automation frameworks
  • Strong understanding of mobile-specific challenges (platform differences, lifecycle, performance, memory, network)
  • Hands-on experience using AI tools (ChatGPT, Cursor, Copilot, custom LLM workflows)
  • Experience with cloud device farms (Firebase Test Lab, BrowserStack, Sauce Labs)
  • Experience integrating automation with CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, Codemagic, Bitrise, GitHub Actions)
  • Ability to perform deep root-cause analysis (RCA) for automation failures and production issues
  • Strong leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills
  • Comfortable working in fast-paced, agile environments and driving quality initiatives independently
  • Mobile performance testing (Startup time, FPS, memory, Battery, Jank)
  • Solid understanding of API testing and backend dependencies

• Experience with declarative / DSL-based testing approaches
  • Passion for mentoring and building high-performing QA teams

lists.content:
We're seeking a seasoned Engineer to lead the development of LLM-powered AI agents and next-gen Generative AI systems that drive core product functionality and customer-facing automation at scale.

This is a high-autonomy, high-impact role for someone who thrives at the intersection of applied AI, agent design, and core data science. You'll build foundational models, retrieval systems, and dynamic agents that interact with millions of users — powering personalized communication, intelligent scheduling, smart replies, and much more.

We are looking for builders who can take projects from research and experimentation to production and iteration, and who bring strong data science rigour alongside hands-on GenAI experience.

• 8+ years of experience in Data Science, Machine Learning, or Applied AI, with a track record of delivering production-grade models and systems
  • Hands-on expertise with LLMs: fine-tuning, prompt engineering, function-calling agents, embeddings, and evaluation techniques
  • Strong experience in building retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems using vector databases (e.g., FAISS, Pinecone, Weaviate)
  • Experience working in cloud-native environments (GCP, AWS) and deploying models with frameworks like PyTorch, Transformers (HF), and MLOps tools
  • Experience with LangChain or similar agent orchestration frameworks; ability to design multi-step, tool-augmented agents
  • Proficiency in Python, with strong engineering practices (CI/CD, testing, versioning) and familiarity with TypeScript
  • Solid foundation in core data science: supervised and unsupervised learning, causal inference, statistical testing, segmentation, and time-series forecasting
  • Proven experience taking ML/AI solutions from prototype to production, including monitoring, observability, and model iteration
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively, leading initiatives and mentoring peers in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment
  • Strong product sense and communication skills—able to translate between technical constraints and product goals

• Architect and deploy autonomous AI agents that execute workflows across sales, messaging, scheduling, and operations
  • Build and fine-tune LLMs (open-source and API-driven) tailored to HighLevel's unique data and customer use cases
  • Develop robust retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems and vector search infrastructure to enable context-rich, real-time generation
  • Design and iterate on prompt engineering, context construction, and agent tool usage strategies using frameworks like LangChain
  • Apply core data science methods — modeling, A/B testing, scoring, clustering, and time-series forecasting — to enhance agent intelligence and broader product features
  • Partner with backend, infra, and product teams to build reusable, scalable GenAI infrastructure: model serving, prompt versioning, logging, evals, and feedback loops
  • Continuously evaluate and monitor agent performance, hallucination rates, and real-world effectiveness using rigorous experimentation frameworks
  • Influence HighLevel's AI roadmap while mentoring engineers and contributing to technical standards and best practices
