lists.content:
What You'll Be Doing:

  • Lead, coach, and develop a pod of Affiliate Managers (AFMs) who each own a named book of 100+ lifetime trial affiliates, running weekly 1:1s, book reviews, and performance conversations.

  • Own your pod's trial commit, forecast, and pacing. Report weekly on wins, risks, and asks, and course-correct fast when an affiliate or AFM book is slipping.

  • Be the escalation point for sensitive affiliate situations and resolve them at your level whenever possible.

  • Manage the endorsement motion for your pod: scope and negotiate endorsement agreements, verify deliverables, and move contracts and payouts through the Legal, Finance, and leadership approval cascade on time.

  • Monitor and actively grow the variety of avatars within the affiliate organization, building the next wave of top producers.

  • Coach AFMs to coach affiliates across the full funnel with a quality-first lens: quality lead generation, quality trial conversion, and trial-to-paid, so affiliates bring in customers who stick.

  • Partner with Land (acquisition) and Activation teams on clean affiliate handoffs, including context-building before graduation into Expand.

  • Build, document, and continuously improve Expand playbooks, SOPs, and onboarding so newer AFMs can operate independently and leader time goes to strategy, not ad-hoc troubleshooting.

  • Work cross-functionally with Business Development, Product Marketing, Events, Compliance, Legal, Finance, Accounts Payable, and RevOps to deliver programs, co-marketing, recognition, and payouts for your affiliates.

  • Partner with Compliance to make sure affiliates in your pod promote HighLevel in line with our Affiliate Program Policies and step in quickly when something needs correcting.

  • Help plan and show up for affiliate recognition moments and events (LevelUp, Commander experiences, affiliate-hosted events), and represent HighLevel with top affiliates in person.

  • Bring insights and recommendations to leadership on where to invest next: programs, incentives, tooling, headcount, and new segments.

    • What You'll Bring:

  • A track record of owning and growing a large book of high-value partner, affiliate, creator, or channel relationships where revenue impact was measurable.

  • Proven people leadership: you've hired, onboarded, coached, and held accountable a team of partner or account managers, including people early in their careers.

  • Comfort managing high-profile, high-personality partners, including tough negotiations and emotional escalations, while staying calm, fair, and firm.

  • Strong analytical skills. You can read a forecast, spot trends in cohort data, build a pacing view, and turn it into a clear plan.

  • Experience with partner incentive structures, commission programs, tiered recognition, and contract or endorsement-based partnerships.

  • Operational rigor. You build repeatable processes and documentation instead of relying on tribal knowledge.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to influence senior internal stakeholders and external partners.

  • Ability to thrive in a fast-moving, high-growth environment where priorities shift and you're expected to make good calls with imperfect information.

  • Willingness to travel for affiliate events and key relationship meetings (approximately 1-2 times per quarter).

    • Experience/Education/Certifications Required:

  • 8+ years of experience in affiliate, partner, channel, creator/influencer, or strategic account management, ideally in SaaS.

  • 3+ years of direct people management experience leading partner, affiliate, or account managers.

  • Experience owning a multi-million dollar partner or affiliate book with forecast accountability.


    • Preferred:

  • Experience with affiliate platforms and tools (FirstPromoter, Tipalti, or similar), CRMs, and BI tools such as Tableau.

  • Familiarity with the marketing agency, SMB SaaS, or creator economy space.

  • Working knowledge of FTC endorsement guidelines and affiliate compliance.

  • Experience with international partner markets.

At HighLevel, affiliates aren’t a side channel. They drive the majority of our net-new trials. This team owns the programs that turn new affiliates into active ones, keeps the full base engaged and motivated, and makes sure every affiliate promotes HighLevel the right way.

You’ve done this before at scale. You’ve run one-to-many partner, affiliate, creator, or community programs where you couldn’t talk to everyone individually, so you built the events, campaigns, content, and systems that did it for you. You’ve led a team with a wide variety of skill sets (events, creative and marketing, operations, and compliance) and you know how to keep each lane moving while connecting them into one program.

You’re also highly organized and action-biased. You can run a quarterly calendar of events, promos, and initiatives at the same time, ship on deadline, and coach a team to run their lanes independently.

  • Lead, coach, and develop a multidisciplinary team spanning affiliate events and community, affiliate marketing and creative, program operations, and affiliate compliance, running weekly 1:1s, lane reviews, and performance conversations.

  • Own the programmatic team’s activation and engagement goals across the full affiliate base, including activation rate, engagement scores, initiative participation, and event and asset reach. Report weekly on wins, risks, and asks, and course-correct fast when a program is underperforming.

  • Oversee the affiliate asset library: swipe copy, creative, landing pages, and training content, making sure affiliates always have current, on-brand, and compliant materials to promote HighLevel.

  • Own affiliate recognition programs, including awards, Commander experiences, and Summit moments, and represent HighLevel with affiliates in person.

  • Lead the affiliate compliance function: enforce our Affiliate Program Policies and endorsement requirements, oversee content reviews and violation resolution, and handle sensitive compliance conversations with affiliates at your level whenever possible.

  • Work cross-functionally with Business Development, Product Marketing, Events, Enablement, Legal, Finance, Accounts Payable, RevOps, and our internal teams to deliver programs and clean affiliate handoffs.


    • What You’ll Bring:

  • A track record of building and running one-to-many partner, affiliate, creator, or community programs that reached thousands of partners with measurable activation and engagement impact.

  • Proven people leadership: you’ve hired, onboarded, coached, and held accountable a team with different specialties, including people early in their careers.

  • Hands-on experience running events end to end, from small workshops to large in-person experiences, including budgets, vendors, and post-event reporting.

  • Experience running partner promos, campaigns, and content or asset programs with a strong eye for quality and brand.

  • A working knowledge of affiliate compliance and FTC endorsement rules, and experience building or operating controls, policies, and audit documentation.

  • Comfort handling tough conversations with high-personality partners, including policy violations and escalations, while staying calm, fair, and firm.

  • Strong analytical skills. You can define program KPIs, build a reporting view, read engagement and cohort data, and turn it into a clear plan.

  • 3+ years of direct people management experience leading a team across multiple functions (for example events, marketing, operations, or compliance).

  • Experience owning program KPIs and budgets for a partner or affiliate base of thousands.

Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing team responsible for complex and high-visibility customer escalations.
Own the strategy, operating standards, performance, and continued development of the Customer Escalations function.

Personally engage with customers in high-impact situations, taking ownership of difficult conversations and coordinating resolution across HighLevel.

Partner across Support, Customer Success, Product, Engineering, Billing, RevOps, and other functions to solve complex customer problems and improve cross-functional experiences.

Lead targeted initiatives that address recurring customer friction and measure whether changes meaningfully improve customer outcomes.
Use data, automation, tooling, and process improvements to increase the effectiveness and scalability of Customer Advocacy.

8+ years of progressive experience in Customer Support, Customer Experience, Customer Success, Escalations, or a related customer-facing technology function, including meaningful leadership experience.
Demonstrated success in a high-growth SaaS or technology environment.
Experience leading high-performing customer-facing professionals and owning or materially influencing a customer-facing function or program.
Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, including confidence engaging customers, business owners, executives, and senior internal stakeholders.
Strong business judgment and experience navigating complex or high-risk customer situations.
Demonstrated ability to identify patterns, diagnose root causes, and turn customer insights into operational improvements.
Proven ability to influence and drive change across teams without direct authority.
Strong analytical skills and comfort using data to prioritize problems and measure outcomes.
Ability to operate independently in ambiguous situations and move fluidly between strategic thinking and hands-on execution.
Strong technical curiosity and the ability to develop deep proficiency in complex SaaS products and customer use cases.
Excellent prioritization skills with a strong bias toward action and ownership.

lists.content:
Process Design & Documentation

  • Map the end-to-end Implementation and CSM journey — touchpoints, handoffs, escalation and risk paths — and document the standard way each is run.

  • Build and own the SOP library for both functions, designing from scratch where process today is tribal knowledge.

  • Keep documentation current through a fixed review cadence with clear version control and owners.

  • Partner with Ops to make the documented path the default path: checklists, templates, task automation, required fields.

    • Training Frameworks & Curriculum

  • Design a training framework for the department with clear competency maps, levels, and learning paths for Implementation Advisors, CSMs, and their managers.

  • Build curriculum using sound instructional design — defined learning objectives, blended delivery, practice and application, spaced reinforcement, and assessment — rather than one-off decks and recorded sessions.

  • Personally facilitate live sessions, workshops, and role-play labs; you are in front of the room regularly, not only behind the plan.

  • Build and maintain a certification model with objective pass criteria, practical assessment, and recertification cycles tied to product releases.

  • Create reusable assets that scale: playbooks, call guides, talk tracks, objection libraries, demo scripts, job aids, and scenario banks.

    • New Hire Onboarding & Ramp

  • Own new hire onboarding for Implementation and CSM end to end — week-by-week structure, product mastery milestones, shadow and reverse-shadow plans, and graduation criteria.

  • Drive measurable improvement in time-to-productivity and reduce variance in how quickly new advisors reach full caseload quality.

  • Standardise onboarding across geographies and shifts so a new hire in any location gets the same standard.

  • Run a structured nesting period with daily feedback loops, and hold the graduation bar.

    • Ongoing Capability & Product Enablement

  • Run a continuous learning calendar covering platform depth, customer conversation skills, discovery and diagnosis, adoption coaching, and handling difficult accounts.

  • Partner with Product and Product Marketing to turn every meaningful release into enablement — what changed, who it matters to, how to position it, how to configure it — delivered before customers ask.

  • Maintain a single source of truth for product and process knowledge, and keep it genuinely current.

  • Build enablement for managers, not only for advisors: how to run a call review, how to give feedback that changes behaviour, how to coach to a framework.

    • Quality Assurance & Coaching Systems

  • Own the QA framework for the department: scorecards, sampling methodology, calibration sessions, and reporting.

  • Personally review calls and account work; surface the patterns behind recurring failure points rather than isolated scores.

  • Translate QA findings into targeted interventions — a curriculum change, an SOP fix, a coaching plan — with a clear owner and a re-measurement date.

  • Embed a coaching rhythm with frontline managers and hold calibration so a score means the same thing across every reviewer.

    • Team Leadership

  • Lead, coach, and develop a small enablement team of trainers and QA analysts; set priorities, quality standards, and delivery cadence.

  • Hire, onboard, and grow the team as the department scales; run clear performance conversations and development plans.

  • Build an intake and prioritisation model so enablement requests from across the business are assessed, sequenced, and resourced rather than absorbed ad hoc.

    • Measurement & Continuous Improvement

  • Define and report enablement KPIs — time-to-productivity, certification pass rates, QA scores, process adherence, knowledge assessment results, and onboarding completion quality.

  • Use call data, QA trends, CSAT, and frontline feedback to identify capability gaps and prioritise what gets built next.

  • Run post-program reviews on every major initiative: what moved, what did not, what changes next cycle.

  • Present capability insights and recommendations to CS leadership with a clear point of view on where the gaps are.

    • Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Act as a trusted partner to Implementation and CSM leadership on process design, 

  • capability planning, and team development.

  • Work with Support, Product, and Ops to close the loop between what customers struggle with and what the team is trained and equipped to do.

  • Carry the voice of the frontline into process and tooling decisions.

• 7+ years in enablement, training, learning & development, or process/quality roles supporting customer-facing teams in SaaS or high-growth environments.

  • 3+ years leading a small team, or leading enablement programs with formal responsibility for trainers, QA analysts, or program owners.

  • Demonstrable, hands-on experience setting up process from scratch — you can walk us through an SOP library, onboarding program, or QA framework you personally designed and shipped, and what changed as a result.

  • Deep practical knowledge of training frameworks and instructional design — competency mapping, learning objectives, blended learning, assessment design, certification, and reinforcement.

  • Strong facilitation skills; comfortable leading live training, workshops, and role-play for both new hires and experienced advisors.

  • Experience building and running a QA or call-quality program, including scorecard design and calibration.

  • Working understanding of the customer onboarding and customer success lifecycle — implementation, adoption, and long-term account ownership.

  • Analytical approach: you define what good looks like, measure it, and adjust based on evidence rather than opinion.

  • Strong documentation and writing skills; your process docs are usable by someone on day three.

  • Comfort with LMS/enablement platforms, knowledge bases, call recording and QA tooling, and CRM workflows.

  • Technically curious and product-fluent — able to learn a deep, fast-moving platform and teach it credibly.

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.

    • Nice to Have

  • Certification in instructional design, adult learning, facilitation, or quality methodology.

  • Experience enabling teams across multiple geographies and shift patterns.

  • Background in a marketing agency, martech, or SMB-focused SaaS environment.

  • Hands-on experience with HighLevel or comparable all-in-one marketing automation platforms.

Who You Are: 
You are a player-coach with genuine analytical depth and a builder's instinct. You do not wait to be asked — you surface what matters before it becomes urgent and bring recommendations, not just observations. You are comfortable walking into a room of experienced GTM leaders and challenging their thinking with data. You see broken workflows as problems to fix, not facts of life, and you have the operational credibility to implement the fix yourself. You thrive on unstructured problems and ambiguity is your baseline, not your blocker. 
What You’ll Be Doing: 
Strategic GTM Partnership
Work directly with Leadership across the Affiliates org — owning the RevOps narrative in every strategic conversation
Run weekly business reviews — own the narrative, surface the gaps, and bring action-oriented recommendations, not just summaries
Proactively surface insights Affiliates leadership is not yet asking for — conversion trends, cohort gaps, activation bottlenecks — before they become visible problems
Prepare and present monthly and quarterly performance reviews combining operational metrics, trend analysis, and forward-looking recommendations  
Planning, Forecasting & Analytics
Own the bottoms-up annual operating plan for the Affiliates org — team composition, quota design, capacity modeling, and hiring plans
Drive the weekly bottoms-up forecast — collecting inputs, validating assumptions, and feeding consolidated outputs into the GTM-wide forecasting model
Track actuals against plan weekly — identify deviations early, diagnose root causes, and bring corrective recommendations before gaps compound
Build and own the core analytics framework: affiliate performance cohorts, LTV by affiliate segment, activation rate analysis, expansion triggers, and dormancy signals
Model the impact of proposed changes before they go live — new incentive structures, new activation playbooks, new affiliate tiers 
 
Endorsed Affiliates Program — Ownership & Operations
Own end-to-end operational tracking of all Endorsed Affiliate agreements — milestone tracking, performance against contracted targets, and payout schedules
Build a centralized tracking system — moving from manual spreadsheets to a structured, automated operational model with real-time visibility
Track payout calculations and coordinate with Finance for approval and disbursement
Own the ROI framework — measuring actual return per endorsed partner and surfacing data-driven recommendations on where to invest, renew, or exit
Identify operational gaps and fix them through process design and automation
Produce regular reporting on program performance, payout status, and ROI for leadership 
Cultivate a high-performing RevOps analyst cohort, fostering a culture of extreme ownership and strategic foresight 
Process Design, Tech Stack & Team Leadership
Map, document, and own every key process across Land, Activate, and Expand — from onboarding workflows to expansion triggers
Conduct regular process audits — identify broken, redundant, or manually intensive workflows and fix them
Own the GTM tech stack for the Affiliates organization end-to-end — including affiliate tracking infrastructure and Endorsed Affiliates Program systems
Manage and develop a small team of analysts — set clear expectations, coach toward proactive instinct, and create a culture of ownership
What You’ll Bring:
Analytically sharp — comfortable building forecasting models, cohort analyses, and ROI frameworks from scratch
Systems and process oriented — you have opinions about how things should work and the ability to implement them
Player-coach mentality — comfortable executing directly while managing and developing a small team
Strong communicator across levels — managers, directors, and senior directors simultaneously
Experience owning a high-value partnership or contract program — tracking milestones, managing payouts, building ROI frameworks
Proven track record in high-growth SaaS where operational processes were being built in real time
Experience/Education/Certifications Required:
5–8 years in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, Partner Operations, or a closely adjacent GTM analytics function
Experience supporting or operating within a partner, affiliate, or channel ecosystem — strongly preferred
Background in high-growth SaaS where operational processes were being built, not just maintained
No specific certification required — analytical depth and track record of impact are the bar

About us
HighLevel is an AI-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate and scale. Today, HighLevel supports SMBs across 150+ countries, fueling community-driven growth rooted in real customer outcomes.
To date, businesses operating on HighLevel have generated over $7 billion in ecosystem value, demonstrating the impact of shared infrastructure at scale. By centralizing conversations, automation and intelligence into one system, we help businesses move faster, reduce complexity and execute efficiently. Behind the platform, HighLevel powers more than 4 billion API hits and 2.5 billion message events daily. With 250 terabytes of distributed data, 250+ microservices and over 1 million domain names supported, our architecture is built for performance, resilience and long-term scalability.
Our people
With over 2,000 team members across 10+ countries, HighLevel operates as a global, remote-first organization built for speed and ownership. We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home.
Our impact
Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1.5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact.
We’re proud to be a part of that.Learn more about us on ourYouTube Channel orBlog PostsRole Overview
For most SMBs, a customer conversation is not merely a support interaction. It is where a lead is qualified, an appointment is booked, a customer question is resolved, a sale is advanced, or a relationship is lost. Businesses receive these conversations across SMS, email, WhatsApp, Facebook, Instagram, live chat, and other messaging channels. Customers expect immediate, accurate, and context-aware responses — but most SMB teams cannot monitor every channel around the clock. HighLevel's Conversation AI product is designed to close that gap.
Conversation AI enables businesses to deploy AI agents that can answer questions, nurture and qualify leads, collect structured information, book and manage appointments, trigger workflows, follow up with inactive contacts, route conversations between specialised agents, and hand interactions to humans when appropriate. The product supports multiple ways of building agents — from guided forms and configurable prompts to visual conversation flows and AI-assisted agent creation. It also includes knowledge retrieval, multi-channel deployment, agent actions, routing, testing, analytics, logs, permissions, reusable snapshots, and APIs for deployment at agency scale.
We are hiring a Principal Product Manager to define the next generation of this platform. This person will own the long-term product strategy for Conversation AI and establish the architecture, product principles, quality systems, operating metrics, and commercial model required to make AI agents dependable across millions of real customer interactions.
This is not a chatbot feature-management role. It is a senior individual-contributor product leadership role at the intersection of AI agents, CRM, messaging infrastructure, workflow automation, knowledge retrieval, appointment scheduling, analytics, developer platforms, and agency-led distribution. You will be expected to influence multiple product and engineering teams, make difficult platform-level trade-offs, and turn Conversation AI into one of the most valuable and trusted products in the HighLevel ecosystem.

Key Responsibilities
●  Define and drive the long-term product vision, strategy, roadmap, and product architecture for HighLevel Conversation AI.
●  Own the complete Conversation AI system, including agent creation, prompts, knowledge, actions, visual flows, channel deployment, routing, testing, monitoring, permissions, templates, APIs, and lifecycle management.
●  Establish the product principles that determine when Conversation AI should answer, ask a clarifying question, take an action, transfer to another agent, follow up later, or hand the conversation to a human.
●  Develop a deep understanding of agencies, SMBs, multi-location businesses, and conversation-heavy industries such as home services, legal, dental, medical and wellness, real estate, insurance, automotive, fitness, and professional services.
●  Spend significant time reviewing real customer conversations, AI failures, support tickets, agent configurations, implementation challenges, and measurable customer outcomes.
●  Translate ambiguous customer and platform problems into clear strategic choices, product requirements, decision documents, system models, phased roadmaps, and measurable success criteria.
●  Partner closely with Engineering and AI leadership on LLM orchestration, model selection, context management, tool invocation, retrieval, re-ranking, latency, caching, reliability, evaluation, observability, data architecture, and cost.
●  Build a scalable evaluation framework covering grounded accuracy, action accuracy, instruction adherence, safety, escalation quality, conversation quality, and business outcomes.
●  Define testing and release standards for changes to models, prompts, retrieval systems, agent tools, routing logic, and conversation behaviour.
●  Partner with Design to simplify the entire agent lifecycle — discovery, creation, configuration, training, testing, deployment, debugging, optimisation, and reuse.
●  Create a coherent product experience across guided forms, prompt-based agents, flow-based agents, templates, snapshots, and Ask AI-assisted creation.
●  Improve integrations between Conversation AI and Contacts, Conversations, Calendars, Workflows, Opportunities, Payments, Knowledge Base, Custom Fields, Custom Objects, and Reporting.
●  Define the platform model for multiple agents, channel assignments, routing priorities, bot transfers, context preservation, and human handovers.
●  Develop robust observability and debugging experiences that show conversation context, model responses, retrieved knowledge, tool calls, action inputs and outputs, latency, errors, and execution timelines.
●  Define instrumentation across the complete product funnel, including agent creation, training, testing, deployment, first successful conversation, first successful action, ongoing usage, customer outcomes, retention, and expansion.
●  Own product decisions involving privacy, data retention, access controls, consent, opt-outs, sensitive information, channel policies, model behaviour, and abuse prevention.
●  Partner with Product Marketing on positioning, packaging, use cases, competitive differentiation, launch strategy, customer education, and agency enablement.
●  Partner with Support, Implementation, Trial Experience, Account Management, and Affiliates to reduce setup friction, improve customer outcomes, lower support burden, and make Conversation AI easier to sell and implement.
●  Partner with Finance and Revenue Experience on subscription plans, usage-based pricing, agency rebilling, AI costs, gross-margin targets, and commercially sustainable product limits.
●  Influence product strategy across the broader AI Employee organisation, ensuring that Conversation AI works coherently with Voice AI, Ask AI, Knowledge Base, Agent Studio, Workflow AI, Reviews AI, and future AI products.
●  Act as a senior product thought partner to Product, Engineering, Design, Data, GTM, and executive leadership.
●  Mentor PMs and raise the quality of product thinking, AI evaluation, strategy, and decision-making across the organisation without relying on formal authority.

Ideal Candidate Profile
●  12+ years of product management experience owning complex B2B SaaS, AI-agent, communications, CRM, workflow-automation, customer-support, or platform products. Scope and demonstrated outcomes matter more than a precise number of years.
●  Prior experience operating as a Principal PM, Staff PM, Lead PM, product founder, or equivalent senior individual contributor responsible for a business-critical product or platform.
●  Evidence of defining product strategy across multiple teams and delivering sustained business outcomes - not only shipping individual features.
●  Strong understanding of AI-agent product design, including the difference between language generation and dependable execution of business tasks.
●  Experience working with one or more of the following:
○  Conversational AI
○  AI agents and tool use
○  Customer-service automation
○  CRM and customer communications
○  Workflow or journey automation
○  Knowledge retrieval and RAG

Our people

With over 2,000 team members across 10+ countries, HighLevel operates as a global, remote-first organization built for speed and ownership. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home.


Our impact

Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1.5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact.

Role Overview

For most SMBs, a customer conversation is not merely a support interaction. It is where a lead is qualified, an appointment is booked, a customer question is resolved, a sale is advanced, or a relationship is lost. Businesses receive these conversations across SMS, email, WhatsApp, Facebook, Instagram, live chat, and other messaging channels. Customers expect immediate, accurate, and context-aware responses — but most SMB teams cannot monitor every channel around the clock. HighLevel's Conversation AI product is designed to close that gap.

Conversation AI enables businesses to deploy AI agents that can answer questions, nurture and qualify leads, collect structured information, book and manage appointments, trigger workflows, follow up with inactive contacts, route conversations between specialised agents, and hand interactions to humans when appropriate. The product supports multiple ways of building agents — from guided forms and configurable prompts to visual conversation flows and AI-assisted agent creation. It also includes knowledge retrieval, multi-channel deployment, agent actions, routing, testing, analytics, logs, permissions, reusable snapshots, and APIs for deployment at agency scale.

This person will own the long-term product strategy for Conversation AI and establish the architecture, product principles, quality systems, operating metrics, and commercial model required to make AI agents dependable across millions of real customer interactions.

This is not a chatbot feature-management role. It is a senior individual-contributor product leadership role at the intersection of AI agents, CRM, messaging infrastructure, workflow automation, knowledge retrieval, appointment scheduling, analytics, developer platforms, and agency-led distribution. About us

HighLevel is an AI-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate and scale. Today, HighLevel supports SMBs across 150+ countries, fueling community-driven growth rooted in real customer outcomes.

To date, businesses operating on HighLevel have generated over $7 billion in ecosystem value, demonstrating the impact of shared infrastructure at scale. By centralizing conversations, automation and intelligence into one system, we help businesses move faster, reduce complexity and execute efficiently. Behind the platform, HighLevel powers more than 4 billion API hits and 2.5 billion message events daily. With 250 terabytes of distributed data, 250+ microservices and over 1 million domain names supported, our architecture is built for performance, resilience and long-term scalability.


Our people

With over 2,000 team members across 10+ countries, HighLevel operates as a global, remote-first organization built for speed and ownership. We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home.


Our impact

Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1.5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact.

We’re proud to be a part of that.Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts

Role Overview

HighLevel is a powerful platform containing hundreds of interconnected capabilities across CRM, marketing, communications, automation, commerce, websites, calendars, reporting, and AI. That breadth creates enormous value - but it also introduces complexity. Users should not need to know which menu contains a capability, how every object in HighLevel is modelled, or which sequence of screens is required to complete a business task. They should be able to describe what they want to accomplish, receive an accurate answer, and safely complete the work.

Ask AI is the natural-language operating layer designed to make that possible. It allows agencies and businesses to ask questions, understand customer and operational data, generate content and assets, create product configurations, invoke specialised agents, execute supported actions, automate recurring work, and interact with HighLevel through text, voice, structured artefacts, and guided workflows.

For Ask AI to be dependable, it needs accurate and current context. HighLevel Knowledge Bases provide the shared intelligence foundation for Ask AI and the broader AI Employee ecosystem. They ingest and organise information from websites, FAQs, rich text, documents, tables, cloud files, and other approved sources so AI products can retrieve relevant information and produce grounded responses.

We are hiring a Principal Product Manager to own the long-term product strategy for this intelligence and assistance platform. This person will define the architecture, product principles, quality systems, developer model, governance, metrics, and commercial strategy required to make Ask AI the default way users understand and operate HighLevel.

This is not a generic chatbot, enterprise-search, or content-generation role. It is a senior individual-contributor product leadership role at the intersection of AI assistants, enterprise knowledge, retrieval systems, agent orchestration, workflow execution, CRM data, permissions, automation, developer platforms, and multi-tenant SaaS. You will influence multiple product and engineering teams, establish shared platform standards, and make foundational decisions that affect every AI product across HighLevel.

Key Responsibilities

●  Define and drive the long-term product vision, strategy, roadmap, and platform architecture for HighLevel Knowledge Bases and Ask AI.

●  Own the complete Ask AI experience, including chat, voice interaction, conversation history, memory, templates, artefacts, scheduled tasks, tools, actions, agent routing, browser interaction, feedback, permissions, approvals, auditability, usage, and lifecycle management.

●  Own the Knowledge Base platform across source ingestion, extraction, parsing, chunking, embeddings, indexing, metadata, retrieval, re-ranking, citations, freshness, versioning, testing, permissions, and observability.

●  Establish the product principles that determine how Ask AI answers questions, requests more information, retrieves knowledge, generates a plan, selects a tool, invokes an agent, asks for approval, executes an action, handles failure, and communicates results.

●  Create a shared context model spanning user identity, agency, location, role, permissions, current interface, business profile, Brand Voice, memory, Knowledge Bases, CRM data, product configuration, and previous tool outputs.

●  Develop a deep understanding of agency owners, marketers, sales teams, customer-service teams, operations leaders, administrators, and SMB employees who use HighLevel to perform daily work.

●  Personally inspect Ask AI conversations, tool traces, Knowledge Base retrieval results, user feedback, support tickets, source-ingestion failures, incorrect answers, failed actions, and downstream customer outcomes.

●  Partner closely with AI and engineering leadership on LLM orchestration, model routing, context management, prompt systems, tool invocation, agent planning, memory, retrieval-augmented generation, embeddings, hybrid search, re-ranking, caching, latency, evaluation, observability, and cost.

●  Partner with platform and infrastructure teams on ingestion pipelines, crawlers, document processing, vector storage, structured-data retrieval, indexing, refresh jobs, multi-tenant isolation, scalability, reliability, and data retention.

●  Define an evaluation architecture covering Ask AI responses, Knowledge Base retrieval, memory usage, tool selection, action accuracy, permissions, artefacts, latency, and cost.

●  Build representative test datasets from real agency and SMB use cases across industries, account types, languages, data structures, and product workflows.

●  Partner with HighLevel product teams to expose their capabilities safely through Ask AI using shared action, permission, approval, error, and result contracts.

●  Establish a scalable onboarding model for product teams that want to contribute Ask AI actions, templates, skills, artefacts, or specialised agents.

●  Advance integration between Ask AI and Agent Studio so custom agents can be discovered, selected, invoked, monitored, and improved from a unified Ask AI experience.

●  Define the platform model for MCP tools, native product actions, external APIs, web search, browser execution, Knowledge Base retrieval, and other agent capabilities.

●  Build robust observability and debugging experiences that show selected context, retrieved sources, model outputs, plans, tools, inputs, permissions, approvals, action results, errors, latency, and usage.

●  Improve Knowledge Base quality-management workflows, including retrieval testing, source inspection, stale-content detection, crawl diagnostics, document-processing errors, conflict detection, and customer-facing recommendations.

●  Define the architecture for reusable, inherited, bundled, and marketplace-distributed Knowledge Bases across agencies and locations.

●  Partner with Design to simplify Knowledge Base creation, source addition, testing, maintenance, agent attachment, Ask AI onboarding, template discovery, approval flows, artefact interaction, and error recovery.

●  Develop a coherent experience across Ask AI templates, open-ended prompting, guided questions, native skills, specialised agents, and scheduled tasks.

●  Define instrumentation across the full funnel, including Ask AI discovery, first prompt, first useful response, first successful action, repeat usage, template completion, scheduled-task retention, Knowledge Base creation, source ingestion, retrieval tests, agent attachment, and sustained production usage.

●  Define quality and outcome metrics by request type rather than treating every Ask AI interaction as equivalent.

●  Partner with Security, Legal, Privacy, and Trust teams on data isolation, access control, memory, browser automation, sensitive data, source permissions, content retention, external-model processing, audit logs, and abuse prevention.

●  Establish standards for destructive actions, bulk changes, financial operations, external communication, and compliance-sensitive workflows.

●  Partner with Product Marketing on positioning, use-case packaging, customer education, competitive differentiation, launches, templates, and agency enablement.

●  Partner with Support, Implementation, Trial Experience, Account Management, Affiliates, and internal operations teams to reduce setup friction, improve outcomes, and lower support burden.

●  Partner with Finance and Revenue Experience on packaging, pay-per-use pricing, AI Employee plans, agency rebilling, cost controls, gross margin, and commercial limits.

●  Develop a clear competitive understanding of AI copilots, enterprise search, AI workspaces, CRM assistants, agent platforms, browser agents, knowledge-management products, and workflow-automation tools.

●  Evaluate external model providers, search and retrieval technologies, document-processing systems, vector databases, re-ranking systems, browser technologies, and strategic partnerships.

●  Influence strategy across Conversation AI, Voice AI, Agent Studio, Workflow AI, CRM, automation, communications, commerce, and the broader HighLevel platform.

●  Act as a senior product thought partner to Product, Engineering, Design, Data, Security, GTM, Finance, and executive leadership.

○  Metadata filtering and query rewriting

○  Re-ranking and source attribution

○  Structured-data retrieval

○  Knowledge freshness and lifecycle management

○  LLM orchestration, tool and function calling, agent routing

○  Context management and memory systems

○  Evaluation and observability

○  APIs and webhooks

●  Strong systems thinking — able to connect identity, permissions, agency and location context, CRM data, Knowledge Bases, memory, tools, workflows, billing, and reporting into a coherent platform.

●  Experience designing products where AI can change business data or execute consequential actions.

●  Strong instincts around permissions, approvals, auditability, reversibility, sensitive information, and customer trust.

●  Experience simplifying technically sophisticated systems for non-technical users.

●  Experience with multi-tenant SaaS and the operational needs of agencies, resellers, franchises, enterprises, or multi-location businesses.

●  Strong customer instincts and willingness to personally inspect retrieval outputs, AI conversations, tool traces, failures, support issues, and user configurations.

●  Strong analytical capability — able to separate model failures, retrieval failures, tool failures, UX problems, and expectation mismatches.

●  Commercial judgment across activation, retention, packaging, usage-based pricing, infrastructure cost, AI cost, gross margin, and ecosystem economics.

●  Ability to influence multiple senior teams without relying on direct reporting authority.

●  Excellent written communication — able to produce clear strategy documents, platform contracts, architectural decisions, evaluation plans, product requirements, executive updates, and launch narratives.

●  High ownership, intellectual honesty, and execution velocity in a remote-first, high-context environment.

●  Comfortable making difficult prioritisation decisions across answer quality, action coverage, customer experience, platform extensibility, privacy, reliability, technical debt, revenue, and cost.


Bonus Points For

About us
HighLevel is an AI-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate and scale. Today, HighLevel supports SMBs across 150+ countries, fueling community-driven growth rooted in real customer outcomes.To date, businesses operating on HighLevel have generated over $7 billion in ecosystem value, demonstrating the impact of shared infrastructure at scale. By centralizing conversations, automation and intelligence into one system, we help businesses move faster, reduce complexity and execute efficiently. Behind the platform, HighLevel powers more than 4 billion API hits and 2.5 billion message events daily. With 250 terabytes of distributed data, 250+ microservices and over 1 million domain names supported, our architecture is built for performance, resilience and long-term scalability.

Our people
With over 2,000 team members across 10+ countries, HighLevel operates as a global, remote-first organization built for speed and ownership. We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home.

Our impact
Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1.5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact.
We’re proud to be a part of that.Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts
 
Role Overview
For most SMBs, the phone remains one of the highest-intent customer channels. A call may represent a new lead, an urgent service request, a customer trying to book an appointment, a patient looking for help, a buyer asking a final question, or an existing customer who needs immediate support. When the call goes unanswered, the opportunity is often lost.
Most SMBs cannot staff every phone line, department, location, and language around the clock. Traditional IVRs frustrate callers, outsourced answering services lack business context, and human teams spend significant time handling repetitive conversations. HighLevel's Voice AI product is designed to change that.
Voice AI enables businesses to deploy intelligent phone agents that can answer inbound calls, initiate outbound calls, understand caller intent, hold natural conversations, answer questions from business knowledge, qualify leads, collect structured information, book appointments, trigger workflows, interact with external systems, route callers between specialised AI agents, transfer calls to humans, and complete follow-up actions.
We are hiring a Principal Product Manager to define and lead the next generation of this platform. This person will own the long-term product strategy, architecture, quality bar, evaluation system, commercial model, and operating metrics required to make Voice AI dependable across millions of real-world phone conversations.
This is not a prompt-management or chatbot-feature role. It is a senior individual-contributor product leadership role requiring deep systems thinking across AI, voice, telephony, automation, CRM, reliability, compliance, and business outcomes. You will influence multiple product and engineering teams, make platform-level trade-offs, and establish Voice AI as one of the most trusted and commercially important products in the HighLevel ecosystem.
Key Responsibilities
●  Define and drive the long-term vision, strategy, roadmap, and platform architecture for HighLevel Voice AI.
●  Own the complete Voice AI lifecycle, including agent creation, prompts, system instructions, voice and model selection, knowledge, actions, testing, deployment, phone routing, inbound and outbound calling, transfers, analytics, permissions, APIs, billing, and optimisation.
●  Establish the product principles that determine when a Voice AI agent should answer, ask a clarifying question, retrieve knowledge, take an action, transfer to another agent, transfer to a human, schedule follow-up, or end the call.
●  Develop a deep understanding of agencies, SMBs, franchises, multi-location businesses, and call-intensive industries such as home services, healthcare and wellness, legal, real estate, automotive, insurance, financial services, fitness, hospitality, and professional services.
●  Personally review real call recordings, transcripts, latency traces, action logs, failed calls, support tickets, customer configurations, implementation challenges, and measurable business outcomes.
●  Translate ambiguous customer and platform problems into strategic choices, product requirements, system models, phased roadmaps, quality standards, and measurable success criteria.
●  Partner closely with engineering and AI leadership on streaming architecture, speech-to-text, text-to-speech, voice activity detection, turn detection, interruption handling, LLM orchestration, tool invocation, context management, retrieval, caching, latency, reliability, model selection, and cost.
●  Partner closely with Phone System and infrastructure teams on call routing, number provisioning, carrier integrations, Twilio and LC Phone behaviour, recording, transfers, forwarding, voicemail, call status, and telephony failure modes.
●  Establish a scalable evaluation and release framework for model, prompt, voice, retrieval, action, routing, and infrastructure changes.
●  Define production service expectations across call-answer rates, connection success, response latency, audio quality, uptime, action reliability, transfer reliability, and graceful degradation.
●  Partner with Design to simplify agent creation, voice selection, prompt configuration, testing, deployment, debugging, analytics, optimisation, and reuse.
●  Make Prompt Evaluator, Edit with AI, Prompt Optimiser, Web Call testing, phone testing, and production logs part of a coherent agent-quality workflow.
●  Improve integrations between Voice AI and Contacts, Conversations, Calendars, Workflows, Opportunities, Knowledge Base, Payments, Custom Fields, Custom Objects, Phone System, and Reporting.
●  Define the architecture and customer experience for multi-agent transfers, human transfers, context handoffs, specialist reuse, fallback behaviour, and merged post-call outputs.
●  Develop observability and debugging experiences that expose call state, latency, transcripts, retrieved knowledge, model behaviour, tool calls, parameter extraction, action responses, transfers, carrier errors, and execution timelines.
●  Define instrumentation across the full funnel, including agent creation, configuration completion, first test, first successful test, number assignment, first live call, first successful action, sustained usage, business outcomes, retention, and expansion.
●  Define operational metrics for inbound and outbound Voice AI, distinguishing between dialling, connection, conversation, qualification, execution, transfer, and business-outcome success.
●  Partner with Legal, Compliance, Trust, and Security on consent, disclosures, voice cloning, recording, data processing, retention, outbound calling, sensitive information, fraud, abuse, and platform safeguards.
●  Partner with Product Marketing on positioning, use cases, competitive differentiation, customer education, vertical templates, launches, and agency enablement.
●  Partner with Support, Implementation, Account Management, Trial Experience, Affiliates, and agency-facing teams to reduce setup friction, improve deployment quality, and lower support burden.
●  Partner with Finance and Revenue Experience on pricing, included usage, overages, agency rebilling, model costs, telephony costs, gross margin, budget protection, and sustainable commercial limits.
●  Drive strategy across the broader AI Employee portfolio so Voice AI works coherently with Conversation AI, Knowledge Base, Agent Studio, Ask AI, Workflows, Calendars, and future AI-agent capabilities.
●  Evaluate external models, voice providers, telephony vendors, infrastructure components, and potential strategic partnerships.
●  Act as a senior product thought partner to Product, Engineering, Design, Data, GTM, Finance, Legal, and executive leadership.
●  Mentor PMs and raise the quality of product strategy, AI evaluation, systems thinking, and decision-making across the organisation without relying on formal authority.
Ideal Candidate Profile
●  12+ years of product management experience owning complex B2B SaaS, Voice AI, conversational AI, communications, contact-centre, telephony, CRM, workflow-automation, or AI-agent products. Scope and demonstrated outcomes matter more than a precise number of years.
●  Prior experience operating as a Principal PM, Staff PM, Lead PM, product founder, or equivalent senior individual contributor responsible for a business-critical product or platform.
●  Evidence of defining strategy across multiple teams and delivering sustained customer and commercial outcomes — not only shipping individual features.
●  Experience building or operating production AI-agent systems that interact with real customers and take actions inside business workflows.
●  Strong understanding of the difference between an impressive voice demonstration and a reliable production calling product.
●  Technical fluency across several of the following:
○  Speech-to-text and automatic speech recognition
○  Text-to-speech and voice models
○  Streaming audio
○  Voice activity and end-of-turn detection
○  Barge-in and interruption handling
○  Noise and echo cancellation
○  LLM orchestration and function calling
○  Context management and RAG/knowledge retrieval
○  APIs and webhooks
○  Telephony, PSTN, SIP, or carrier infrastructure
○  Latency, reliability, observability, and cost
●  Strong judgment around AI evaluation — able to define how voice agents should be tested, scored, monitored, debugged, and improved in production.
●  Strong systems thinking — able to connect phone infrastructure, AI models, voices, prompts, CRM data, calendars, workflows, actions, permissions, reporting, compliance, and billing into a coherent product.
●  Experience simplifying technically sophisticated systems for non-technical customers.
●  Experience working with multi-tenant SaaS and the operational requirements of agencies, franchises, resellers, or multi-location businesses.
●  Strong customer instincts and willingness to inspect recordings, transcripts, traces, failed calls, implementation issues, and support data personally.
●  Commercial judgment across activation, retention, packaging, usage-based pricing, provider cost, telephony cost, gross margin, and partner economics.
●  Ability to make difficult trade-offs between caller experience, latency, accuracy, reliability, extensibility, compliance, and cost.
●  Ability to influence senior stakeholders and multiple teams without relying on direct reporting authority.
●  Excellent written communication — able to produce clear strategy documents, product requirements, system models, evaluation plans, architectural decisions, executive updates, and launch narratives.
●  High ownership, intellectual honesty, and execution velocity in a remote-first, high-context environment.
Bonus Points For
●  Experience building production voice agents, contact-centre AI, automated receptionists, sales dialers, or customer-service voice automation.
●  Experience with voice and AI platforms such as Twilio, ElevenLabs, Cartesia, Deepgram, Google, OpenAI, Anthropic, Amazon Connect, Genesys, Five9, Dialpad, RingCentral, or similar technologies.
●  Experience with PSTN, SIP, WebRTC, IVR, call routing, caller identification, number provisioning, recording, voicemail detection, and carrier failure modes.
●  Experience building real-time systems with strict latency and availability requirements.
●  Experience designing agent tools, function calling, MCP integrations, workflow actions, or external API execution.
●  Experience building automated evaluation systems using scenario generation, synthetic callers, human review, production telemetry, transcripts, recordings, and business-outcome data.
●  Experience with appointment scheduling, lead qualification, customer support, call routing, outbound campaigns, or service-dispatch products.
●  Experience supporting multilingual speech recognition and synthesis, accents, localisation, translation, pronunciation, or voice cloning.
●  Experience with consent, AI disclosure, call recording, opt-out management, outbound-contact rules, trust and safety, or communications-platform abuse prevention.
●  Experience building APIs, webhooks, developer platforms, reusable templates, marketplaces, or partner ecosystems.
●  Experience building products for agencies, SMBs, franchises, local businesses, or multi-location operators.
●  Experience with AI usage-based pricing, per-minute communication pricing, provider routing, model cost management, gross-margin optimisation, rebilling, or fair-use controls.
●  Familiarity with metrics such as call answer rate, connection rate, time to first response, end-of-turn latency, barge-in success, speech-recognition accuracy, call completion rate, containment rate, transfer success rate, action success rate, appointment-booking conversion, caller sentiment, opt-out and complaint rate, P95/P99 latency, cost per call, cost per successful outcome, retention, and support-ticket rate.
Why Join HighLevel?
At HighLevel, we foster an exciting and dynamic work environment driven by a passionate team. We believe in a collective responsibility where no task is considered someone else's job. Our unwavering focus is on providing value to our users, and we achieve this by delivering solutions swiftly through lean principles, allowing us to bring products to market in weeks rather than quarters.
Every good idea is put to the test, ensuring that we maintain a high standard of innovation. We prioritise the well-being of our team, recognising that by taking care of them, they can better serve our users. We embrace the concept of continuous and iterative improvement, understanding that progress is an ongoing journey. We are also a well-funded and profitable company.
Join us at HighLevel, and you will have the opportunity to learn the intricacies of scaling a B2B SaaS startup and develop impactful products that cater to the needs of our customers.

About Us
HighLevel is an AI powered, all-in-one white-label sales & marketing platform that empowers agencies, entrepreneurs, and businesses to elevate their digital presence and drive growth. We are proud to support a global and growing community of over 2 million businesses, comprised of agencies, consultants, and businesses of all sizes and industries. HighLevel empowers users  with all the tools needed to capture, nurture, and close new leads into repeat customers. As of mid 2025, HighLevel processes over 4 billion API hits and handles more than 2.5 billion message events every day. Our platform manages over 250 terabytes of data distributed across five databases, operates with a network of over 250 microservices, and supports over 1 million hostnames.
Our People
With over 1,500 team members across 15+ countries, we operate in a global, remote-first environment. We are building more than software; we are building a global community rooted in creativity, collaboration, and impact. We take pride in cultivating a culture where innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated, and people come first, no matter where they call home.
Our Impact
As of mid 2026, our platform powers over 1.5 billion messages, helps generate over 200 million leads, and facilitates over 20 million conversations for the more than 2 million businesses we serve each month. Behind those numbers are real people growing their companies, connecting with customers, and making their mark - and we get to help make that happen.
 
About the Role
The Payments Platform team at HighLevel builds and scales the payment orchestration layer that powers every transaction across our ecosystem from invoices and subscriptions to point-of-sale and mobile checkout. The orchestration platform is the engine that routes payments across providers, processes transactions, generates receipts, and ingests webhook events at scale, making it one of the most business-critical systems we run. This role is a rare opportunity to own core payments infrastructure that hundreds of thousands of businesses depend on every day.
We are seeking a Product Manager II, Payment Orchestration, who will own the roadmap and execution for HighLevel’s orchestration platform spanning the orchestrator, transaction lifecycle, receipts, and webhook ingress. You will be responsible for the reliability, breadth, and developer experience of the platform that every payment surface at HighLevel is built on top of.
The ideal candidate combines product judgment with technical fluency, comfortable reasoning about payment routing, PSP integrations, idempotency, and event delivery, while keeping adoption, transaction success, and customer trust at the center of every decision. This is a role for someone who wants to go deep on payments infrastructure and translate that depth into measurable product outcomes.
Your mission: To build a reliable, extensible, and provider-agnostic payment orchestration platform that maximizes transaction success and powers fast, secure, and seamless payment experiences across HighLevel’s global customer base.
 
What You’ll Do
Own the Orchestration Roadmap & Execution – Define and deliver the roadmap for the payment orchestration platform, spanning the orchestrator, transaction lifecycle, receipts, and webhook ingress, with a strong focus on reliability, coverage, and transaction success.
Drive Payment Routing & Provider Strategy – Improve authorization rates and cost efficiency through smart routing, provider selection, retries, and failover across multiple PSPs and gateways.
Own the Transaction Lifecycle – Lead the end-to-end handling of authorizations, captures, refunds, voids, and disputes, ensuring correctness, idempotency, and state integrity at scale.
Deliver Reliable Webhook Ingress – Build robust inbound webhook processing that normalizes, deduplicates, and reliably fans out provider events to downstream services with strong delivery guarantees.
Ship Trustworthy Receipts & Records – Own accurate, well-formatted receipts and transaction records that give customers and their end users clear, trustworthy proof of every payment.
Elevate Platform APIs & Developer Experience – Partner with engineering to design clean, well-documented payment APIs and events that internal teams and product surfaces can build on with confidence.
Champion Reliability & Observability – Treat uptime, latency, and error rates as first-class product metrics, driving instrumentation, alerting, and reconciliation to keep the platform accurate and dependable.
Ensure Scale, Security & Compliance – Own PCI, risk, and data-integrity considerations, ensuring the platform stays secure, scalable, and compliant as volume grows.
Collaborate Cross-Functionally – Work closely with engineering, design, data, risk, support, and partner-facing teams to align the platform with the needs of every payment surface it powers.
Leverage Payments Data for Decisions – Use metrics such as authorization rates, transaction success, failure reasons, latency, and reconciliation gaps to prioritize the roadmap and measure impact.
Own Outcomes, Not Just Features – Deliver measurable improvements in transaction success, platform reliability, and provider coverage, and in the experience of the teams building on the platform.

Who You Are
Payments & Platform Experience – You have built and shipped features within a payments, fintech, or platform/infrastructure ecosystem, delivering secure, reliable systems that operate at scale.
Technically Fluent – You can hold your own with engineers on APIs, webhooks, idempotency, routing logic, and failure modes, and you use that fluency to make sharper product decisions.
Reliability-Minded – You care deeply about correctness, uptime, and edge cases, and you design for the failure paths - retries, timeouts, duplicates, and reconciliation, not just the happy path.
Customer- & Developer-Centric – You balance business goals, risk, and trust, keeping the needs of both end customers and the internal teams who build on your platform at the center of your decisions.
Strategic and Execution-Focused – You can shape a clear roadmap for your area while staying deeply involved in execution to ensure ideas translate into shipped, measurable impact.
Highly Data-Driven in Ambiguity – You are comfortable working with messy, incomplete data - transaction logs, failure reasons, and provider quirks - to find patterns and derive actionable insights.

What You’ll Bring
4+ years of Product Management experience, with a focus on payments, fintech, platform, or API/infrastructure products, 
A track record of shipping impactful platform or infrastructure features that improved reliability, coverage, or transaction success in a high-scale environment.
A working understanding of payment systems PSP/gateway integrations, the authorization-to-settlement lifecycle, webhooks, idempotency, and reconciliation.
Strong technical fluency, with the ability to partner closely with engineering on API design, event models, and system trade-offs.
Familiarity with SaaS and platform growth levers, including adoption of internal platforms, developer experience, and reliability as a driver of customer trust.
Bonus:
You have worked on a payments or fintech platform processing significant transaction volume across multiple providers, and can clearly articulate your impact on reliability, authorization rates, and customer trust.

Why should you join us?
At HighLevel, we foster an exciting and dynamic work environment driven by a passionate team. We believe in a collective responsibility where no task is considered someone else's job. Our unwavering focus is on providing value to our users, and we achieve this by delivering solutions swiftly through lean principles, allowing us to bring products to market in a matter of weeks rather than quarters. Every good idea is put to the test, ensuring that we maintain a high standard of innovation. We prioritise the well-being of our team, recognizing that by taking care of them, they can better serve our users. We embrace the concept of continuous and iterative improvement, understanding that progress is an ongoing journey. We are also a well funded & profitable company. 
Join us at High Level, and you will have the opportunity to learn the intricacies of scaling a B2B SaaS startup and develop impactful products that cater to the needs of our customers.

data.descriptionBody:
About Us

HighLevel is an AI powered, all-in-one white-label sales & marketing platform that empowers agencies, entrepreneurs, and businesses to elevate their digital presence and drive growth. We are proud to support a global and growing community of over 2 million businesses, comprised of agencies, consultants, and businesses of all sizes and industries. HighLevel empowers users  with all the tools needed to capture, nurture, and close new leads into repeat customers. As of mid 2025, HighLevel processes over 4 billion API hits and handles more than 2.5 billion message events every day. Our platform manages over 250 terabytes of data distributed across five databases, operates with a network of over 250 microservices, and supports over 1 million hostnames.

Our People

With over 1,500 team members across 15+ countries, we operate in a global, remote-first environment. We are building more than software; we are building a global community rooted in creativity, collaboration, and impact. We take pride in cultivating a culture where innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated, and people come first, no matter where they call home.

Our Impact

As of mid 2026, our platform powers over 1.5 billion messages, helps generate over 200 million leads, and facilitates over 20 million conversations for the more than 2 million businesses we serve each month. Behind those numbers are real people growing their companies, connecting with customers, and making their mark - and we get to help make that happen.

 

About the Role

The Payments Platform team at HighLevel builds and scales the payment orchestration layer that powers every transaction across our ecosystem from invoices and subscriptions to point-of-sale and mobile checkout. The orchestration platform is the engine that routes payments across providers, processes transactions, generates receipts, and ingests webhook events at scale, making it one of the most business-critical systems we run. This role is a rare opportunity to own core payments infrastructure that hundreds of thousands of businesses depend on every day.

We are seeking a Product Manager II, Payment Orchestration, who will own the roadmap and execution for HighLevel’s orchestration platform spanning the orchestrator, transaction lifecycle, receipts, and webhook ingress. You will be responsible for the reliability, breadth, and developer experience of the platform that every payment surface at HighLevel is built on top of.

The ideal candidate combines product judgment with technical fluency, comfortable reasoning about payment routing, PSP integrations, idempotency, and event delivery, while keeping adoption, transaction success, and customer trust at the center of every decision. This is a role for someone who wants to go deep on payments infrastructure and translate that depth into measurable product outcomes.

Your mission: To build a reliable, extensible, and provider-agnostic payment orchestration platform that maximizes transaction success and powers fast, secure, and seamless payment experiences across HighLevel’s global customer base.

 

What You’ll Do

Own the Orchestration Roadmap & Execution – Define and deliver the roadmap for the payment orchestration platform, spanning the orchestrator, transaction lifecycle, receipts, and webhook ingress, with a strong focus on reliability, coverage, and transaction success.

Drive Payment Routing & Provider Strategy – Improve authorization rates and cost efficiency through smart routing, provider selection, retries, and failover across multiple PSPs and gateways.

Own the Transaction Lifecycle – Lead the end-to-end handling of authorizations, captures, refunds, voids, and disputes, ensuring correctness, idempotency, and state integrity at scale.

Deliver Reliable Webhook Ingress – Build robust inbound webhook processing that normalizes, deduplicates, and reliably fans out provider events to downstream services with strong delivery guarantees.

Ship Trustworthy Receipts & Records – Own accurate, well-formatted receipts and transaction records that give customers and their end users clear, trustworthy proof of every payment.

Elevate Platform APIs & Developer Experience – Partner with engineering to design clean, well-documented payment APIs and events that internal teams and product surfaces can build on with confidence.

Champion Reliability & Observability – Treat uptime, latency, and error rates as first-class product metrics, driving instrumentation, alerting, and reconciliation to keep the platform accurate and dependable.

Ensure Scale, Security & Compliance – Own PCI, risk, and data-integrity considerations, ensuring the platform stays secure, scalable, and compliant as volume grows.

Collaborate Cross-Functionally – Work closely with engineering, design, data, risk, support, and partner-facing teams to align the platform with the needs of every payment surface it powers.

Leverage Payments Data for Decisions – Use metrics such as authorization rates, transaction success, failure reasons, latency, and reconciliation gaps to prioritize the roadmap and measure impact.

Own Outcomes, Not Just Features – Deliver measurable improvements in transaction success, platform reliability, and provider coverage, and in the experience of the teams building on the platform.


Who You Are

Payments & Platform Experience – You have built and shipped features within a payments, fintech, or platform/infrastructure ecosystem, delivering secure, reliable systems that operate at scale.

Technically Fluent – You can hold your own with engineers on APIs, webhooks, idempotency, routing logic, and failure modes, and you use that fluency to make sharper product decisions.

Reliability-Minded – You care deeply about correctness, uptime, and edge cases, and you design for the failure paths - retries, timeouts, duplicates, and reconciliation, not just the happy path.

Customer- & Developer-Centric – You balance business goals, risk, and trust, keeping the needs of both end customers and the internal teams who build on your platform at the center of your decisions.

Strategic and Execution-Focused – You can shape a clear roadmap for your area while staying deeply involved in execution to ensure ideas translate into shipped, measurable impact.

Highly Data-Driven in Ambiguity – You are comfortable working with messy, incomplete data - transaction logs, failure reasons, and provider quirks - to find patterns and derive actionable insights.


What You’ll Bring

  • 4+ years of Product Management experience, with a focus on payments, fintech, platform, or API/infrastructure products, 

  • A track record of shipping impactful platform or infrastructure features that improved reliability, coverage, or transaction success in a high-scale environment.

  • A working understanding of payment systems PSP/gateway integrations, the authorization-to-settlement lifecycle, webhooks, idempotency, and reconciliation.

  • Strong technical fluency, with the ability to partner closely with engineering on API design, event models, and system trade-offs.

  • Familiarity with SaaS and platform growth levers, including adoption of internal platforms, developer experience, and reliability as a driver of customer trust.

Bonus:

  • You have worked on a payments or fintech platform processing significant transaction volume across multiple providers, and can clearly articulate your impact on reliability, authorization rates, and customer trust.


Why should you join us?

At HighLevel, we foster an exciting and dynamic work environment driven by a passionate team. We believe in a collective responsibility where no task is considered someone else's job. Our unwavering focus is on providing value to our users, and we achieve this by delivering solutions swiftly through lean principles, allowing us to bring products to market in a matter of weeks rather than quarters. Every good idea is put to the test, ensuring that we maintain a high standard of innovation. We prioritise the well-being of our team, recognizing that by taking care of them, they can better serve our users. We embrace the concept of continuous and iterative improvement, understanding that progress is an ongoing journey. We are also a well funded & profitable company. 

Join us at High Level, and you will have the opportunity to learn the intricacies of scaling a B2B SaaS startup and develop impactful products that cater to the needs of our customers.

About HighLevel:
HighLevel is an AI-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate and scale. Today, HighLevel supports SMBs across 150+ countries, fueling community-driven growth rooted in real customer outcomes.
To date, businesses operating on HighLevel have generated over $7 billion in ecosystem value, demonstrating the impact of shared infrastructure at scale. By centralizing conversations, automation and intelligence into one system, we help businesses move faster, reduce complexity and execute efficiently.
Behind the platform, HighLevel powers more than 4 billion API hits and 2.5 billion message events daily. With 250 terabytes of distributed data, 250+ microservices and over 1 million domain names supported, our architecture is built for performance, resilience and long-term scalability.
 
Our People
With over 2,000 team members across 10+ countries, HighLevel operates as a global, remote-first organization built for speed and ownership. We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home.
 
Our Impact
Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1.5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact. We’re proud to be a part of that.
Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts.
 
Programme Details:
Work Type: Apprenticeship
Department: Marketing 
Sub Department: Product Marketing
Duration: 6 months
Monthly Stipend: 40000
Shift timings : 9 AM to 5 PM CST
Location: Remote - India
Programme Start: October 2026



Responsibilities:
Support the Product Marketing team with day-to-day research, coordination, and execution across a variety of projects.
Help build HighLevel’s Marketing Analytics Reports by gathering, organizing, and validating data, industry benchmarks, and supporting research.
Conduct market, competitor, customer, and industry research to support product marketing initiatives.
Assist with customer education projects, including researching and organizing information that helps customers better understand HighLevel products and features.
Support product launches, campaigns, presentations, and other team initiatives as needed.
 
 
Requirements:
Strong research and organizational skills with excellent attention to detail.
Comfort working with spreadsheets, data, and quantitative information.
Strong written and verbal English communication skills.
Curiosity about marketing, technology, SaaS, and how businesses grow.
A willingness to learn, take feedback, and work across a variety of projects.
Ability to manage assignments independently and follow through on deadlines.
Familiarity with AI tools, Google Workspace, or other marketing tools is a plus.
Nice to Have:
Currently pursuing or recently completed a Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, Economics, Analytics, or a related field.
Previous professional experience is not required. Relevant coursework, academic projects, internships, or personal projects are welcome.
 
HighLevel India Apprenticeship Policy:
This Apprenticeship Policy is issued pursuant to and in compliance with the Apprentices Act, 1961 (as
amended), the Apprenticeship Rules, 1992, the National Employability Enhancement Mission (NEEM)
Guidelines (if applicable), and the National Apprenticeship Promotion Scheme (NAPS) Guidelines notified
by the Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship.

Providing this information is voluntary and refusal to do so will not affect your application status. This data will be kept separate from your application and will not be used in the hiring decision.

We encourage you to review our Privacy Policy before submitting your application

You’ll spend most of your time on backend and API design, data flows, and performance — while still owning the Vue 3 UI layer end-to-end.
