To date, businesses operating on HighLevel have generated over $7 billion in ecosystem value, demonstrating the impact of shared infrastructure at scale. By centralizing conversations, automation and intelligence into one system, we help businesses move faster, reduce complexity and execute efficiently.
Behind the platform, HighLevel powers more than 4 billion API hits and 2.5 billion message events daily. With 250 terabytes of distributed data, 250+ microservices and over 1 million domain names supported, our architecture is built for performance, resilience and long-term scalability.

Our people
With over 2,000 team members across 10+ countries, HighLevel operates as a global, remote-first organization built for speed and ownership. We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home.

Our impact
Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1.5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact. We’re proud to be a part of that.
Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts
 

 

What are we hiring for?

The systems that run millions of businesses.

Every month, 2.6 billion messages flow through our platform. Our automation engine enrolls 3.1 billion contacts and executes 21.5 billion workflow actions in the same window — with API traffic peaking at 28,000+ requests per second. Booking appointments, closing deals, answering customers. If these systems lag, businesses lose leads. If they go down, people lose income.

We're hiring backend engineers who treat that as a design constraint, not a fun fact.

This isn't a role where you'll implement someone else's spec. You'll be handed problems that don't have a known answer yet — a datastore buckling under index growth, a queue that needs to absorb 10x burst traffic without dropping a message, a state machine with millions of concurrent executions. You'll figure it out. And you'll own it.


Team & System Overview:
The Conversations organization powers multi-channel communication across SMS, Email, WhatsApp, and DMs — handling over 2B messages each month. The Threads & Composer team owns the inbox and composer surfaces, and the backend services that deliver and store those interactions.You’ll work across Node.js microservices, GCP-based infra (GKE, Pub/Sub, Cloud Tasks), and MongoDB/Firestore storage layers, ensuring every message and UI state stays consistent, fast, and recoverable.

lists.content:
• Design and build Node.js / Go services on critical paths — high throughput, low latency, zero tolerance for data loss

  • Own systems end to end: architecture, design docs, code, tests, rollout, and production health

  • Model and optimize data layers across SQL and NoSQL stores handling high read/write volumes and atomic updates

  • Build queueing, caching, and rate-limiting layers that keep the platform graceful under burst traffic

  • Instrument everything — logs, metrics, traces — so you know your system is healthy before anyone asks

  • Debug production incidents, ship the fix, drive the post-mortem to closure

  • Review code, raise the bar, and pull the engineers around you up with you.

• 4+ years of backend engineering experience, with deep hands-on work in Node.js and/or Go

  • Queueing experience — you've designed with Pub/Sub, Kafka, RabbitMQ, Cloud Tasks, or similar, and you understand delivery semantics, ordering, and backpressure

  • Complex distributed systems experience — consistency trade-offs, idempotency, fault tolerance, systems that stay correct under partial failure

  • Hands-on with Redis or other in-memory data stores — caching strategies, data structures, and their failure modes

  • Strong with SQL or NoSQL databases — schema design, indexing, and query optimization at high volume

  • You write clear design docs and rigorous test cases as a habit, not on request

  • Champion of AI-assisted engineering — you make agents produce accurate, production-quality code, fast

• Languages: Node.js (TypeScript), Go

  • Storage: MongoDB, Firestore, Redis, ElasticSearch, ClickHouse

  • Infra: GCP — GKE, Pub/Sub, Cloud Tasks

  • CI/CD: GitHub Actions, Docker, Kubernetes

We're past the debate. AI is part of how we build — and we expect you to be better at it than most.

That means making agents do real work: producing code that's accurate, tested, and slop-free — fast. You know when to hand a problem to an agent and when to take the wheel. You review AI output with the same rigor as a junior engineer's PR, and you ship at a pace that engineers without this skill can't match.

If you're still copy-pasting from a chat window and hoping, this isn't the seat for you.

• You've solved problems nobody handed you a playbook for — ideally in a 0→1 environment where the system didn't exist until you built it

  • You understand systems in depth — not just the API surface, but what happens under load, at the tail, when the network partitions

  • You write design docs people actually read — clear trade-offs, honest risks, a real recommendation

  • You treat test cases as part of the design, not a chore after the fact

  • When production breaks at 2 AM, your first instinct is curiosity, not panic

• Familiarity with our stack: GCP, MongoDB, Firestore, ClickHouse, ElasticSearch

  • You've built or scaled messaging, automation, or event-driven platforms

  • You've taken a system from 0→1, or rebuilt one mid-flight without breaking it

About HighLevel:
HighLevel is an AI-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate and scale. Today, HighLevel supports SMBs across 150+ countries, fueling community-driven growth rooted in real customer outcomes.
To date, businesses operating on HighLevel have generated over $7 billion in ecosystem value, demonstrating the impact of shared infrastructure at scale. By centralizing conversations, automation and intelligence into one system, we help businesses move faster, reduce complexity and execute efficiently.
Behind the platform, HighLevel powers more than 4 billion API hits and 2.5 billion message events daily. With 250 terabytes of distributed data, 250+ microservices and over 1 million domain names supported, our architecture is built for performance, resilience and long-term scalability.

Our people
With over 2,000 team members across 10+ countries, HighLevel operates as a global, remote-first organization built for speed and ownership. We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home.

Our impact
Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1.5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact. We’re proud to be a part of that.
Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts
 

 

What are we hiring for?

The platform underneath our two biggest systems.

Workflows executes 21.5 billion automation actions a month from 3.1 billion enrollments. Conversations moves 2.6 billion messages in the same window. Together they run on thousands of pods, across 50+ kinds of deployments, on top of multiple database engines, GCP Pub/Sub, Cloud Tasks, and Redis, with traffic peaking above 28,000 requests per second and growing double-digit percent every month.

Product engineers build the features. This role owns what the features stand on, the queues, the storage layers, the caching, the infrastructure, and makes sure it holds when the growth curve does what our growth curve does.

We're not looking for someone who knows one layer. We're looking for the engineer who understands the whole vertical: how a query plan behaves at 1.5 TB of indexes, why a pod eviction turned into a message backlog, what a Redis failover actually does to the request path. Databases, infra, cloud, you see through all of it.



Team & System Overview:
The Conversations organization powers multi-channel communication across SMS, Email, WhatsApp, and DMs — handling over 2B messages each month. The Threads & Composer team owns the inbox and composer surfaces, and the backend services that deliver and store those interactions.You’ll work across Node.js microservices, GCP-based infra (GKE, Pub/Sub, Cloud Tasks), and MongoDB/Firestore storage layers, ensuring every message and UI state stays consistent, fast, and recoverable.

lists.content:
• Design and build the platform components Workflows and Conversations run on, queueing pipelines, storage access layers, caching strategies, rate limiters, schedulers

  • Own your components end to end: architecture, design docs, code, tests, rollout, dashboards, and production health

  • Go deep on data stores at scale, schema and index design, sharding strategies, replication behavior, and migrations on live systems with billions of records

  • Work close to the infrastructure: GKE autoscaling, resource tuning, Pub/Sub and Cloud Tasks topologies, and the capacity planning that keeps headroom ahead of growth

  • Spot gaps in your systems before production does, missing idempotency, unbounded queues, cache stampedes, hot shards, and drive the fixes

  • Debug the incidents that cross layers, where the answer isn't in one service's logs but in how the pieces interact

  • Write design docs and RCAs that make the platform's behavior legible to 80+ engineers building on it

    • The terrain:

  • Runtime: Node.js (TypeScript), Go, on GKE

  • Messaging & async: GCP Pub/Sub, Cloud Tasks, Redis

  • Storage: MongoDB, Firestore, ClickHouse, ElasticSearch

  • Observability: metrics, tracing, and alerting you'll help make sharper

• 4+ years of backend engineering experience, with deep hands-on work in Node.js and/or Go

  • Strong systems understanding across the stack, application, database, and infrastructure, proven on high-throughput production systems

  • Deep experience with queueing and async processing, Pub/Sub, Kafka, RabbitMQ, Cloud Tasks, or similar, delivery semantics, ordering, backpressure, idempotency

  • Database depth beyond CRUD, indexing strategies, sharding, replication, query performance, and safe migrations on SQL or NoSQL stores at scale

  • Hands-on with Redis or other in-memory stores, caching patterns, data structures, and their failure modes

  • Production experience with cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes, autoscaling, resource limits, and how they behave under pressure (GCP preferred)

  • You write clear design docs and rigorous test cases as a habit, not on request

  • Champion of AI-assisted engineering, you make agents produce accurate, production-quality code, fast

We're past the debate. AI is part of how we build, and we expect you to be better at it than most.

That means making agents do real work: producing code that's accurate, tested, and slop-free, fast. On platform code, the bar is higher, not lower: a sloppy merge here doesn't break a feature, it breaks the floor everything stands on. You review AI output with that in mind, and you ship at a pace engineers without this skill can't match.

• You understand systems in depth, not just the API surface, but what happens under load, at the tail, when the network partitions

  • You've taken real production hits, a migration gone sideways, a queue that wouldn't drain, a database that fell over, and each one made your designs better

  • You're the engineer teammates pull in when the bug crosses layers, app, database, infra, because you can hold all three in your head

  • You write design docs people actually read, clear trade-offs, honest risks, a real recommendation

  • You treat capacity and failure modes as design inputs, not afterthoughts

  • When production breaks, your first instinct is curiosity, not panic

• You've operated systems at comparable scale, billions of events, thousands of instances

  • Experience with ClickHouse, ElasticSearch, or Firestore in production

  • You've done platform work before, the unglamorous layers everyone depends on and nobody notices until they fail

About the Role:
We're looking for a Software Development Engineer III (Full Stack) to join our Labs team. Labs is the platform that powers how HighLevel ships new features to production — controlling staged rollouts, feature flags, and experimentation across the platform, and closing the loop with in-product customer feedback.
Today, every new capability shipped across HighLevel's platform passes through Labs' feature-flag and rollout infrastructure, spanning 100K+ agencies and the 2M+ businesses they serve. The systems we build directly shape how safely and quickly the rest of the engineering org can ship — enabling gradual rollouts, targeted enablement at the company and location level, and fast, safe rollback when something goes wrong.
The team builds and scales core capabilities across feature flag management, staged feature rollout, and customer feedback collection. These systems let product and engineering teams control exactly who gets a feature and when, monitor adoption and health in real time, and gather structured feedback directly from agencies and locations to inform what ships next.
As an SDE-3, you'll play a key role in building and evolving these systems across the frontend and backend, while contributing to technical architecture and engineering decisions. You'll work on challenges involving high-throughput flag evaluation, scalable APIs and services, distributed systems, and data architecture — with a strong focus on reliability, low latency, and correctness, since every other team's shipping velocity depends on this platform working correctly.
You'll collaborate closely with Product Managers, Designers, and other Engineers across the org to take features from requirements and technical planning through implementation and production, while contributing to technical decisions and continuously improving the systems you own.

lists.content:
• Own and contribute to the architecture, design, and development of key product areas across Feature Flags, Staged Rollouts, and Customer Feedback within the Labs platform.
  • Design and build scalable backend services, APIs, and integrations, working across internal microservices and third-party platforms such as Statsig, with a strong focus on reliability, security, and performance.
  • Build performant and scalable frontend experiences for feature flag management, rollout configuration, and feedback collection workflows using modern frontend frameworks and component-driven architecture with strong state management practices.
  • Drive technical decisions, identify risks and trade-offs, and independently own complex features from technical design through production.
  • Leverage AI-first development practices and AI-assisted development tools to improve development, testing, debugging, and refactoring while maintaining strong quality and security standards.
  • Design data models and build efficient queries and caching strategies across data stores such as MongoDB and Redis, optimized for low-latency flag evaluation at scale.
  • Participate across the full Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), from requirement analysis and technical design to implementation, deployment, monitoring, and production support.
  • Write clean, efficient, secure, and testable code with appropriate unit and integration test coverage.
  • Build and maintain effective observability through logs, metrics, monitoring, and tracing to improve system reliability and enable faster production issue resolution — critical given that other engineering teams depend on Labs to ship safely.
  • Participate in code reviews, technical design discussions, incident resolution, and operational support, including on-call responsibilities where applicable.
  • Collaborate closely with Product Managers, Designers, and other Engineering teams to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions.
  • Follow engineering best practices around security, scalability, maintainability, testing, documentation, and production readiness.

• 4+ years of hands-on software engineering experience building and scaling robust backend systems and high-performance frontend applications.
  • Strong backend engineering skills with hands-on experience in Node.js, TypeScript, API development, data modeling, and system design. Experience with NestJS is preferred.
  • Strong understanding of RESTful API design, microservices architecture, distributed systems, and cross-service communication.
  • Hands-on experience working with data stores such as MongoDB and Redis, with a strong understanding of data modeling, query design, and performance optimization.
  • Experience working with event-driven architectures and messaging systems such as GCP Pub/Sub, Kafka, RabbitMQ, or similar technologies.
  • Exposure to AI/LLM application development, such as integrating LLM APIs, prompt/context design, or building AI-assisted product workflows.
  • Good frontend development experience with modern frameworks such as Vue.js, React, or Angular, with Vue.js preferred, along with a good understanding of component-driven architecture and modern CSS frameworks such as Tailwind CSS or Bootstrap.
  • Experience with frontend state management patterns and libraries such as Vuex/Pinia, Redux, MobX, or similar solutions.
  • Good understanding of production observability and debugging, including logging, monitoring, tracing, error tracking, and performance profiling using tools such as Grafana, Prometheus, Sentry, or similar platforms.
  • Experience with modern SDLC practices, Agile development methodologies, Git workflows, automated testing, and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Familiarity with specialized data platforms such as ClickHouse and Elasticsearch, and an understanding of when to use document databases, analytical/columnar databases, and search engines.
  • Familiarity with modern developer productivity tools, including hands-on experience with AI-assisted development tools such as Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or similar tools.
  • Strong problem-solving and debugging skills, with the ability to investigate issues across frontend, backend, databases, integrations, and distributed services.
  • Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills, with the ability to drive technical discussions, make sound engineering trade-offs, and mentor other engineers.
  • Strong ownership mindset with the ability to independently drive complex engineering problems and deliver high-quality solutions.

About the Role:
We’re looking for a Senior Software Development Engineer (Full Stack) to join our Agency Module, Platform Billing, and Onboarding team. These products form a critical part of HighLevel’s Agency ecosystem, enabling agencies to seamlessly create and manage their accounts, onboard onto the platform, manage subscriptions and billing, and scale their businesses.
Today, 100K+ agencies use HighLevel, collectively serving 2M+ businesses of all sizes, primarily SMBs. The systems we build support critical parts of the agency lifecycle and directly contribute to agency growth by making onboarding, account management, and billing experiences reliable and seamless.
The team builds and scales key capabilities across Agency Signup and Company Management, Platform Billing, and Agency Onboarding. Our onboarding experiences help new agencies get started with HighLevel, configure their accounts, discover and adopt key platform capabilities, and move from signup to successfully using the platform. Together, these systems provide the foundation for agencies to onboard, operate, and grow their businesses on HighLevel.
As an Sr. SDE, you’ll play a key role in building and evolving these systems across the frontend and backend, while contributing to technical architecture and engineering decisions. You’ll work on challenges involving scalable APIs and services, distributed systems, data architecture and modern frontend experiences — with a strong focus on reliability, scalability, and performance.
You’ll collaborate closely with Product Managers, Designers, and other Engineers to take features from requirements and technical planning through implementation and production, while contributing to technical decisions and continuously improving the systems you own.

lists.content:
• Own and contribute to the architecture, design, and development of key product areas across the Agency Module, Agency Onboarding, and Platform Billing.
  • Design and build scalable backend services, APIs, and integrations, working across internal microservices and third-party platforms such as Stripe, with a strong focus on reliability, security, and performance.
  • Build performant and scalable frontend experiences for agency management, onboarding, and billing workflows using modern frontend frameworks and component-driven architecture with strong state management practices.
  • Drive technical decisions, identify risks and trade-offs, and independently own complex features from technical design through production.
  • Leverage AI-first development practices and AI-assisted development tools to improve development, testing, debugging, and refactoring while maintaining strong quality and security standards.
  • Design data models and build efficient queries across data stores such as Firestore, MongoDB, ClickHouse, and Elasticsearch.
  • Participate across the full Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), from requirement analysis and technical design to implementation, deployment, monitoring, and production support.
  • Write clean, efficient, secure, and testable code with appropriate unit and integration test coverage.
  • Build and maintain effective observability through logs, metrics, monitoring, and tracing to improve system reliability and enable faster production issue resolution.
  • Participate in code reviews, technical design discussions, incident resolution, and operational support, including on-call responsibilities where applicable.
  • Collaborate closely with Product Managers, Designers, and other Engineering teams to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions.
  • Follow engineering best practices around security, scalability, maintainability, testing, documentation, and production readiness.

• 4+ years of hands-on software engineering experience building and scaling robust backend systems and high-performance frontend applications.
  • Strong backend engineering skills with hands-on experience in Node.js, TypeScript, API development, data modeling, and system design. Experience with NestJS is preferred.
  • Strong understanding of RESTful API design, microservices architecture, distributed systems, and cross-service communication.
  • Hands-on experience working with data stores such as MongoDB and Redis, with a strong understanding of data modeling, query design, and performance optimization.
  • Experience working with event-driven architectures and messaging systems such as GCP Pub/Sub, Kafka, RabbitMQ, or similar technologies.
  • Exposure to AI/LLM application development, such as integrating LLM APIs, prompt/context design, or building AI-assisted product workflows.
  • Good frontend development experience with modern frameworks such as Vue.js, React, or Angular, with Vue.js preferred, along with a good understanding of component-driven architecture and modern CSS frameworks such as Tailwind CSS or Bootstrap.
  • Experience with frontend state management patterns and libraries such as Vuex/Pinia, Redux, MobX, or similar solutions.
  • Good understanding of production observability and debugging, including logging, monitoring, tracing, error tracking, and performance profiling using tools such as Grafana, Prometheus, Sentry, or similar platforms.
  • Experience with modern SDLC practices, Agile development methodologies, Git workflows, automated testing, and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Familiarity with specialized data platforms such as ClickHouse and Elasticsearch, and an understanding of when to use document databases, analytical/columnar databases, and search engines.
  • Familiarity with modern developer productivity tools, including hands-on experience with AI-assisted development tools such as Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or similar tools.
  • Strong problem-solving and debugging skills, with the ability to investigate issues across frontend, backend, databases, integrations, and distributed services.
  • Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills, with the ability to drive technical discussions, make sound engineering trade-offs, and mentor other engineers.
  • Strong ownership mindset with the ability to independently drive complex engineering problems and deliver high-quality solutions.

About the Team:

Millions of businesses post to social media through HighLevel's Social Planner. Hundreds of thousands of posts go out every day across every major social platform, each with its own API, rate limits, and frequent changes. Our job is to make that look easy.We're a small team with a big surface area, and we're building the next layer on top of publishing: understanding what the internet is saying about our customers, at scale, with AI. We're hiring a senior full stack engineer who can own critical systems and large features end to end, proactively identify problems, drive scalable solutions, and raise the engineering quality bar across the team.

lists.content:
• Own critical subsystems and large features end to end - from problem discovery and technical design through development, rollout, monitoring, and measuring customer and business impact.
  • Lead major technical initiatives within the team and drive architecture, design, implementation, rollout strategy, and post-release improvements.
  • Proactively identify system problems, including scalability bottlenecks, reliability risks, performance issues, technical debt, usability gaps, and operational inefficiencies, and drive solutions without waiting for them to be assigned.
  • Design and operate reliable distributed systems using message queues, background workers, schedulers, retries, idempotency, caching, and high-volume third-party platform API integrations.
  • Anticipate scale, edge cases, failure modes, rate limits, API changes, and downstream system implications before they become production problems.
  • Evaluate architectural and technology trade-offs across scalability, reliability, maintainability, cost, development velocity, and customer impact.
  • Build data pipelines that ingest and enrich large volumes of social data and metrics from multiple sources and provide infrastructure for fast analytics and insights.
  • Process media at scale, including image and video upload, transformation, optimization, generation, storage, and delivery in the formats required by different social platforms.
  • Ship both backend APIs and frontend experiences, with strong attention to usability, performance, accessibility, and customer experience.
  • Build production-grade AI capabilities using LLMs, image/video generation, embeddings, RAG, tool calling, and agentic workflows to improve customer outcomes.
  • Identify opportunities where AI and intelligent technologies can improve product capabilities, engineering productivity, system reliability, or operational efficiency, and validate them through prototypes and measurable outcomes.
  • Follow and promote Test-Driven Development and strong automated testing practices to reduce defect leakage and improve release confidence.
  • Own production quality through observability, monitoring, incident investigation, root-cause analysis, and permanent corrective actions.
  • Raise the engineering quality bar through code reviews, design reviews, engineering standards, documentation, testing practices, and maintainable architecture.
  • Mentor engineers and help the team make better technical decisions through design discussions, reviews, prototypes, and knowledge sharing.

• 4+ years of hands-on software engineering experience building and operating production systems, preferably SaaS products at meaningful scale.
  • Strong experience independently owning complex or business-critical features or services from design through production.
  • Hands-on experience building distributed systems using message queues, background workers, schedulers, retries, idempotency, caching, and high-volume third-party API integrations.
  • Extensive experience integrating with third-party APIs and handling real-world challenges such as rate limits, authentication and token management, webhooks, retries, API version changes, partial failures, and inconsistent external dependencies.
  • Strong ability to proactively identify system problems and drive improvements across scalability, reliability, performance, maintainability, and technical debt.
  • Strong understanding of system design and the ability to evaluate architectural trade-offs, edge cases, downstream dependencies, and long-term implications.
  • Strong engineering fundamentals with experience writing clean, maintainable, well-tested code and applying Test-Driven Development or similar disciplined testing practices.
  • Strong TypeScript and Node.js experience; hands-on experience with NestJS is preferred.
  • Experience building customer-facing web applications using Vue.js, React, Angular, or similar modern frontend frameworks, with a good understanding of UI/UX principles and the ability to identify usability gaps.
  • Experience with MongoDB, Redis, and data-intensive applications.
  • Experience with large-scale data ingestion, ETL/ELT, analytics, or data warehousing using technologies such as ClickHouse, BigQuery, Snowflake, Elasticsearch, or similar systems.
  • Hands-on experience building AI-powered software using LLM APIs, embeddings, RAG, image/video generation, tool calling, or agentic workflows.
  • Ability to move AI features beyond prototypes into reliable production systems with appropriate evaluation, observability, guardrails, cost considerations, and failure handling.
  • Hands-on experience with AI-assisted software development and the ability to use AI coding tools thoughtfully while maintaining ownership of architecture, quality, security, and correctness.
  • Customer-first and product-oriented mindset: start with the customer or business problem and select technology based on the desired outcome.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to lead technical discussions, communicate trade-offs clearly, and collaborate effectively in a remote environment.

• Experience building social listening, monitoring, sentiment analysis, trend detection, brand intelligence, social publishing, or social media management products.
  • Hands-on experience integrating with social platform APIs such as Meta/Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, TikTok, YouTube, X/Twitter, Pinterest, Google Business Profile, or similar platforms.
  • Experience designing systems for high-volume event ingestion and near real-time processing using Pub/Sub, Kafka, SQS, RabbitMQ, or similar event-driven architectures.
  • Experience working with high-volume external APIs where rate limiting, token lifecycle management, webhooks, asynchronous processing, and third-party reliability are core challenges.
  • Experience with social listening, NLP, sentiment analysis, trend detection, topic classification, entity extraction, or deriving insights from unstructured social data.
  • Experience building AI workflows that generate personalized posts, images, videos, recommendations, or marketing content from customer or business data.
  • Experience designing or operating agentic workflows involving tools, retrieval, structured outputs, evaluation, guardrails, and human-in-the-loop patterns.
  • Experience with large-scale image/video processing, including transcoding, optimization, codecs, storage, CDN delivery, or asynchronous media pipelines.
  • Experience with GCP technologies such as Pub/Sub, Cloud Storage, GKE, Firestore, monitoring, and autoscaling.
  • Previous experience in SaaS, MarTech, CRM, social media management, analytics, or a high-growth product environment.
  • Experience leading technical design discussions, writing design documents, mentoring engineers, and improving engineering standards within a team.
  • Contributions to open-source projects, technical writing, side projects, or experimentation with emerging AI and engineering technologies.

Our automation engine enrolls 3.1 billion contacts and executes 21.5 billion workflow actions in the same window - with API traffic peaking at 28,000+ requests per second. If these systems lag, businesses lose leads. If they go down, people lose income.

You haven't built at this scale yet. That's fine - almost nobody has.

What we're hiring for is the engineer who reads those numbers and feels pulled toward them. Who wants to know what a queue looks like when it's absorbing a 10x burst, what an index does at 1.5 TB, what "eventually consistent" actually means when a customer is staring at the screen. You'll work on real production paths from week one — with senior engineers around you who've broken and fixed these systems before. You'll build. You'll break things. You'll learn faster here than anywhere else.

If these systems lag, businesses lose leads. If they go down, people lose income.

You haven't built at this scale yet. That's fine - almost nobody has.

What we're hiring for is the engineer who reads those numbers and feels pulled toward them. Who wants to know what a queue looks like when it's absorbing a 10x burst, what an index does at 1.5 TB, what "eventually consistent" actually means when a customer is staring at the screen. You'll work on real production paths from week one — with senior engineers around you who've broken and fixed these systems before. You'll build. You'll break things. You'll learn faster here than anywhere else.

lists.content:
• Build and ship features in Node.js / Go services that sit on real production paths — your code handles live traffic, not toy problems

  • Own well-scoped services and components end to end: code, tests, rollout, and monitoring

  • Work with SQL and NoSQL data stores — writing queries, adding indexes, and learning why the schema looks the way it does

  • Get hands-on with queues, caches, and rate limiters — the building blocks of every system here

  • Ship Vue 3 UIs that consume your own APIs — clean components, sane state management, and realtime updates that don't flicker or drift

  • Write design docs for your features and defend them in review — clear thinking, honest trade-offs

  • Join the on-call rotation with backup from senior engineers — incidents are where the deepest learning happens

  • Ask questions relentlessly, absorb feedback from code reviews, and level up fast

• 2+ years of backend engineering experience with strong fundamentals in Node.js, Go, or a comparable language — and the drive to go deep in ours

  • Working knowledge of queues or async processing — you've used Pub/Sub, Kafka, RabbitMQ, or similar, and want to master delivery semantics, ordering, and backpressure

  • Genuine interest in distributed systems — you understand the basics (idempotency, retries, consistency trade-offs) and are hungry to learn the rest by building

  • Hands-on with Redis or another cache/in-memory store, even at small scale

  • Comfortable with SQL or NoSQL databases — you can model data, write efficient queries, and reason about indexes

  • Proficient in Vue 3 or a similar modern frontend framework — solid component design and real experience with state management (Pinia, Vuex, or equivalent)

  • You write tests as a habit and can put your design thinking into a clear doc

  • AI-native builder — you code with agents daily and are pushing to get accurate, production-quality output from them

• Languages: Node.js (TypeScript), Go

  • Frontend: Vue 3, TypeScript, Pinia, Vite, Tailwind

  • Storage: MongoDB, Firestore, Redis, ElasticSearch, ClickHouse

  • Infra: GCP — GKE, Pub/Sub, Cloud Tasks

  • CI/CD: GitHub Actions, Docker, Kubernetes

Most engineers spend years at companies where "scale" means a few hundred requests per second — and never find out what they're capable of.

Here, the systems are the teacher. Every design decision has a visible consequence at billions of events a month. Every incident is a masterclass. You'll sit in architecture reviews with staff engineers debating storage engines and consistency models — and within a year, you'll be contributing to those debates, not just watching them.

If you optimize your career for learning velocity, there is no faster track than this.

We're past the debate. AI is part of how we build - and we expect you to be hungry for it.

You already code with agents daily. You're learning what they're good at, where they hallucinate, and how to get accurate, tested, slop-free code out of them fast. You treat AI as a multiplier on your learning speed, not a substitute for understanding.

If you're still copy-pasting from a chat window and hoping, this isn't the seat for you.

• You're deeply curious — you don't stop at "it works," you need to know why it works

  • You read post-mortems and system-design write-ups for fun, not because someone assigned them

  • You've built things beyond your job description — side projects, internal tools, that one system you rewrote because the old one bothered you

  • You take feedback like a gift: code review comments make your next PR better, every time

  • When something breaks, your first instinct is curiosity, not panic

• You own a service or component that the team trusts you on completely

  • You're a dependable on-call engineer — you've debugged real incidents and shipped the fixes

  • Your design docs have gone from "reviewed heavily" to "approved with nits"

  • Senior engineers pull you into harder problems — because you've earned it

  • You're visibly on the path to SDE-3, and everyone around you knows it

• Familiarity with our stack: GCP, MongoDB, Firestore, ClickHouse, ElasticSearch

  • You've contributed to a messaging, automation, or event-driven system — at any scale

  • Side projects or open-source work that shows you build because you can't not build

About HighLevel:
HighLevel is an AI-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate and scale. Today, HighLevel supports SMBs across 150+ countries, fueling community-driven growth rooted in real customer outcomes.
To date, businesses operating on HighLevel have generated over $7 billion in ecosystem value, demonstrating the impact of shared infrastructure at scale. By centralizing conversations, automation and intelligence into one system, we help businesses move faster, reduce complexity and execute efficiently.
Behind the platform, HighLevel powers more than 4 billion API hits and 2.5 billion message events daily. With 250 terabytes of distributed data, 250+ microservices and over 1 million domain names supported, our architecture is built for performance, resilience and long-term scalability.

Our people
With over 2,000 team members across 10+ countries, HighLevel operates as a global, remote-first organization built for speed and ownership. We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home.

Our impact
Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1.5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact. We’re proud to be a part of that.
Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts
 

 

What are we hiring for?

The systems that run millions of businesses.

Every month, 2.6 billion messages flow through our platform. Our automation engine enrolls 3.1 billion contacts and executes 21.5 billion workflow actions in the same window - with API traffic peaking at 28,000+ requests per second. If these systems lag, businesses lose leads. If they go down, people lose income.

You haven't built at this scale yet. That's fine - almost nobody has.

What we're hiring for is the engineer who reads those numbers and feels pulled toward them. Who wants to know what a queue looks like when it's absorbing a 10x burst, what an index does at 1.5 TB, what "eventually consistent" actually means when a customer is staring at the screen. You'll work on real production paths from week one — with senior engineers around you who've broken and fixed these systems before. You'll build. You'll break things. You'll learn faster here than anywhere else.

About the Role
We’re looking for a Software Development Engineer II (Full Stack) to join our Agency Module, Platform Billing, and Onboarding team. These products form a critical part of HighLevel’s Agency ecosystem, enabling agencies to seamlessly create and manage their accounts, onboard onto the platform, manage subscriptions and billing, and scale their businesses.
Today, 100K+ agencies use HighLevel, collectively serving 2M+ businesses of all sizes, primarily SMBs. The systems we build support critical parts of the agency lifecycle and directly contribute to agency growth by making onboarding, account management, and billing experiences reliable and seamless.
The team builds and scales key capabilities across Agency Signup and Company Management, Platform Billing, and Agency Onboarding. Our onboarding experiences help new agencies get started with HighLevel, configure their accounts, discover and adopt key platform capabilities, and move from signup to successfully using the platform. Together, these systems provide the foundation for agencies to onboard, operate, and grow their businesses on HighLevel.
As an SDE-2, you’ll work across the frontend and backend, building and delivering features across these systems. You’ll work on scalable APIs and services, data-driven workflows, integrations, and modern frontend experiences while developing a strong understanding of the products and systems you work on.
You’ll collaborate closely with Product Managers, Designers, and other Engineers to take features from requirements through implementation and production, contribute to technical discussions, and continuously improve the quality and reliability of the systems you work on.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Software Development Engineer II (Full Stack) to join our Agency Module, Platform Billing, and Onboarding team. These products form a critical part of HighLevel’s Agency ecosystem, enabling agencies to seamlessly create and manage their accounts, onboard onto the platform, manage subscriptions and billing, and scale their businesses.

Today, 100K+ agencies use HighLevel, collectively serving 2M+ businesses of all sizes, primarily SMBs. The systems we build support critical parts of the agency lifecycle and directly contribute to agency growth by making onboarding, account management, and billing experiences reliable and seamless.

The team builds and scales key capabilities across Agency Signup and Company Management, Platform Billing, and Agency Onboarding. Our onboarding experiences help new agencies get started with HighLevel, configure their accounts, discover and adopt key platform capabilities, and move from signup to successfully using the platform. Together, these systems provide the foundation for agencies to onboard, operate, and grow their businesses on HighLevel.

As an SDE-2, you’ll work across the frontend and backend, building and delivering features across these systems. You’ll work on scalable APIs and services, data-driven workflows, integrations, and modern frontend experiences while developing a strong understanding of the products and systems you work on.

You’ll collaborate closely with Product Managers, Designers, and other Engineers to take features from requirements through implementation and production, contribute to technical discussions, and continuously improve the quality and reliability of the systems you work on.

lists.content:
• Build and deliver features across the Agency Module, Agency Onboarding, and Platform Billing, contributing across both backend and frontend systems.

  • Design and build scalable backend services, APIs, and integrations, working across internal microservices and third-party platforms such as Stripe, with a focus on reliability, security, and performance.

  • Build performant and scalable frontend experiences for agency management, onboarding, and billing workflows using modern frontend frameworks and component-driven architecture with strong state management practices.

  • Own features end-to-end, from understanding requirements and technical planning through implementation, testing, deployment, and production support.

  • Leverage AI-first coding practices and AI tools (such as LLMs, Cursor, Claude Code, etc.) to write, refactor, test, and debug code efficiently, while maintaining strict guardrails for reliability and security.

  • Design data models and build efficient queries across data stores such as MongoDB, ClickHouse, and Elasticsearch.

  • Participate across the full Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), from requirement analysis and implementation to deployment, monitoring, and production support.

  • Write clean, efficient, secure, and testable code with appropriate unit and integration test coverage.

  • Use logs, metrics, monitoring, and tracing to troubleshoot production issues and contribute to improving system reliability.

  • Participate in code reviews, technical discussions, incident resolution, and operational support, including on-call responsibilities where applicable.

  • Follow engineering best practices around security, scalability, maintainability, testing, documentation, and production readiness.

• 2+ years of software engineering experience building and shipping production-grade full-stack applications.

  • Strong hands-on experience with Node.js and TypeScript for backend development, including APIs and service integrations; NestJS experience is preferred.

  • Strong frontend development experience with Vue.js, React, or Angular, with Vue.js preferred, and a good understanding of component-based development and state management.

  • Experience building and consuming REST APIs and working with microservices and service-to-service integrations.

  • Hands-on experience with MongoDB or similar databases, including data modeling, querying, and performance considerations.

  • Experience with asynchronous and event-driven application patterns, using technologies such as GCP Pub/Sub, Kafka, RabbitMQ, or similar.

  • Ability to debug and troubleshoot production issues across frontend, backend, databases, and integrations using logs and monitoring tools.

  • Good understanding of software engineering practices including automated testing, code reviews, Git, CI/CD, and production deployment.

  • Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools and the ability to use them effectively as part of day-to-day engineering workflows.

  • Strong problem-solving, ownership, and collaboration skills, with the ability to independently take a feature from requirement understanding through implementation and production.

• Experience with AI tools and contributions to open-source projects, internal platforms, or engineering blogs.

  • Experience with modern front-end frameworks (e.g., React, Vue, Angular) and building full-stack web applications.

  • Familiarity with cloud-native development, specifically within the Google Cloud Platform (GCP) ecosystem.

lists.content:
Backend Development

● Develop backend services and APIs using Node.js, TypeScript and NestJS or similar frameworks.

● Design REST APIs for customer-facing product capabilities.

● Work with databases, caching, and asynchronous processing.

● Optimize APIs and queries for performance and scalability.

Frontend Development

● Build responsive and performant interfaces using Vue.js and TypeScript.

● Develop reusable components for CRM experiences.

● Build interfaces dealing with lists, filters, search, files, notes, tags, and large datasets.

● Integrate frontend applications cleanly with backend APIs.

End-to-End Feature Ownership

● Understand product requirements and translate them into technical solutions.

● Own features across database/API/UI layers.

● Participate in technical design and API-contract discussions.

● Test and deploy features and monitor their behavior in production.

Quality & Reliability

● Write maintainable and testable code.

● Participate in code reviews.

● Debug frontend and backend production issues.

● Improve performance, reliability, and usability of existing features.

● Contribute to monitoring and observability.

● 3+ years of software development experience.

● AI First approach while Design, Development and Debugging

● Strong JavaScript/TypeScript fundamentals.

● Backend experience with Node.js.

● Frontend experience with Vue.js, React, or Angular.

● Experience designing/consuming REST APIs.

● Experience with relational and/or NoSQL databases.

● Understanding of component-based frontend architecture.

● Experience with Git, CI/CD and automated testing.

● Good understanding of frontend and backend debugging.

● Ability to independently deliver medium-complexity features.

● Experience working on high-scale SaaS products.

● Vue 2/Vue 3 and Pinia/Redux/anything

● NestJS.

● MongoDB/Firestore.+

● Redis.

● Elasticsearch/OpenSearch.

● Docker/Kubernetes/GCP.

● Micro-frontend architecture.

● Event-driven systems.

● Accessibility and internationalization.

● Build products used by millions of businesses worldwide.

● Solve challenging engineering problems at internet scale.

● Work with modern technologies in a highly distributed architecture.

● Be part of a remote-first engineering organization that values ownership, innovation, and continuous learning.

● Opportunity to build systems handling billions of API requests and message events every day.

lists.content:
• Backend ownership: Design and maintain Node.js/NestJS services for message storage, retrieval, and state sync

• Backend: Node.js, TypeScript, NestJS / Express, REST APIs

About Us
HighLevel is an AI powered, all-in-one white-label sales & marketing platform that empowers agencies, entrepreneurs, and businesses to elevate their digital presence and drive growth. We are proud to support a global and growing community of over 2 million businesses, comprised of agencies, consultants, and businesses of all sizes and industries. HighLevel empowers users  with all the tools needed to capture, nurture, and close new leads into repeat customers. As of mid 2025, HighLevel processes over 4 billion API hits and handles more than 2.5 billion message events every day. Our platform manages over 470 terabytes of data distributed across five databases, operates with a network of over 250 microservices, and supports over 1 million hostnames.
Our People
With over 1,500 team members across 15+ countries, we operate in a global, remote-first environment. We are building more than software; we are building a global community rooted in creativity, collaboration, and impact. We take pride in cultivating a culture where innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated, and people come first, no matter where they call home.
Our Impact
As of mid 2025, our platform powers over 1.5 billion messages, helps generate over 200 million leads, and facilitates over 20 million conversations for the more than 2 million businesses we serve each month. Behind those numbers are real people growing their companies, connecting with customers, and making their mark - and we get to help make that happen.
 
About the Team:
Currently we have millions of sales funnels, websites, attributions, forms and survey tools for lead generation. Our B2B customers use these tools to bring in the leads to the HighLevel CRM system. We are working to continuously improve the functionality of these tools to solve our customers’ business needs. In this role, you will be expected to be autonomous, guide other developers who might need technical help, collaborate with other technical teams, product, support and customer success
 
About the Role:
We are looking for a passionate and highly skilled Senior Software Development Engineer (SDE3) to join the Ads Manager Team. You will work on building scalable systems and user experiences that power ad campaign creation, optimisation, reporting, and automation across multiple advertising platforms.You will collaborate closely with Product, Design, QA, AI, and Platform teams to deliver high-impact features and improve campaign success rates, scalability, and reliability.This role requires strong backend engineering fundamentals, product ownership, execution discipline, and the ability to solve complex technical challenges at scale.

About the Role:
We are seeking an SDE-3 Backend Builder to own the CRM Opportunities product end-to-end. Opportunities is the deal and pipeline engine at the heart of our CRM — the system of record for every revenue motion our customers run, from lead conversion to closed-won.
This role emphasises deep backend ownership: designing data models, APIs, and distributed workflows that power pipelines, stages, automations, reporting, and integrations at scale. You will operate with high autonomy, turning ambiguous problems into production systems, with enough frontend fluency to ship the occasional UI surface without waiting on anyone.
Opportunities is also where a growing set of AI-assisted features live — things like surfacing what needs attention in a pipeline, summarising deal context, and suggesting next steps. To be clear about the shape of that work: we are not training or serving models. These features are built on top of existing AI capabilities, and the engineering problem is the product plumbing around them — assembling the right context from CRM data, keeping latency and cost sane, handling failure and non-deterministic output gracefully, and making the results trustworthy enough for a customer to act on. You do not need an ML background; you need the judgement to build a reliable product feature on top of a probabilistic dependency.

About the Role:

We are seeking an SDE-3 Backend Builder to own the CRM Opportunities product end-to-end. Opportunities is the deal and pipeline engine at the heart of our CRM — the system of record for every revenue motion our customers run, from lead conversion to closed-won.

This role emphasises deep backend ownership: designing data models, APIs, and distributed workflows that power pipelines, stages, automations, reporting, and integrations at scale. You will operate with high autonomy, turning ambiguous problems into production systems, with enough frontend fluency to ship the occasional UI surface without waiting on anyone.

Opportunities is also where a growing set of AI-assisted features live — things like surfacing what needs attention in a pipeline, summarising deal context, and suggesting next steps. To be clear about the shape of that work: we are not training or serving models. These features are built on top of existing AI capabilities, and the engineering problem is the product plumbing around them — assembling the right context from CRM data, keeping latency and cost sane, handling failure and non-deterministic output gracefully, and making the results trustworthy enough for a customer to act on. You do not need an ML background; you need the judgement to build a reliable product feature on top of a probabilistic dependency.

lists.content:
• Own the full lifecycle of the Opportunities backend: translate business and customer needs into scalable, production-grade services
  • Design and evolve the data model for pipelines, stages, deals, and associated entities — getting consistency, throughput, and query patterns right
  • Build and scale APIs, event-driven workflows, and background jobs that handle high-volume writes, automations, and integrations
  • Tackle distributed systems concerns: idempotency, eventual consistency, race conditions, hot tenants, and noisy-neighbor isolation
  • Improve performance and reliability of large pipelines (millions of opportunities per workspace) through indexing, sharding, caching, and query optimization
  • Build the AI-assisted surfaces of Opportunities on top of existing AI capabilities — context assembly from CRM data, prompt and response contracts, caching, cost and latency budgets, graceful degradation when a call is slow, wrong, or unavailable, and a feedback loop for measuring output quality
  • Ship end-to-end when needed — including UI changes in Vue — without blocking on cross-functional handoffs
  • Instrument the system: logs, metrics, traces, and SLOs that make production behavior legible
  • Drive incident response, postmortems, and the engineering hygiene that keeps a high-traffic product healthy

• 4+ years building and operating production backend systems at scale
  • Strong fundamentals in data modeling (SQL and NoSQL), API design, and distributed systems
  • Hands-on experience with Node.js or Go in production
  • Track record of owning services end-to-end — design, build, deploy, on-call
  • Comfort working independently in ambiguous problem spaces with high ownership
  • Solid grasp of scalability, performance, and reliability trade-offs

• Experience building CRM, sales, pipeline, or workflow products
  • Worked on multi-tenant SaaS at scale (sharding, tenant isolation, fair-use limits)
  • Familiarity with event streaming (Kafka/Redis Streams), queues, and async processing
  • Exposure to MongoDB, Postgres, ElasticSearch, ClickHouse, or similar at non-trivial scale
  • Have shipped a customer-facing feature backed by an LLM or similar AI API — and have opinions on where it worked and where it did not. No modelling or ML-infrastructure background required
  • Frontend fluency in Vue.js — enough to ship a feature without a frontend partner
  • Strong product instincts and a portfolio or GitHub of shipped work

Node.js (NestJS), Go, Vue.js, MongoDB, Redis, Kafka / Pub-Sub, ElasticSearch — running on a distributed microservices architecture over Istio service mesh, with AI-assisted features built on top of existing AI/LLM APIs.

• Ships Opportunities features from idea to production with minimal cycle time
  • Builds services that stay reliable as workspaces grow from thousands to millions of deals
  • Makes sound trade-offs between speed, quality, and long-term maintainability
  • Ships AI-assisted features that customers actually trust — useful often enough to matter, and well-behaved when the underlying call is not
  • Raises the bar on data correctness, API design, and operational excellence for the product
  • Continuously sharpens the customer experience through iteration and instrumentation

This role emphasises deep backend ownership: designing data models, APIs, and distributed workflows that power pipelines, stages, automations, reporting, and integrations at scale. You will operate with high autonomy, turning ambiguous problems into production systems, with enough frontend fluency to ship the occasional UI surface without waiting on anyone.

Opportunities is also where a growing set of AI-assisted features live — things like surfacing what needs attention in a pipeline, summarising deal context, and suggesting next steps. To be clear about the shape of that work: we are not training or serving models. These features are built on top of existing AI capabilities, and the engineering problem is the product plumbing around them — assembling the right context from CRM data, keeping latency and cost sane, handling failure and non-deterministic output gracefully, and making the results trustworthy enough for a customer to act on. You do not need an ML background; you need the judgement to build a reliable product feature on top of a probabilistic dependency.

About the Role:

We are seeking an SDE-3 Backend Builder to own the CRM Opportunities product end-to-end. Opportunities is the deal and pipeline engine at the heart of our CRM — the system of record for every revenue motion our customers run, from lead conversion to closed-won.

This role emphasises deep backend ownership: designing data models, APIs, and distributed workflows that power pipelines, stages, automations, reporting, and integrations at scale. You will operate with high autonomy, turning ambiguous problems into production systems, with enough frontend fluency to ship the occasional UI surface without waiting on anyone.

lists.content:
• Own the full lifecycle of Opportunities backend: translate business and customer needs into scalable, production-grade services
  • Design and evolve the data model for pipelines, stages, deals, and associated entities — getting consistency, throughput, and query patterns right
  • Build and scale APIs, event-driven workflows, and background jobs that handle high-volume writes, automations, and integrations
  • Tackle distributed systems concerns: idempotency, eventual consistency, race conditions, hot tenants, and noisy-neighbor isolation
  • Improve performance and reliability of large pipelines (millions of opportunities per workspace) through indexing, sharding, caching, and query optimization
  • Ship end-to-end when needed — including UI changes in Vue — without blocking on cross-functional handoffs
  • Instrument the system: logs, metrics, traces, and SLOs that make production behavior legible
    Drive incident response, postmortems, and the engineering hygiene that keeps a high-traffic product healthy

• 4+ years building and operating production backend systems at scale
  • Strong fundamentals in data modeling (SQL and NoSQL), API design, and distributed systems
  • Hands-on experience with Node.js or Go in production
  • Track record of owning services end-to-end — design, build, deploy, on-call
  • Comfort working independently in ambiguous problem spaces with high ownership
  • Solid grasp of scalability, performance, and reliability trade-offs
  • Experience building CRM, sales, pipeline, or workflow products
  • Worked on multi-tenant SaaS at scale (sharding, tenant isolation, fair-use limits)
  • Familiarity with event streaming (Kafka/Redis Streams), queues, and async processing
  • Exposure to MongoDB, Postgres, ElasticSearch, ClickHouse, or similar at non-trivial scale
  • Frontend fluency in Vue.js — enough to ship a feature without a frontend partner
    Strong product instincts and a portfolio or GitHub of shipped work

• Ships Opportunities features from idea to production with minimal cycle time
  • Builds services that stay reliable as workspaces grow from thousands to millions of deals
  • Makes sound trade-offs between speed, quality, and long-term maintainability
  • Raises the bar on data correctness, API design, and operational excellence for the product
    Continuously sharpens the customer experience through iteration and instrumentation

About HighLevel
HighLevel is a cloud-based, all-in-one white-label marketing and sales platform that empowers marketing agencies, entrepreneurs, and businesses to elevate their digital presence and drive growth. We are proud to support a global and growing community of over 1 million businesses, from marketing agencies to entrepreneurs to small businesses and beyond. Our platform empowers users across industries to streamline operations, drive growth, and crush their goals.
HighLevel processes over 15 billion API hits and handles more than 2.5 billion message events every day. Our platform manages 470 terabytes of data distributed across five databases, operates with a network of over 250 micro-services, and supports over 1 million domain names.
 
Our People
With over 1,500 team members across 15+ countries, we operate in a global, remote-first environment. We are building more than software; we are building a global community rooted in creativity, collaboration, and impact. We take pride in cultivating a culture where innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated, and people come first, no matter where they call home.
 
Our Impact
Every month, our platform powers over 1.5 billion messages, helps generate over 200 million leads, and facilitates over 20 million conversations for the more than 2 million businesses we serve. Behind those numbers are real people growing their companies, connecting with customers, and making their mark - and we get to help make that happen.
Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts
 
About the Role
We’re looking for a Software Development Engineer III (SDE III) with strong backend expertise and enough full-stack capability to own features end-to-end.
 
 
Must-have skills:
Deep expertise in Node.js, MongoDB, Vue.js, and distributed systemsProven track record in building highly stable, scalable backend platformsComfortable contributing to the frontend when needed (this is not a UI-heavy role)
 
What the role is really about (backend-heavy): You’ll join our Wallet team that powers Wallet, Billing, Taxes, and related services. Your focus will be on foundational, platform-level work:Ensuring rock-solid system stability and performance under growing loadDriving scalability, tech debt reduction, security hardening, and cost optimization Solving complex distributed systems challenges that keep the entire Wallet ecosystem reliable and efficient.
 
This is a backend-first, full-stack role — you’ll spend most of your time on architecture, performance, and infrastructure while still being able to ship complete features when required. If you love deep backend problems and want to own the stability and scalability of a mission-critical product, this is for you.

  • Identify and fix systemic issues (crashes, time-outs, race conditions, memory leaks, etc.) to improve overall platform reliability.
  • Drive performance optimizations and cost-efficiency improvements (query tuning, caching strategies, indexing, reducing cloud spend).
  • Actively reduce technical debt by refactoring critical parts of the codebase, improving test coverage, and eliminating anti-patterns.

About HighLevel
HighLevel is a cloud-based, all-in-one white-label marketing and sales platform that empowers marketing agencies, entrepreneurs, and businesses to elevate their digital presence and drive growth. We are proud to support a global and growing community of over 1 million businesses, from marketing agencies to entrepreneurs to small businesses and beyond. Our platform empowers users across industries to streamline operations, drive growth, and crush their goals.
HighLevel processes over 15 billion API hits and handles more than 2.5 billion message events every day. Our platform manages 470 terabytes of data distributed across five databases, operates with a network of over 250 micro-services, and supports over 1 million domain names.
 
Our People
With over 1,500 team members across 15+ countries, we operate in a global, remote-first environment. We are building more than software; we are building a global community rooted in creativity, collaboration, and impact. We take pride in cultivating a culture where innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated, and people come first, no matter where they call home.
 
Our Impact
Every month, our platform powers over 1.5 billion messages, helps generate over 200 million leads, and facilitates over 20 million conversations for the more than 2 million businesses we serve. Behind those numbers are real people growing their companies, connecting with customers, and making their mark - and we get to help make that happen.
Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts
 
About the Role
We’re looking for a Software Development Engineer III (SDE III) with strong backend expertise and enough full-stack capability to own features end-to-end.

Deep expertise in Node.js, MongoDB, Vue.js, and distributed systemsProven track record in building highly stable, scalable backend platformsComfortable contributing to the frontend when needed (this is not a UI-heavy role)

Your focus will be on foundational, platform-level work:Ensuring rock-solid system stability and performance under growing loadDriving scalability, tech debt reduction, security hardening, and cost optimization Solving complex distributed systems challenges that keep the entire Wallet ecosystem reliable and efficient.
 
This is a backend-first, full-stack role — you’ll spend most of your time on architecture, performance, and infrastructure while still being able to ship complete features when required. If you love deep backend problems and want to own the stability and scalability of a mission-critical product, this is for you.

About the Role
 We are seeking a Senior Manager, Product Design to lead a high-performing team of product designers focused on AI-powered workflows that span our Product and Revenue product lines — the tools our customers rely on to communicate with their customers. This spans conversations, messaging, automation and intelligence surfaces that sit at the center of how agencies and SMBs run their businesses on HighLevel. You have spent 9+ years designing and leading complex products, including 3+ years managing designers, and are ready to guide a distributed team through ambitious, AI-driven product work.

This role will report to the Senior Director, Product Design and manage approximately 8–12 product designers across the United States and India. You will lead design execution across AI workflow surfaces that cut across our Product and Revenue pillars, helping teams turn customer needs, business goals and technical constraints into clear, useful product experiences for the conversations and communications that power our customers' businesses.

This is a craft-driven management role for someone who stays close to the work. You will not be the primary production designer, but you should have the taste, product judgment and design fluency to improve direction, sharpen decisions and coach designers — with particular fluency in designing for AI-assisted and AI-generated experiences.

We expect candidates at this level to demonstrate exceptional visual and interaction design judgment, strong systems thinking and the ability to grow designers through clear expectations, critique, direct feedback and practical coaching. You should care deeply about the standards that make product experiences feel refined, trustworthy and coherent at scale — especially where AI is shaping how customers communicate with their own customers.

Experience leading B2B SaaS, platform, CRM, marketing technology, workflow-heavy or SMB software experiences is highly valuable. Experience using AI-powered tools for exploration, prototyping, critique, synthesis, documentation or workflow acceleration is expected, as is experience designing AI-native product experiences (e.g., conversational AI, automation, agentic workflows, or generative communication tools). 
What You'll Do
Manage, coach and develop 8–12 product designers across US- and India-based teams.
Lead design execution for AI-powered workflows spanning Product and Revenue lines — the communication, messaging and automation experiences customers use to reach and engage their own customers.
Connect customer needs, business goals, technical constraints and product strategy across these cross-cutting AI workflow surfaces.
Set expectations for quality, accountability, collaboration, communication and delivery.
Keep designers focused on the highest-priority work, help them manage ambiguity and clarify what is expected, blocked or ready for decision.
Partner with Product, Engineering, Data, design leadership and the Senior Director, Product Design to shape roadmaps, clarify tradeoffs and improve outcomes across Product and Revenue AI initiatives.
Lead critiques, coaching conversations, quality reviews and launch-readiness discussions that improve usability, accessibility, interaction quality, visual consistency, design-system alignment and the quality of AI-assisted experiences.
Maintain workstream visibility through useful rituals, crisp updates and timely risk escalation.
Hire excellent talent, onboard designers and create clear development plans.
Use AI-powered tools and workflows to accelerate exploration, prototyping, synthesis, documentation and production collaboration without lowering the quality bar.
What We Are Looking For
9+ years of relevant product design, UX or product experience work, including 3+ years managing product designers.
Proven experience managing designers in complex B2B SaaS, platform, workflow-heavy or multi-product environments.
An exceptionally strong portfolio that demonstrates product judgment, systems thinking, customer empathy, high-quality execution and measurable product impact — ideally including AI-powered or AI-assisted product experiences.
Exceptional visual and interaction design judgment, with the ability to raise the quality of work across a team.
Strong management skills with individual contributors, including keeping designers focused, unblocked, accountable and connected to the broader goals of the work.
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to maintain visibility across workstreams and give leadership a clear view of progress, risks, tradeoffs and decisions.
Experience leading critique, coaching designers, giving direct feedback and helping teams make stronger product design decisions.
Working knowledge of design systems, accessibility standards, reusable patterns and scalable product experience decisions.
Strong product judgement and comfort balancing customer needs, business outcomes, technical constraints and speed of execution — particularly across cross-functional Product and Revenue initiatives.
Comfort designing for AI-native experiences: conversational interfaces, automation, agentic workflows or generative communication tools.
Proven ability to hire strong designers, develop existing talent, support career growth and performance manage team members who need additional support.
Experience managing distributed teams and working across time zones; experience working closely with India-based teams is highly valuable.
Familiarity with AI-assisted production tools and enthusiasm for using them thoughtfully to improve design quality, communication and velocity.
How You Work
You raise the bar for craft, visual sophistication, product quality and team execution.
You stay close enough to the work to improve decisions, not only track progress.
You teach designers how to recognize, critique and ship stronger product design, including for AI-powered experiences.
You keep work visible, focused and moving without turning management into bureaucracy.
You build trust through warmth, candor, accountability, direct feedback and respect for your teammates as people.
You enjoy leading collaboration across time zones and cultural contexts, including with US- and India-based teammates.
You communicate in ways that help distributed teams work with clarity, care, trust and momentum.
You think across product boundaries — connecting Product and Revenue workflows around a shared goal: helping our customers communicate better with their customers.
