Who You Are:
At most companies, affiliates are a channel. At HighLevel, they're the business. Our affiliate program drives the growth of the company, and getting them paid correctly and on time is not just a back-office function. It's a trust function.

You are the person who owns that. You'll run affiliate commissions and contractual payments end to end, across our entire affiliate base. Whether you’re triaging an issue, proactively analyzing the data, or walking a frustrated affiliate through why their commissions went up or down month over month, you are able to process data quickly and have confident, empathetic conversations with stakeholders. You're confident being the go-to when affiliates have a question about their money, and you ensure the right amounts get sent out the door.

This is a build role. You’ll collaborate closely with the current affiliate, endorsement, commission, revenue operations, data, and legal teams, and you'll create the standard and processes that the growing team runs on for years to come.

lists.content:
What You'll Be Doing:

  • Own the full payment lifecycle from signed agreement through payout, for commissions and contractual payments across our entire affiliate base

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for affiliates on anything commission or endorsement contract related. Be confident taking video calls, face calls, text messages, e-mails, etc., to be able to meet the affiliates where they are at

  • Build trust with affiliates who have questions or frustrations and have strong follow-through on ensuring audits, follow-ups, and new processes are implemented

  • Partner with Affiliate Managers to verify deliverable completion ahead of each cycle

  • Provide final sign-off on payment accuracy. You'll partner with your Revenue Operations counterpart on calculations and data extraction

  • Own payout disputes, clawbacks, refunds, chargebacks, duplicate accounts, and self-referrals end to end, and resolve them directly with the affiliate.

  • Apply HighLevel's affiliate program policies and agreement terms to payment decisions, and collaborate with affiliate compliance teams when needed

  • Build this into a documented, repeatable process that is not dependent on any one person; write the SOPs, the exception policy, and the calculation methodology, and automate the manual work over time.

  • Work cross-functionally with Affiliate, Revenue Operations, Finance, and Legal to maintain one source of truth everyone operates from and continuous improvement to the overall process.

    • Success in this role looks like:

  • 100% of affiliate commission and contractual payments going out on time, every cycle

  • Payout disputes resolved within a defined SLA instead of sitting open indefinitely

  • Zero affiliates lost to a competitor over a payment issue

  • A documented payout process and exception policy that holds up when you're out of office

    • What You'll Bring:

  • Strong bias-to action and accountability. You have extensive experience running a commission cycle end to end

  • Genuine comfort in customer-facing conversations, including hard ones about money, delays, prorations, and clawbacks.

  • The ability to explain a complicated finance situation in plain language to a stakeholder or an affiliate who does not work in finance.

  • Strong analytical judgment. You can review a full commission report, spot what's wrong, trace it to a root cause, and drive it to resolution before the payout cutoff.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to write clear yet concise instructions and documentation.

  • High integrity with confidential financial information


    • Experience/Education/Certifications Required:

  • 5+ years of related experience in commissions, partner or affiliate payouts, revenue operations, billing, or finance operations.

  • Advanced proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets.

  • Hands-on experience with payment or vendor management platforms such as RAMP, Bill.com, Tipalti, or similar.


    • Preferred:

  • Affiliate or partner program experience, particularly in SaaS.

  • Familiarity with affiliate tracking platforms such as FirstPromoter.

  • Exposure to FTC endorsement rules or partner program compliance.

  • Experience supporting internal or external audit on a payment or commission cycle.

Role Overview
The Sr. Director of Growth will lead the cross-functional growth organization within the Product team, focusing on optimising user acquisition, activation, retention, and monetisation. This leader will own the strategy and execution of growth initiatives that directly impact key company metrics such as trial-to-paid conversion, customer engagement, and churn reduction. You’ll work closely with Product, Marketing, Customer Success, and Product Marketing teams to identify high-leverage opportunities across the customer lifecycle, design scalable reward systems, and implement product experiences that drive sustained growth and user delight.

Key Responsibilities
Strategic Leadership: Define and execute a holistic product growth strategy aligned with company objectives, focusing on user activation, retention, and expansion

Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner effectively with Marketing, Customer Support, Product Marketing, Engineering, and Data Science to identify growth opportunities and deliver high-impact initiatives

Growth Mechanics Expertise: Design and deploy growth loops, reward systems, and game mechanics that create engagement, habit formation, and referral behaviors within the product ecosystem

Data-Driven Optimization: Identify and track the key upstream actions that influence core downstream business outcomes such as trial-to-paid conversion, customer lifetime value, and churn

Team Leadership: Lead and mentor a team of Product Managers and Growth Analysts, fostering a culture of experimentation, collaboration, and impact

Experimentation & Testing: Build a culture of rigorous A/B testing and rapid iteration across onboarding flows, pricing experiments, and product engagement funnels

SaaS B2B2C Growth: Leverage deep experience in SaaS B2B2C models to drive scalable product adoption across both business and end-user layers

Insights & Reporting: Collaborate with analytics and finance teams to translate growth performance data into actionable insights and executive-level reporting
Qualifications
 
10+ years of experience in Product Management, Growth, or Product-Led Growth roles within high-growth SaaS environments
5+ years in a senior leadership role managing Product Managers or cross-functional growth teams
Proven track record designing and optimizing growth loops, reward systems, and game mechanics that improve engagement and retention
Deep experience with SaaS B2B2C business models and the unique challenges of scaling multi-tenant customer networks
Expert at identifying high-value upstream actions that predict and influence downstream metrics such as activation, conversion, and churn
Strong analytical and experimental mindset - comfortable with hypothesis-driven testing, cohort analysis, and data-informed decision-making
Excellent communication, influence, and stakeholder management skills across technical and non-technical teams
Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, Economics, or related field; MBA or advanced degree preferred

lists.content:
Key Responsibilities  

  • Implementation Services Leadership: Own onboarding, Q&A and retention delivery across adoption, retention and product advisors, their managers, and the concierge function.

  • Customer Success Management Leadership: Lead CSM across the United States and India, including the segment model that runs from named strategic accounts down to pooled, AI-mediated coverage, and the renewal forecast that comes out of it.

  • Capacity & Coverage: Own the coverage model for a follow-the-sun, on-demand delivery organization — availability by window rather than average occupancy, adherence, and the capacity plan that funds it.

  • Early-Lifecycle Retention: Own retention end to end through the customer's first quarter. Most customers never work with a named success manager, so the durability of what happens in the room is the primary retention mechanism, not a handoff.

  • Raising the Middle: Move department-level performance and the size of the population you measure, rather than coaching the bottom quartile to average. Outliers are not the bar here; the median is.

  • Evidence-Based Staffing: Design and run the tests that answer how delivery should be staffed — senior versus non-senior advisors, call length, and which segments justify which motion — and let the results set the staffing shape rather than the other way around.

  • AI-Driven Efficiency: Operate within a flat headcount plan and make the efficiency case in numbers: what the organization would have needed without automation and AI-assisted delivery.

  • Cross-Functional Partnership: Partner across Revenue Growth, Support, Product and Revenue Operations on shared definitions, handoffs and one version of the funnel, so Customer Success and the rest of the business tell the same story.

  • Leadership Bench: Build and level up your leaders. You will decide whether and when to add a consolidating Director layer over Customer Success Management, and who should hold it.

  • Other duties may be assigned and/or modified as business needs change.



    • What Success Looks Like

    First 30 days. You can explain, with evidence, exactly where and why customers stop succeeding in their first quarter — which cohort, which product, which segment of the delivery organization. You have confirmed that the round-the-clock coverage model is genuinely covered, window by window. You have taken ownership of the in-flight staffing tests and made them measurable.

    Days 31–90. Department-level adoption performance is moving on a growing measured population, not a shrinking one. Delivery quality is properly instrumented, so it can be managed rather than sampled. The forward capacity plan is signed off with an efficiency narrative attached.

    Days 91–180. Early-lifecycle retention is off its plateau and holding. The staffing question is answered on retention outcomes rather than on activity metrics. Your leaders are operating a level above where they started, and you are running the organization through them.


    What You'll Bring

  • 12+ years in post-sales, customer success, implementation or service delivery leadership, including 5+ years leading leaders.

  • Experience running a 200+ person customer-facing delivery organization with a 24/7 or follow-the-sun coverage model, ideally spanning the United States and India.

  • You have owned a retention or time-to-value number at company level and can describe the specific mechanism you used to move it — not the dashboard you built to watch it.

  • You have run both a high-volume advisor or agent motion and a named-account customer success book, and you understand why they need different management systems.

  • Fluency in capacity modeling: occupancy, shrinkage, adherence and queue availability. You argue a staffing shape from data rather than from headcount requests.

  • Track record of improving throughput and outcomes during a period of flat or declining headcount.

  • You inherit strong managers well. You grow the people you are given rather than replacing them by default.

  • Experience serving SMB and agency customers at volume. Our customer is a marketing agency or a small business owner, not an enterprise procurement team.

  • Analytically self-sufficient — comfortable in the data, and willing to be wrong on the record about a forecast.

  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, remote-first global environment, managing multiple stakeholders.

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in a SaaS environment.

  • Proficiency with standard business tools (Google Suite, Zoom, Slack) and CRM or service platforms; familiarity with HighLevel is a plus.

About us
HighLevel is an AI-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate and scale. Today, HighLevel supports SMBs across 150+ countries, fueling community-driven growth rooted in real customer outcomes.

To date, businesses operating on HighLevel have generated over $7 billion in ecosystem value, demonstrating the impact of shared infrastructure at scale. By centralizing conversations, automation and intelligence into one system, we help businesses move faster, reduce complexity and execute efficiently.

Behind the platform, HighLevel powers more than 4 billion API hits and 2.5 billion message events daily. With 250 terabytes of distributed data, 250+ microservices and over 1 million domain names supported, our architecture is built for performance, resilience and long-term scalability.

Our people
With over 2,000 team members across 10+ countries, HighLevel operates as a global, remote-first organization built for speed and ownership. We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home.

Our impact
Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1.5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact. We're proud to be a part of that.

Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts


Who You Are
You are a post-sales operator who has run delivery at scale and knows that the work is won or lost in the middle of the organization, not at the extremes. You are equally comfortable in an executive conversation about capacity strategy and in a review of why a specific cohort of customers stopped succeeding in their third month. You thrive in ambiguity, move with urgency, and are known for improving outcomes without asking for more headcount.

About the Role
As Sr. Director, Customer Delivery you own the quality and the outcome of every live interaction HighLevel has with a customer after they buy — the scheduled onboarding call, the on-demand rooms that run around the clock, and the ongoing Customer Success Management relationship through renewal. You lead a global organization of advisors, senior advisors, customer success managers and their leaders across the United States and India.

You are measured on one thing above all: whether the customers who start with us are still with us, and successful, three months later and beyond. You will inherit strong, tenured leaders you did not hire, a delivery model that runs 24/7 across time zones, and a mandate to improve outcomes on a flat headcount plan. The role suits a leader who can hold both halves of the post-sale motion at once — a high-volume advisor floor where the unit of work is the call, and a named-account success book where the unit of work is the relationship — and who knows why those two things need different management systems.

HighLevel is hiring a Sr.Director of Product Pricing & Monetization to lead our company-wide approach to pricing, packaging, monetization, and customer research.

This person will help HighLevel answer four critical questions:

  • Who are our most important customer segments, and what outcomes are they trying to achieve?

  • Which products, capabilities, and services do those customers value most?

  • How should we package and price our offerings to align customer value with sustainable company growth?

  • How do we create a continuous customer-learning system that improves product, go-to-market, and strategic decisions?

    • You will sit at the intersection of Product, Finance, Data, Growth, Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, and Operations. You will combine customer research, behavioral data, market intelligence, financial analysis, and experimentation to shape HighLevel’s commercial strategy.

    This is not an advisory-only role. You will be expected to develop recommendations, build alignment, support implementation, measure results, and improve decisions based on what we learn.

    The role reports to the Chief of Staff and will have significant exposure to HighLevel’s executive leadership team.

Pricing and packaging strategy

  • Develop a clear, company-wide pricing and packaging strategy across subscription plans, product bundles, add-ons, usage-based capabilities, services, and new product launches.

  • Evaluate how HighLevel’s pricing architecture should evolve as the platform expands into new products, customer segments, and monetization models.

  • Identify the most appropriate value metrics for different parts of the platform, including where subscription, usage-based, account-based, feature-based, or hybrid pricing models may be appropriate.

  • Assess opportunities to improve plan differentiation, feature entitlements, upgrade paths, product bundling, and add-on attachment.

  • Build business cases for pricing and packaging changes, including expected impact on acquisition, trial-to-paid conversion, average revenue per customer, expansion, retention, gross margin, and lifetime value.

  • Develop principles and guardrails for discounts, promotions, trials, grandfathering, migrations, and price increases.

  • Partner with Finance and Data teams to model revenue impact, customer impact, adoption scenarios, and potential risks.

  • Create a prioritized monetization roadmap rather than treating pricing as a series of isolated decisions.

    • Customer research and insights

  • Build a continuous customer research program covering prospects, trial users, paying customers, expanded customers, churned customers, agency owners, affiliates, and the businesses operating within agency sub-accounts.

  • Establish a clear segmentation framework based on customer needs, behaviors, maturity, business models, use cases, value realization, and willingness to pay.

  • Lead qualitative and quantitative research, including customer interviews, surveys, concept testing, win/loss analysis, churn research, behavioral analysis, and willingness-to-pay studies.

  • Understand the jobs customers hire HighLevel to perform, the outcomes they value, the alternatives they consider, and the barriers that prevent them from adopting or expanding.

  • Create a centralized customer-insights repository so that research is accessible, reusable, and connected to company decisions.

  • Develop a regular cadence for sharing insights with Product, Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, and executive leadership.

  • Translate research into clear implications for product strategy, roadmap prioritization, positioning, onboarding, customer education, and go-to-market execution.

    • Experimentation and implementation

  • Design pricing, packaging, positioning, and offer experiments with clearly defined hypotheses, target segments, success metrics, and decision criteria.

  • Partner with Product, Growth, Engineering, Billing, Legal, Finance, Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success to operationalize approved changes.

  • Develop rollout strategies that account for existing customers, new customers, channel partners, affiliates, billing complexity, communications, and customer support.

  • Establish guardrails to ensure that monetization initiatives improve business performance without creating unacceptable deterioration in customer trust, conversion, adoption, or retention.

  • Build post-launch measurement plans and ensure that each major pricing or packaging decision generates reusable learning.

  • Monitor performance across metrics such as trial-to-paid conversion, plan mix, average revenue per customer, add-on attachment, expansion, downgrade rates, churn, net revenue retention, gross margin, and customer lifetime value.

    • Market and competitive intelligence

  • Maintain a structured view of pricing, packaging, positioning, and monetization trends across relevant SaaS, agency technology, CRM, marketing automation, communications, AI, and adjacent software categories.

  • Identify changes in customer expectations, competitive offers, business models, and emerging value metrics.

  • Distinguish between competitive signals that require action and those that should not influence HighLevel’s strategy.

  • Use market intelligence as one input alongside customer value, product strategy, economics, and HighLevel’s long-term differentiation.

    • Decision-making and organizational leadership

  • Establish a cross-functional pricing and monetization operating cadence, including clear decision rights, approval processes, and measurement standards.

  • Bring structure to complex decisions where customer needs, product strategy, technical constraints, and financial outcomes may conflict.

  • Present recommendations to senior leaders in a clear, commercially grounded, and decision-oriented manner.

  • Build alignment across functions while remaining willing to challenge assumptions and surface difficult trade-offs.

  • Initially operate as a hands-on leader and, as the function develops, help define and build the right team across pricing, monetization analytics, and customer insights.

  • Raise the organization’s overall capability in customer research, pricing strategy, experimentation, and value-based decision-making.

• 14+ years of experience across SaaS pricing, monetization, product strategy, customer insights, growth strategy, management consulting, corporate strategy, or related roles.

  • Significant direct experience leading pricing and packaging decisions for a B2B SaaS, platform, or technology company.

  • Demonstrated experience translating customer research and data into changes in product, pricing, packaging, or go-to-market strategy.

  • Strong understanding of SaaS business models, including subscription economics, usage-based pricing, expansion revenue, retention, gross margin, and customer lifetime value.

  • Experience working with multi-product or multi-tier offerings and navigating the impact of pricing changes on existing and new customers.

  • Strong quantitative and financial modeling skills, with the ability to develop scenarios, challenge assumptions, and make recommendations with imperfect information.

  • Experience with both qualitative and quantitative research methods, such as customer interviews, segmentation, surveys, willingness-to-pay analysis, concept testing, conjoint analysis, and behavioral data analysis.

  • Strong commercial judgment and the ability to balance customer value, growth, simplicity, operational feasibility, and long-term strategy.

  • Excellent executive communication skills, including the ability to turn complex analysis into a clear recommendation and decision.

  • A highly collaborative working style and a record of influencing Product, Finance, Data, Engineering, Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success leaders.

  • Comfort operating in a fast-moving environment where the operating model and analytical foundation may still need to be built.

  • A player-coach mentality: equally comfortable defining strategy, conducting customer interviews, reviewing analyses, building a business case, and supporting execution.

• Experience with product-led growth, free trials, self-serve acquisition, or hybrid product-led and sales-assisted models.

  • Experience with agency software, SMB software, CRM, marketing automation, communications, payments, AI products, or vertical SaaS.

  • Experience with ecosystems in which the direct customer serves or resells products to another end customer.

  • Experience with white-label products, reseller models, marketplaces, channel partners, or multi-sided platforms.

  • Experience launching usage-based products or monetizing high-variable-cost capabilities such as communications, payments, infrastructure, or AI.

  • Familiarity with SQL, experimentation platforms, business intelligence tools, or product analytics systems.

  • Experience building a pricing, customer insights, or monetization function from an early stage

In the first 90 days

  • Develop a clear understanding of HighLevel’s customer segments, current plans, product entitlements, monetization model, customer economics, and decision-making processes.

  • Complete an initial assessment of pricing and packaging opportunities, risks, customer pain points, and analytical gaps.

  • Establish a customer research agenda across trial users, paying customers, expanded customers, churned customers, agencies, affiliates, and sub-accounts.

  • Create an initial pricing and packaging opportunity backlog, distinguishing near-term improvements from longer-term strategic questions.

  • Establish a cross-functional pricing and monetization governance process.

    • Within six months

  • Deliver a practical customer segmentation and needs framework that is actively used by Product and go-to-market teams.

  • Establish a repeatable customer research and insight-sharing cadence.

  • Present a prioritized pricing and packaging roadmap supported by customer evidence, behavioral data, competitive context, and financial modeling.

  • Launch or support the launch of the first major pricing, packaging, or monetization initiative.

  • Implement reporting that connects pricing decisions to customer and business outcomes.

    • Within the first year

  • Establish a clear and scalable pricing architecture across HighLevel’s core platform, add-ons, and emerging products.

  • Build a trusted customer-insights capability that consistently informs product, go-to-market, and strategic decisions.

  • Create a repeatable process for researching, testing, launching, and evaluating monetization changes.

  • Deliver measurable improvement across one or more key outcomes, such as trial-to-paid conversion, plan mix, average revenue per customer, product attachment, expansion, retention, net revenue retention, or gross margin.

  • Build strong organizational confidence that major pricing and product decisions are grounded in customer value, sound economics, and rigorous learning.

HighLevel’s pricing and packaging decisions influence far more than revenue. They shape which customers we attract, how quickly customers understand the platform, which products they adopt, how agencies build businesses on top of HighLevel, and how effectively we can continue investing in customer value.

This role will help create the customer understanding and commercial discipline required for HighLevel’s next stage of growth.

 

The salary range for this position is $248000 - $322000 annually.

Who You Are: 
You have worked inside an affiliate, partner, or channel program — not just adjacent  to one. You understand how affiliates think, what motivates them, and what causes  them to disengage. 
You are a builder and a coach first. You get energy from watching a manager's  conversation quality improve week over week — not from presenting to executives
You write playbooks from scratch, design onboarding sequences, and build call  frameworks that real people actually use. 
You are data-aware. You can read an Olive AI dashboard, spot a no-show pattern,  and connect it to a coaching intervention. 
You are willing to travel and show up in person. This role requires event attendance,  in-person affiliate relationship building, and on-site team sessions. 
You have an existing network in the affiliate, partner, or digital marketing ecosystem.  You know people. You bring contacts. 
What You’ll Be Doing: 
HighLevel's affiliate channel is one of the most important growth levers in the business, servicing thousands of affiliate partners, a top-performing endorsed tier, and a team of Affiliate Managers  working daily to move partners from sign-up to their first trial and beyond. 
We are building the enablement infrastructure to match the scale of this channel. The Affiliate Enablement Manager will be the first dedicated resource for the affiliate org who is leveraging their extensive enablement background to equip our internal team first, then extend that excellence to the affiliate experience. 
This is a build role. You will be creating the foundation of knowledge and growth for the entire affiliate organization from the ground-up while collaborating with senior affiliate leadership. If you thrive in fast-moving environments, have a background in partnerships, affiliate programs, or channel sales  enablement, and believe that great coaching and onboarding are revenue levers, not overhead — this role is for you. 
You will: 
Own onboarding for every new affiliate manager joining the affiliate team, resulting in time-to-first-activation results amongst growing affiliate managers and “exams” to ensure proficiency is maintained across the entire organization 
Build a structured learning path: what does an affiliate manager need to know in their first 7 days,  30 days, and 90 days? Own the content, the sequence, and the checkpoints. 
Own a continuous, always-on enablement cadence for existing AFMs — not just new  hires — so product knowledge and call quality stay current as the team and the  platform both grow. 
Create and maintain a centralized internal resource hub — an always-current  repository of playbooks, SOPs, and tools that every AFM can access in seconds. 
Design and own the structured onboarding  experience for all new affiliates outside the endorsed tier 
Build and maintain the product knowledge baseline, establishing what a “qualified affiliate manager” knows about the product, the program, and strategies about our top affiliates 
Collaborate with Affiliate Partner individuals to build lifecycle communication sequences (email, SMS, in-app) that guide new affiliates from sign-up through first trial 
Work cross-functionally to ensure that the process for new affiliates is constantly being optimized for broader team goals 
Provide reports for senior leadership, finance, revenue operations, and other stakeholders as needed
Attend affiliate industry events, conferences, and meetups — representing GHL and  building direct relationships with existing and prospective affiliate partners. 
What You’ll Bring:
Willingness and ability to travel for events, affiliate meetups, and in-person team  sessions. 
Proficiency with CRM (HighLevel or similar), call intelligence tools (Olive AI, Gong, Chorus, or  equivalent), and communication/outreach platforms highly preferred.
Direct experience working inside a SaaS affiliate or partner program is highly preferred.
Strong English written and verbal communication.
Dallas-based or willing to travel to Dallas frequently. Frequent in-office presence expected. 
Experience/Education/Certifications Required: 
4–6 years of experience in affiliate program management, channel partner  enablement, sales enablement, or a directly adjacent role. 
Thorough experience building onboarding programs, call frameworks, or  coaching toolkits from scratch. 
Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, or equivalent practical  experience.

We're looking for a Senior Engineering Manager to lead the team building HighLevel's Payments Platform. This leader will own the execution, reliability, and evolution of the platform that powers checkout, subscriptions, payment orchestration, invoicing, and financial reconciliation at scale.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role where you'll partner closely with Product, Design, Finance, Support, Infrastructure, and other engineering teams to deliver reliable, secure, and scalable payment experiences. You'll build and grow a high-performing engineering team while driving technical strategy, operational excellence, and stakeholder alignment.

• 12+ years of experience building scalable backend distributed systems, including 5+ years working with Go
  • 5+ years of experience managing software engineering teams delivering large-scale backend platforms
  • Proven experience leading teams responsible for business-critical distributed systems with high availability and reliability requirements
  • Experience partnering with Product Managers and cross-functional stakeholders to define roadmaps, manage priorities, and deliver customer-facing capabilities
  • Strong track record of hiring, coaching, mentoring, and growing engineering talent
  • Deep understanding of distributed systems including event-driven architectures, asynchronous messaging, consistency models, idempotency, concurrency control, and resilience patterns
  • Experience with Kubernetes/GKE, GCP services (Pub/Sub, Redis, MongoDB/Firestore, ClickHouse), CI/CD, and cloud-native infrastructure
  • Strong understanding of API lifecycle management including protobuf, ConnectRPC/gRPC, versioning strategies, and contract testing
  • Experience driving engineering operational excellence through SLIs/SLOs, observability, incident management, disaster recovery, and capacity planning
  • Familiarity with security and compliance best practices including PCI, secrets management, data governance, and privacy controls
  • Excellent communication skills with experience presenting technical strategy, delivery updates, and architectural decisions to senior stakeholders and executives

• Team Leadership:
  • Team growth, hiring, mentoring, and performance management
  • Career development and succession planning
  • Engineering culture focused on ownership and continuous improvement

  • Platform Delivery
  • End-to-end execution of Payments Platform initiatives
  • Cross-functional roadmap planning and prioritization
  • Delivery predictability across multiple workstreams

  • Technical Excellence
  • Platform architecture evolution in partnership with senior technical leaders
  • Reliability strategy including SLIs, SLOs, capacity planning, and incident management
  • API governance, data lifecycle management, and operational excellence

  • Stakeholder Management
  • Product roadmap planning and execution
  • Executive communication and engineering updates
  • Cross-functional collaboration across Product, Infrastructure, Finance, Compliance, Support, and Security
  • Managing competing priorities while balancing customer outcomes and technical investments

- Lead and Grow a High-Performing Engineering Team:
  • Build, mentor, and scale a high-performing team of backend engineers
  • Create an environment of ownership, accountability, continuous learning, and technical excellence
  • Coach engineers through regular feedback, career development, performance management, and growth planning
  • Drive hiring strategy, interview quality, onboarding, and succession planning
  • Foster engineering best practices through design reviews, code quality, technical mentorship, and knowledge sharing

    • - Drive Execution & Delivery:
  • Own execution for the Payments Platform roadmap, ensuring predictable delivery across multiple concurrent initiatives
  • Balance business priorities with long-term platform investments, technical debt reduction, and reliability improvements
  • Coordinate cross-team dependencies while proactively identifying risks, blockers, and execution gaps
  • Lead sprint planning, roadmap planning, estimation, prioritization, and delivery reviews
  • Ensure engineering teams consistently deliver high-quality, maintainable software

    • - Partner with Cross-functional Stakeholders:
  • Work closely with Product, Finance, Compliance, Customer Success, Marketing, Infrastructure, and Security teams to translate business objectives into technical roadmaps
  • Communicate engineering tradeoffs, delivery timelines, risks, and technical decisions to executive stakeholders
  • Align multiple engineering teams around shared architectural decisions, platform capabilities, and operational goals
  • Drive roadmap planning while balancing customer impact, platform scalability, and engineering investments

    • - Own Platform Reliability & Operational Excellence:
  • Lead the team responsible for highly available, planet-scale payment infrastructure including checkout, subscriptions, payment orchestration, invoicing, ledger, and reconciliation services
  • Ensure the team designs resilient distributed systems using patterns such as:
  • Idempotency
  • Retry strategies
  • Circuit breakers
  • Saga/Outbox patterns
  • Graceful degradation
  • Multi-region failover
  • Champion production excellence through:
  • SLO ownership
  • Error budgets
  • Incident management
  • Disaster recovery planning
  • Capacity planning
  • Operational readiness reviews

    • - Drive Technical Strategy:
  • Partner with Staff and Principal Engineers to evolve platform architecture and technical direction
  • Guide architectural decisions around:
  • Domain Driven Design
  • API governance
  • Event-driven systems
  • Service boundaries
  • Data consistency models
  • Ensure engineering teams maintain strong engineering standards for API lifecycle management, schema evolution, observability, security, and platform reliability
  • Lead technical planning while balancing scalability, maintainability, delivery speed, and operational cost

    • - Champion Engineering Excellence:
  • Establish engineering standards for:
  • API design
  • Code quality
  • Testing strategy
  • CI/CD
  • Documentation
  • Operational readiness
  • Promote a strong engineering culture through design reviews, RFCs, ADRs, postmortems, and continuous improvement initiatives
  • Drive adoption of developer productivity improvements including service templates, automated testing, observability, and deployment tooling

We are looking for a Senior Engineering Manager to lead our Data Platform & Infrastructure team. This leader will own the strategy, execution, and evolution of the foundational data systems that power insights and our ecosystem.

You will lead a team of highly capable engineers responsible for building reliable, scalable, secure, and developer-friendly data infrastructure. This includes data ingestion and processing, data platforms, storage and compute, orchestration, observability, and the infrastructure that enables teams across the company to efficiently build and operate data-intensive products and applications.

This is a hands-on leadership role: you will set technical direction and organizational strategy while remaining close enough to the technology to make high-quality architectural decisions and guide the team through complex technical challenges.

Leadership & Team Management

  • Lead, recruit, and mentor an exceptional engineering team.
  • Direct data infrastructure strategy to drive business and product success.
  • Oversee resource allocation, including headcount and vendor budget planning.
  • Establish operational rhythms, goals, and execution frameworks aligned with core business outcomes.
  • Cultivate an inclusive environment focused on ownership, technical rigor, and continuous professional development.
  • Champion team morale, engagement, learning opportunities, and delivery velocity.

    • Data Engineering Strategy

  • Guide system architecture, data flow design, quality standards, and platform roadmaps.
  • Partner with Product and Data leadership to plan, sequence, and execute multi-quarter initiatives.
  • Define robust platform abstractions, APIs, and SLAs to streamline developer workflows and increase adoption.
  • Ensure infrastructure resilience through comprehensive monitoring, incident management, disaster recovery, and cost optimization.
  • Work cross-functionally with Security, Audit, and Analytics Engineering to deploy key capabilities and compliance controls.

    • Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Engage with Data, Product, and Finance partners to enable machine learning, experimentation, and business reporting.
  • Establish and enforce organization-wide standards for pipeline reliability, data security, and quality.

    • Technical Leadership

  • Advocate for automation, engineering best practices, and thoughtful trade-offs between execution speed and long-term scalability.
  • Thrive in fast-paced, ambiguous settings while cultivating senior technical leaders and building leadership succession through delegated autonomy, developing senior technical leaders and succession depth.

Required Qualifications

  • 10+ years of experience in software engineering, SRE or infrastructure, data platform engineering, or related fields.
  • 4+ years managing high-performing technical teams, growing and developing people
  • Deep expertise with Snowflake/Google BigQuery/Databricks or equivalent modern data warehousing systems and ecosystem of tools including Airflow, DBT etc.
  • Familiarity with Git and CI/CD workflows 
  • Strong understanding of data warehousing concepts and infrastructure workload management.

Role overview
We are seeking a Senior Manager, Product Design to lead design for HighLevel's core platform experiences, mobile experiences for native platforms and design system team. This role will report to the Senior Director, Product Design and manage approximately 8 product designers across the United States and India.
This is a craft-driven senior design manager role for someone who can help create a step change in HighLevel's design practice. The ideal candidate brings exceptional aesthetic judgment, visual craft and interaction-design taste, plus the leadership ability to turn those standards into better work from the team.
A major part of this role will be line managing the design system team and helping level up design system strategy and execution, in partnership with the Senior Director, Product Design, who owns the design system as part of their broader portfolio. The goal is not only better internal tooling, but major improvements to the UX/UI our customers experience every day.
HighLevel values velocity, ownership and practical innovation. We are actively adopting AI-assisted production workflows, including tools such as Cursor and Claude Code, and we are looking for design leaders who are curious about new ways of working and eager to help teams get to better results more quickly.
Product and design scope
You will lead design execution and quality across three connected areas:
Core platform experiences that help agencies and SMBs manage customers, work across accounts, navigate the product, configure settings and complete essential business workflows
Mobile experiences for native platforms that make HighLevel's most important workflows accessible, focused and effective for customers on the go
Design system strategy, execution and team practices, including AI-assisted production workflows, that help designers and engineers deliver a vastly better, more consistent customer experience
What you will lead
A team of approximately 8 product designers across US and India teams, including coaching, career development, performance management, prioritization and staffing
Design quality and execution across core platform experiences, native mobile surfaces and design system work
Line management for the design system team, in partnership with the Senior Director on design system strategy, priorities and adoption
A high-velocity operating rhythm for critiques, reviews, planning, feedback loops and cross-functional alignment
A meaningfully higher bar for aesthetic quality, visual design, interaction design, information architecture, product thinking and end-to-end usability

Manage, coach and develop approximately 8 product designers across US and India teams
Set clear expectations for quality, ownership, collaboration and delivery
Hire excellent talent, onboard new designers and help the team grow with intention
Elevate designers through coaching, stretch opportunities and clear development plans
Performance manage thoughtfully and directly when designers need additional support, sharper expectations or role calibration
Build a team culture that values speed, ownership, craft and customer impact

Raise the bar for design output across aesthetic quality, visual craft, interaction quality, product design thinking and customer-centered execution
Help create a step change in HighLevel's design practice by making quality standards sharper, more visible and more consistently applied
Lead critiques and quality reviews that improve the work before it reaches customers
Ensure major releases are grounded in clear user needs, thoughtful flows, durable interaction patterns and refined visual execution
Encourage responsible use of AI-assisted tools and workflows to accelerate exploration, prototyping, documentation and production collaboration
3. Core platform and mobile design leadership
Lead design execution across core platform experiences that support navigation, account management, configuration, workflow execution and customer operations
Guide mobile design for native platforms, ensuring the experience is focused, useful and appropriately adapted to mobile customer needs
Partner with Product and Engineering to clarify priorities, shape roadmaps, identify tradeoffs and maintain a high-quality customer experience
Connect work across desktop, mobile and shared platform surfaces so customers experience HighLevel as one coherent product
4. Design system leadership
Line manage the design system team and help evolve HighLevel's bespoke design system into a strategic accelerator for product quality, execution speed and customer experience
Partner with the Senior Director on design system strategy, priorities, governance and adoption across the broader product portfolio
Work horizontally across product, design and engineering teams to drive adoption of shared components, patterns and interaction standards
Reduce pattern drift across core platform and mobile experiences through clear guidance, reusable patterns and strong examples of the desired UX/UI quality
5. Cross-functional collaboration and business impact
Build strong operating partnerships with Product, Engineering, Data, Support and Customer Success
Represent design in planning, roadmap and delivery conversations with clarity and sound product judgment
Work effectively across time zones and cultures, especially between US and India teams
Model the pace, ownership and adaptability expected in a high-velocity product environment
Qualifications
9+ years of experience in product design, UX or related product experience disciplines, including 3+ years managing product designers
Proven experience managing designers across complex B2B SaaS, platform, mobile or multi-product environments
Exceptional aesthetic judgment, visual craft and interaction-design taste, with the ability to raise the quality of work across a team
Experience leading critique, coaching designers and helping teams make strong design decisions
Experience leading or line managing design system work, including component libraries, shared patterns, contribution models, documentation, governance or adoption across product teams
Experience managing distributed teams and working across time zones; experience working closely with India-based teams is a strong plus
Demonstrated ability to hire strong designers, develop existing talent and performance manage team members who need additional support
Strong product judgment and comfort balancing customer needs, business outcomes, technical constraints and speed of execution
Familiarity with AI-assisted production tools such as Cursor, Claude Code or exploratory "vibe coding" workflows, and enthusiasm for using them thoughtfully to improve design velocity and collaboration
Comfort operating in fast-paced, ambiguous environments with high ownership expectations
What success looks like
Core platform and mobile experiences become more cohesive, intuitive and polished across the customer journey
HighLevel's bespoke design system becomes a major force for better UX/UI, with clearer strategy, stronger execution, broader adoption and visible improvements to customer-facing quality
The team's design output shows a step change in aesthetic quality, visual craft, interaction models, information architecture and end-to-end product thinking
Designers receive clearer feedback, stronger coaching and better development support across both US and India teams
The team embraces AI-assisted workflows to explore faster, communicate ideas more clearly and deliver better outcomes without compromising quality
Product, Engineering and other partners experience Design as a clear, reliable and high-quality partner in shaping and shipping product work
Why HighLevel
Lead design for foundational product experiences used by millions of businesses
Manage and grow a talented team across US and India
Help level up design system strategy and execution across a broad product platform
Raise the bar for aesthetic quality, craft, interaction quality and product design excellence
Work with modern AI-assisted production tools and workflows in a culture that values velocity, ownership and practical experimentation
Competitive compensation, benefits and flexibility

data.descriptionPlain:
About us
HighLevel is an AI-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate and scale. Today, HighLevel supports SMBs across 150+ countries, fueling community-driven growth rooted in real customer outcomes.
To date, businesses operating on HighLevel have generated over $7 billion in ecosystem value, demonstrating the impact of shared infrastructure at scale. By centralizing conversations, automation and intelligence into one system, we help businesses move faster, reduce complexity and execute efficiently.
Behind the platform, HighLevel powers more than 4 billion API hits and 2.5 billion message events daily. With 250 terabytes of distributed data, 250+ microservices and over 1 million domain names supported, our architecture is built for performance, resilience and long-term scalability.

Our people
With over 2,000 team members across 10+ countries, HighLevel operates as a global, remote-first organization built for speed and ownership. We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home.

Our impact
Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1.5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact. We’re proud to be a part of that.
Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts
Who You Are: 
You are a sophisticated strategic visionary possessing the operational credibility required to influence senior Customer Success leadership. You demonstrate the intellectual rigor to architect high-fidelity organizational structures from the ground up, transforming unstructured challenges into scalable frameworks. You possess the capability to conceptualize rigorous KPI blueprints and long-range roadmaps while simultaneously mastering the granular execution of workflow optimization and data integrity. Leveraging data-driven skepticism, you foster institutional alignment across executive cohorts, thriving within institutional ambiguity to transform institutional gaps into verified operational excellence.
What You’ll Be Doing: 
Strategic Partnership & Executive Leadership Alignment
You are the embedded RevOps partner and strategic advisor to Implementation and Customer Success leadership. Your job is not to service requests — it is to make these organizations more effective by owning the operational and analytical layer they cannot build themselves.
Partner with the Sr. Director of RevOps and CS leadership to lead annual and quarterly planning — building bottoms-up operational plans grounded in real drivers, not just top-down targets
 Own forecasting frameworks across the CS organization — customer health trajectories, adoption milestones, churn risk signals, and expansion revenue potential
 Track actuals against plan with discipline — identify deviations early, diagnose root causes, and bring forward-looking recommendations rather than backward-looking summaries
Lead monthly and quarterly business reviews for CS leadership — owning the narrative, surfacing the strategic gaps, and driving action
Build the financial models and business cases that support investment decisions across the CS organization — new programs, new tooling, new headcount
Challenge assumptions with data — if CS leadership is making decisions based on instinct or anecdote, your job is to stress-test them with rigour
 
Implementation Operations
Implementation is a strategically important function within HighLevel's post-sale motion. Effective implementation drives measurable improvements in long-term customer outcomes — yet significant operational and strategic opportunities remain untapped. This role is accountable for building the RevOps foundation that unlocks those opportunities.
Own the full operational picture of the Implementation team — funnel metrics, engagement rates, completion rates, open office hours volumes, and downstream customer outcome correlation
Design and own the KPI framework for Implementation — defining what good looks like across every stage of the implementation journey and creating the measurement infrastructure to track it
Build the analytics layer that connects implementation activity to downstream customer outcomes — enabling leadership to make evidence-based decisions about where to invest and where to optimize
Identify strategic and operational gaps in how the Implementation program currently runs — and build the case for change with data, not just intuition
Own the RevOps relationship with the customer support platform (Freshdesk) — understand the system architecture, identify where it creates operational friction, and work proactively with the systems team to drive improvements
Flag data integrity issues, broken workflows, and reporting gaps to the systems team before they compound
Represent Implementation's operational needs in any tooling or platform investment discussions
Design and govern the process standards and documentation that give the Implementation organization operational consistency and institutional memory
Customer Success Operations
Customer Success at HighLevel is a high-potential, recently launched motion focused on driving product adoption, expansion revenue, and long-term retention for a specific customer segment. The function has strong early indicators but significant operational maturity headroom — this role is responsible for closing that gap.
Own the operational foundation for the Customer Success organization — processes, reporting infrastructure, KPI frameworks, and systems — building much of this from the ground up
Partner with CS leadership to define, align on, and operationalize the KPI framework for the team:
What does CSM effectiveness look like at HighLevel's scale?
◦       How is customer health measured and acted upon?
◦       What does meaningful engagement look like, and how is it tracked?
Build the analytics framework that connects CS activity to business outcomes:
◦       Customer health scoring and predictive churn signals
◦       Engagement depth and its correlation with retention
◦       Add-on and usage revenue attribution by CS activity type
◦       Cohort analysis of CS-engaged vs. non-engaged customer segments
Own the Success AI bot from a RevOps operational standpoint — track performance metrics, measure impact on customer experience and resolution quality, surface gaps between deflection rates and actual customer satisfaction, and work with the AI team on continuous improvement priorities
Design the operational cadences, escalation frameworks, handoff standards from Implementation, and renewal and expansion triggers that govern how CSMs manage their book of business
Partner with the systems team on CS tooling requirements — defining needs clearly, driving adoption, and ensuring data integrity
Retention Intelligence, Process Design & Organizational Leadership
One of the highest-value contributions this role can make is giving CS and Implementation leadership a clear, data-driven picture of what drives customer outcomes — and connecting that picture to business decisions.
Build and own the retention analytics framework — connecting team activity across Implementation and CS to downstream customer lifetime value, churn, and expansion outcomes
Develop the early warning system that gives CS and Implementation leadership proactive visibility into at-risk customers before churn becomes inevitable
Quantify the business impact of Implementation and CS at the leadership level — translating operational activity into revenue and retention outcomes that resonate at the executive level
Identify where product gaps are driving customer outcomes that CS and Implementation cannot fix through operational means alone — and surface those findings to Product with structured evidence
Feed CS and Implementation insights into the broader GTM customer lifecycle intelligence layer, in partnership with the GTM Strategy function
What You’ll Bring:
Analytically sharp — comfortable building retention models, cohort analyses, churn attribution frameworks, and health scoring methodologies from scratch
Strategic thinker with operational depth — sets direction and executes simultaneously
Proven ability to influence senior leaders — challenges assumptions with data, drives alignment without formal authority
Experience with customer-facing platforms (Freshdesk, Zendesk, Gainsight, Salesforce Service Cloud, or similar)
Proactive by instinct — surfaces what matters before it becomes urgent
Strong people leader — develops analysts, sets high standards, builds cultures of ownership
Comfortable building in ambiguity — creates structure from unstructured problems
Experience/Education/Certifications Required:
Possess 10+ years of professional trajectory across Revenue Operations, Customer Success Operations, or GTM Strategy, demonstrating high-fidelity expertise within sophisticated post-sale environments
Tier-1 MBA or institutional management consulting pedigree strongly prioritized; must demonstrate the intellectual rigor to architect solutions for complex organizational challenges with executive-level clarity
Proven track record of engineering Success Operations or Implementation frameworks from foundational stages to institutional scale
Demonstrated capability to establish the causal nexus between implementation velocity and quantifiable retention or revenue expansion outcomes
Sophisticated background in PLG or hybrid SaaS models, mastering the operational nuances where self-serve and high-touch assisted motions intersect
While specific certifications are not mandated, a verified history of strategic impact and operational excellence remains the primary benchmark for selection

Our impact
Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1.5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts
Who You Are: 
You are a high-level strategic architect who combines rigorous analytical frameworks with deep tactical expertise to navigate HighLevel's most intricate workflows. Rather than overseeing static processes, you thrive on architecting the future of the organization. Your dual-track capabilities allow you to design long-range operational strategies while meticulously optimizing granular technical bottlenecks. You possess the executive presence to influence senior leadership through data-backed insights, fostering consensus across departments. Furthermore, you distinguish meaningful automated outcomes from mere deflection, maintaining a sharp focus on quantifiable success metrics.

STRATEGIC PARTNERSHIP & LEADERSHIP ALIGNMENT
You are the embedded RevOps partner and strategic advisor to Support leadership. Your mandate is to make the Support organization more effective by owning the operational and analytical layer that connects their work to business outcomes.
Partner with the Sr. Director of RevOps and Support leadership to lead annual and quarterly planning — building bottoms-up operational plans grounded in real capacity drivers and demand signals
Own forecasting frameworks for the Support organization — ticket volume projections, channel mix trends, resolution capacity, and cost-per-resolution modeling
Track actuals against plan with discipline — identify deviations early, understand root causes, and bring forward-looking recommendations rather than backward-looking reports
Lead monthly and quarterly business reviews for Support leadership — owning the narrative, surfacing strategic gaps, and driving prioritized action
Build the financial models and business cases that support investment decisions — new tooling, AI capability expansions, channel investments, and headcount planning
Challenge assumptions with data — if Support leadership is making prioritization decisions based on instinct or anecdote, your job is to stress-test them with rigour and evidence
BUSINESS IMPACT FRAMEWORK — CONNECTING SUPPORT TO REVENUE OUTCOMES
This is one of the most strategically important mandates in this role. Support at HighLevel operates at scale — but the connection between support quality and the business outcomes that matter most (customer retention, lifetime value, churn) has not been formally built. You will build it.

Quantify the business impact of Support at the leadership level — translating operational metrics into revenue and retention outcomes that resonate at the executive level

Identify where recurring ticket patterns reveal product gaps, friction points, or customer experience failures — and surface structured findings to Product and GTM leaders with clear business impact framing
Feed Support intelligence into the broader GTM customer lifecycle analytics layer, in partnership with the GTM Strategy function
Establish Support as a strategic contributor to retention decisions — not just an operational function measured on speed and volume

Work with the AI/Innovation team on continuous improvement priorities — bringing structured operational findings, edge cases, and quality gaps that should inform the next phase of AI capability development
Identify where automation can reduce manual operational overhead within the Support RevOps function itself — and implement those automations proactively
Partner with the AI/Innovation team on the roadmap for Support AI expansion — providing the operational intelligence and requirements that should shape future AI investments
Process Design, Systems & Data Infrastructure
Audit and redesign operational workflows across the Support organization — from ticket routing and triage logic to escalation pathways and resolution standards
Define and govern handoff standards between Support tiers and between Support and other GTM functions — ensuring customers do not fall through the cracks as they move between channels and teams
Design process documentation standards for the Support organization — every key workflow should be documented, version-controlled, and accessible

Partner with the RevOps systems team and the AI/Innovation team to ensure the Support organization has the tools, data pipelines, and automation infrastructure it needs to operate at scale
Own data integrity for the Support organization — clean metric definitions, consistent tagging and categorization, and reliable reporting pipelines across all support platforms
Define requirements for tooling investments — translating operational needs into clear specifications for build vs. buy decisions
 
What You’ll Bring:
Possess exceptional analytical rigor with the ability to engineer complex fiscal models, operational frameworks, and bottom-line impact evaluations from the ground up
Act as a strategic visionary possessing deep tactical expertise, capable of architecting long-range directions while simultaneously mastering granular execution
Demonstrate the executive presence required to influence senior leadership, leveraging data-driven skepticism to foster institutional alignment and challenge status-quo assumptions
Deep experience navigating sophisticated service-centric ecosystems and omnichannel engagement platforms such as Freshdesk, Zoom, or similar enterprise solutions
Proficient in optimizing AI-driven automation workflows, maintaining a sharp focus on distinguishing verified problem resolution from superficial ticket deflection
Instinctively proactive, with a disciplined approach to surfacing critical operational trends and risks before they escalate into urgent bottlenecks
Exceptional people leader dedicated to cultivating high-performing analyst cohorts through extreme ownership, rigorous standards, and strategic foresight
Thrive within institutional ambiguity, possessing the architect’s mindset to transform unstructured challenges into scalable, high-fidelity organizational structures 
 
Experience/Education/Certifications Required:
Possess 10+ years of professional trajectory within Revenue, Support, or Customer Success Operations, demonstrating significant mastery in managing high-volume, client-centric GTM ecosystems
Tier-1 MBA or a background in management consulting is highly preferred, emphasizing the analytical rigor required to engineer solutions for complex operational bottlenecks and engage leadership with executive clarity
Proven architect who has designed and scaled support operations infrastructure within expansive, enterprise-grade environments from the ground up
Deep expertise in establishing the causal nexus between service excellence metrics and quantifiable bottom-line outcomes like customer retention and revenue health
Operational mastery of AI-driven automation workflows, with a disciplined focus on verifying resolution throughput, quality auditing, and deflection efficacy
Significant experience navigating high-velocity SaaS landscapes where scaling requires the ability to architect robust frameworks while managing real-time institutional ambiguity
 Formal certifications are secondary to a documented history of driving high-fidelity organizational impact and strategic foresight

Who You Are: 
You are a high-level strategic architect who combines rigorous analytical frameworks with deep tactical expertise to navigate HighLevel's most intricate workflows. Rather than overseeing static processes, you thrive on architecting the future of the organization. Your dual-track capabilities allow you to design long-range operational strategies while meticulously optimizing granular technical bottlenecks. You possess the executive presence to influence senior leadership through data-backed insights, fostering consensus across departments. Furthermore, you distinguish meaningful automated outcomes from mere deflection, maintaining a sharp focus on quantifiable success metrics.
 
What You’ll Be Doing: 
STRATEGIC PARTNERSHIP & LEADERSHIP ALIGNMENT
You are the embedded RevOps partner and strategic advisor to Support leadership. Your mandate is to make the Support organization more effective by owning the operational and analytical layer that connects their work to business outcomes.
Partner with the Sr. Director of RevOps and Support leadership to lead annual and quarterly planning — building bottoms-up operational plans grounded in real capacity drivers and demand signals
Own forecasting frameworks for the Support organization — ticket volume projections, channel mix trends, resolution capacity, and cost-per-resolution modeling
Track actuals against plan with discipline — identify deviations early, understand root causes, and bring forward-looking recommendations rather than backward-looking reports
Lead monthly and quarterly business reviews for Support leadership — owning the narrative, surfacing strategic gaps, and driving prioritized action
Build the financial models and business cases that support investment decisions — new tooling, AI capability expansions, channel investments, and headcount planning
Challenge assumptions with data — if Support leadership is making prioritization decisions based on instinct or anecdote, your job is to stress-test them with rigour and evidence
BUSINESS IMPACT FRAMEWORK — CONNECTING SUPPORT TO REVENUE OUTCOMES
This is one of the most strategically important mandates in this role. Support at HighLevel operates at scale — but the connection between support quality and the business outcomes that matter most (customer retention, lifetime value, churn) has not been formally built. You will build it.
Design and own the analytical framework that connects Support activity and quality to downstream customer outcomes — retention rates, churn signals, and customer lifetime value
Quantify the business impact of Support at the leadership level — translating operational metrics into revenue and retention outcomes that resonate at the executive level
Build the early warning system that gives Support leadership visibility into customer health signals emerging through support interactions — before they become retention problems
Identify where recurring ticket patterns reveal product gaps, friction points, or customer experience failures — and surface structured findings to Product and GTM leaders with clear business impact framing
Feed Support intelligence into the broader GTM customer lifecycle analytics layer, in partnership with the GTM Strategy function
Establish Support as a strategic contributor to retention decisions — not just an operational function measured on speed and volume
SUPPORT OPERATIONS — PERFORMANCE MANAGEMENT & ANALYTICS
The Support organization runs a sophisticated tiered operation across multiple channels and time zones. Building the RevOps layer that gives leadership real-time operational intelligence is a core deliverable of this role.
Own the KPI framework for the Support organization — defining what good looks like across CSAT, turnaround time, resolution quality, first contact resolution, escalation rates, and tier distribution
Build and maintain the analytics infrastructure that gives Support leadership visibility into team and channel performance at the granularity they need to make operational decisions
Track performance across L1, L2, and L3 tiers — identifying where escalation patterns reveal training gaps, process breakdowns, or product complexity issues
Own channel performance analytics — how are ticket volumes, resolution rates, and customer satisfaction scores distributed across chat, platform, and live Zoom channels, and what does the optimal channel mix look like
Build cost efficiency models — cost per resolution, cost by channel, cost by tier — enabling leadership to make evidence-based decisions about where to invest and where to optimize
Design and govern the operating cadences that keep Support leadership aligned, informed, and action-oriented — weekly business reviews, performance reviews, and escalation governance
AI & AUTOMATION — STRATEGIC OPERATIONS
HighLevel has deployed AI-assisted support tooling that is already delivering meaningful results at scale. This role is responsible for ensuring that investment continues to grow in impact — not just in volume.
Own the RevOps operational layer for the Support AI bot — tracking deflection performance, measuring impact on customer satisfaction and resolution quality, and identifying where AI is creating gaps versus solving them
Build the measurement framework that distinguishes between AI deflection (a ticket was not raised) and AI resolution (a customer's problem was actually solved) — and track both with rigour
Work with the AI/Innovation team on continuous improvement priorities — bringing structured operational findings, edge cases, and quality gaps that should inform the next phase of AI capability development
Identify where automation can reduce manual operational overhead within the Support RevOps function itself — and implement those automations proactively
Partner with the AI/Innovation team on the roadmap for Support AI expansion — providing the operational intelligence and requirements that should shape future AI investments
Process Design, Systems & Data Infrastructure
Audit and redesign operational workflows across the Support organization — from ticket routing and triage logic to escalation pathways and resolution standards
Define and govern handoff standards between Support tiers and between Support and other GTM functions — ensuring customers do not fall through the cracks as they move between channels and teams
Design process documentation standards for the Support organization — every key workflow should be documented, version-controlled, and accessible
Lead change management for new processes and systems — adoption is the measure of success, not design
Identify and eliminate operational redundancies — the Support organization operates at a scale where small inefficiencies compound significantly
Partner with the RevOps systems team and the AI/Innovation team to ensure the Support organization has the tools, data pipelines, and automation infrastructure it needs to operate at scale
Own data integrity for the Support organization — clean metric definitions, consistent tagging and categorization, and reliable reporting pipelines across all support platforms
Define requirements for tooling investments — translating operational needs into clear specifications for build vs. buy decisions
 
What You’ll Bring:
Possess exceptional analytical rigor with the ability to engineer complex fiscal models, operational frameworks, and bottom-line impact evaluations from the ground up
Act as a strategic visionary possessing deep tactical expertise, capable of architecting long-range directions while simultaneously mastering granular execution
Demonstrate the executive presence required to influence senior leadership, leveraging data-driven skepticism to foster institutional alignment and challenge status-quo assumptions
Deep experience navigating sophisticated service-centric ecosystems and omnichannel engagement platforms such as Freshdesk, Zoom, or similar enterprise solutions
Proficient in optimizing AI-driven automation workflows, maintaining a sharp focus on distinguishing verified problem resolution from superficial ticket deflection
Instinctively proactive, with a disciplined approach to surfacing critical operational trends and risks before they escalate into urgent bottlenecks
Exceptional people leader dedicated to cultivating high-performing analyst cohorts through extreme ownership, rigorous standards, and strategic foresight
Thrive within institutional ambiguity, possessing the architect’s mindset to transform unstructured challenges into scalable, high-fidelity organizational structures 
 
Experience/Education/Certifications Required:
Possess 10+ years of professional trajectory within Revenue, Support, or Customer Success Operations, demonstrating significant mastery in managing high-volume, client-centric GTM ecosystems
Tier-1 MBA or a background in management consulting is highly preferred, emphasizing the analytical rigor required to engineer solutions for complex operational bottlenecks and engage leadership with executive clarity
Proven architect who has designed and scaled support operations infrastructure within expansive, enterprise-grade environments from the ground up
Deep expertise in establishing the causal nexus between service excellence metrics and quantifiable bottom-line outcomes like customer retention and revenue health
Operational mastery of AI-driven automation workflows, with a disciplined focus on verifying resolution throughput, quality auditing, and deflection efficacy
Significant experience navigating high-velocity SaaS landscapes where scaling requires the ability to architect robust frameworks while managing real-time institutional ambiguity
 Formal certifications are secondary to a documented history of driving high-fidelity organizational impact and strategic foresight
