lists.content:
● Build and activate an initial pipeline of MSP relationships, leveraging your established  industry network to accelerate HighLevel's entry into the MSP market. 

● Identify and segment the MSP profiles most likely to succeed with HighLevel and  continuously refine the ideal customer/partner profile based on real-world market  feedback. 

● Own the MSP relationship lifecycle from initial outreach and discovery through  onboarding, activation, revenue generation, retention, and expansion.

● Conduct direct conversations with MSP owners and leaders to test positioning,  uncover business needs, understand objections, and identify product, integration,  enablement, or commercial gaps. 

● Help develop and validate the HighLevel value proposition specifically for the MSP  market. 

● Partner with Affiliate Programs, Product Marketing, Enablement, Marketplace, Product,  and other internal teams to develop the messaging, onboarding, enablement, and  infrastructure required to support the MSP motion. 

● Learn HighLevel's affiliate ecosystem and identify creative opportunities to connect  affiliate-led growth strategies and economics with the traditional MSP business  model. 

● Help build, document, and continuously improve the MSP GTM playbook based on  market feedback, experiments, wins, losses, and performance data. 

● Identify ecosystem applications and integrations that materially strengthen the  HighLevel value proposition for MSPs, improve adoption, or create additional revenue  opportunities. 

● Develop early lighthouse MSP relationships that can provide market validation,  feedback, advocacy, case studies, and future expansion opportunities.

● Track MSP pipeline, activation, revenue performance, market feedback, and key  learnings, providing actionable recommendations on where HighLevel should invest  next. 

● Operate with a test learn adjust scale mentality, moving quickly while maintaining strong communication and cross-functional alignment. 

● Represent HighLevel at approximately 1–2 relevant MSP industry events per quarter,  using events to build relationships, generate qualified opportunities, gather market  intelligence, strengthen HighLevel's presence within the MSP community, and support  development of the MSP GTM motion.

● An established and active network of relationships with MSP owners, executives, and  business leaders, with demonstrated ability to open doors and develop commercial  relationships. 

● Deep understanding of the MSP ecosystem, including how MSPs operate, monetize  services, build recurring revenue, evaluate technology, and make vendor decisions. ● Demonstrated experience building pipeline and developing new business  relationships rather than solely managing established accounts. 

● A strong builder mentality with experience operating in fast-moving, high-growth,  startup, or zero-to-one environments. 

● Comfort working without a fully established playbook and the ability to help create  one through hands-on execution, experimentation, and market learning.

● Strong commercial instincts and the ability to translate market feedback into  actionable GTM recommendations.

● Curiosity about affiliate-led growth and a willingness to learn HighLevel's affiliate  ecosystem and experiment with how affiliate and MSP models can complement one  another. 

● Excellent communication skills with the ability to influence both internal and external  stakeholders. 

● Ability to work cross-functionally across Affiliate Programs, Marketing, Product  Marketing, Enablement, Product, and Marketplace teams. 

● Ability to analyze relationship performance, pipeline, activation, and revenue data and turn those insights into action. 

● Willingness and ability to travel approximately 1–2 times per quarter for relevant MSP  industry events, meetings, and relationship-building opportunities. 

Experience/Education/Certifications Required: 

● 5+ years of relevant experience working directly within the MSP ecosystem, MSP focused technology, SaaS partnerships, channel development, business development, or a related role. 

Preferred: 

● Familiarity with SaaS platforms, APIs, integrations, and technical ecosystem concepts.

● Experience with vertical SaaS, platform ecosystems, or product-led growth  environments. 

Additional Information 

What Success Looks Like 

Success in this role is not measured simply by the number of MSP relationships created. The  goal is to help HighLevel determine how to build a scalable, productive MSP go-to-market  motion. 

Early success will include: 

● Quickly activating an initial network of qualified MSP conversations.

● Helping validate and refine HighLevel's MSP ideal profile and value proposition.

● Establishing early lighthouse MSP relationships and generating measurable pipeline  and activation. 

● Identifying the product, integration, enablement, and commercial requirements  necessary to make HighLevel successful within the MSP ecosystem. 

● Developing repeatable recruitment, onboarding, activation, and expansion practices.

● Translating early market learning into the first version of HighLevel's MSP GTM  playbook. 

● Identifying opportunities where HighLevel's existing affiliate model can create a  differentiated approach within the MSP market.

● Demonstrating a clear path from initial market validation to a scalable new growth  motion.

Role Overview
HighLevel's AI portfolio spans more than a dozen products, from conversational and voice agents that handle customer interactions on a business's behalf to copilots that help operators run the business itself. These products are sold both as a bundled subscription and on a pay-per-use basis, across a base of more than a million sub-accounts.
As Senior Product Analyst for AI Products, you will own the measurement of that portfolio. You will run the recurring business review, maintain the metric definitions for each product, report performance against the operating plan, and analyse retention, adoption and the unit economics of AI usage. Your work will inform the AI roadmap and will feed into quarterly and board-level reviews.
The role is hands-on. You will write SQL against ClickHouse and Snowflake, build the reporting layer in Superset, and take responsibility for whether a figure is correct before anyone acts on it. You will work directly with the VP of Product and with the product managers who own each AI product, and we will expect you to form a view on what the data means and to defend it.
Key Responsibilities
Run the recurring business review for the AI portfolio, from building the underlying analysis through to presenting the results to product leadership.
Define and document the metrics for each AI product, including activation, adoption, the north star metric and penetration, and keep those definitions consistent across every report.
Build and maintain the Superset datasets, charts and dashboards the AI team depends on, and audit the existing reporting for hardcoded filters, stale queries and definitions that have drifted.
Write SQL against ClickHouse and Snowflake, including against semi-structured JSON columns, to answer the questions our dashboards cannot.
Report each product's performance against the annual operating plan and subsequent re-forecasts, and explain the variances in terms of what happened in the product.
Analyse retention, cohort behaviour and adoption funnels at the sub-account level, and establish where and why accounts stop using a product.
Build the unit economics of AI usage, converting token consumption into cost by model and reporting cost-to-revenue ratio and margin by product.
Report on AI product quality, covering version-over-version evaluation results, containment and escalation rates, and the sampling design behind those figures.
Reconcile figures that disagree between sources, and decide which source should be used to answer which question.
Specify instrumentation with product managers before a feature ships, analyse in-product behaviour in Pendo once it has, and size the opportunities and experiments that go into the roadmap.
Ideal Candidate Profile
At least six years of experience in product or business analytics, including time spent working directly with product teams.
Strong SQL skills. You should be able to write multi-CTE queries, window functions and cohort logic without assistance, query semi-structured JSON in Snowflake, and move into Python or R for the work SQL cannot do.
Production experience with a cloud data warehouse, ideally ClickHouse and Snowflake.
The ability to author in Superset or Tableau, including building datasets and dashboards, and to open an existing chart definition and work out what it actually measures.
Experience with a product analytics tool such as Pendo, Amplitude or Mixpanel, including defining events and tracking plans.
Experience owning a recurring metrics pack or business review that other people depended on.
Careful attention to data grain and time period. You should check whether a figure is measured at the account or sub-account level before using it, and recognise what an incomplete period does to a cohort table.
A good command of SaaS metrics, including MRR and ARR movements, expansion and contraction, churn, retention and ARPU.
Enough statistical grounding to size and read an experiment honestly, and to say when a result is too noisy to act on.
Clear written English. A large part of this job is explaining an analysis in a short piece of writing that a busy reader can act on.
Bonus Points For
Experience analysing an AI or LLM product, particularly token consumption, model cost and quality evaluation.
Familiarity with usage-based or hybrid pricing models and the reporting problems they create.
Experience with dbt or a comparable transformation layer.
A background in CRM, agency or SMB SaaS products.
Experience with subscription analytics tools such as ChartMogul.
Why Join HighLevel?
At HighLevel, we foster an exciting and dynamic work environment driven by a passionate team. We believe in a collective responsibility where no task is considered someone else's job. Our unwavering focus is on providing value to our users, and we achieve this by delivering solutions swiftly through lean principles, allowing us to bring products to market in weeks rather than quarters. Every good idea is put to the test, ensuring that we maintain a high standard of innovation. We prioritise the well-being of our team, recognising that by taking care of them, they can better serve our users. We embrace the concept of continuous and iterative improvement, understanding that progress is an ongoing journey. We are also a well-funded and profitable company.

We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Role Overview

HighLevel's AI portfolio spans more than a dozen products, from conversational and voice agents that handle customer interactions on a business's behalf to copilots that help operators run the business itself. These products are sold both as a bundled subscription and on a pay-per-use basis, across a base of more than a million sub-accounts.

As Senior Product Analyst for AI Products, you will own the measurement of that portfolio. You will run the recurring business review, maintain the metric definitions for each product, report performance against the operating plan, and analyse retention, adoption and the unit economics of AI usage. Your work will inform the AI roadmap and will feed into quarterly and board-level reviews.

The role is hands-on. You will write SQL against ClickHouse and Snowflake, build the reporting layer in Superset, and take responsibility for whether a figure is correct before anyone acts on it. You will work directly with the VP of Product and with the product managers who own each AI product, and we will expect you to form a view on what the data means and to defend it.

Key Responsibilities

  • Run the recurring business review for the AI portfolio, from building the underlying analysis through to presenting the results to product leadership.

  • Define and document the metrics for each AI product, including activation, adoption, the north star metric and penetration, and keep those definitions consistent across every report.

  • Build and maintain the Superset datasets, charts and dashboards the AI team depends on, and audit the existing reporting for hardcoded filters, stale queries and definitions that have drifted.

  • Write SQL against ClickHouse and Snowflake, including against semi-structured JSON columns, to answer the questions our dashboards cannot.

  • Report each product's performance against the annual operating plan and subsequent re-forecasts, and explain the variances in terms of what happened in the product.

  • Analyse retention, cohort behaviour and adoption funnels at the sub-account level, and establish where and why accounts stop using a product.

  • Build the unit economics of AI usage, converting token consumption into cost by model and reporting cost-to-revenue ratio and margin by product.

  • Report on AI product quality, covering version-over-version evaluation results, containment and escalation rates, and the sampling design behind those figures.

  • Reconcile figures that disagree between sources, and decide which source should be used to answer which question.

  • Specify instrumentation with product managers before a feature ships, analyse in-product behaviour in Pendo once it has, and size the opportunities and experiments that go into the roadmap.

Ideal Candidate Profile

  • At least six years of experience in product or business analytics, including time spent working directly with product teams.

  • Strong SQL skills. You should be able to write multi-CTE queries, window functions and cohort logic without assistance, query semi-structured JSON in Snowflake, and move into Python or R for the work SQL cannot do.

  • Production experience with a cloud data warehouse, ideally ClickHouse and Snowflake.

  • The ability to author in Superset or Tableau, including building datasets and dashboards, and to open an existing chart definition and work out what it actually measures.

  • Experience with a product analytics tool such as Pendo, Amplitude or Mixpanel, including defining events and tracking plans.

  • Experience owning a recurring metrics pack or business review that other people depended on.

  • Careful attention to data grain and time period. You should check whether a figure is measured at the account or sub-account level before using it, and recognise what an incomplete period does to a cohort table.

  • A good command of SaaS metrics, including MRR and ARR movements, expansion and contraction, churn, retention and ARPU.

  • Enough statistical grounding to size and read an experiment honestly, and to say when a result is too noisy to act on.

  • Clear written English. A large part of this job is explaining an analysis in a short piece of writing that a busy reader can act on.

Bonus Points For

  • Experience analysing an AI or LLM product, particularly token consumption, model cost and quality evaluation.

  • Familiarity with usage-based or hybrid pricing models and the reporting problems they create.

  • Experience with dbt or a comparable transformation layer.

  • A background in CRM, agency or SMB SaaS products.

  • Experience with subscription analytics tools such as ChartMogul.

Why Join HighLevel?

At HighLevel, we foster an exciting and dynamic work environment driven by a passionate team. We believe in a collective responsibility where no task is considered someone else's job. Our unwavering focus is on providing value to our users, and we achieve this by delivering solutions swiftly through lean principles, allowing us to bring products to market in weeks rather than quarters. Every good idea is put to the test, ensuring that we maintain a high standard of innovation. We prioritise the well-being of our team, recognising that by taking care of them, they can better serve our users. We embrace the concept of continuous and iterative improvement, understanding that progress is an ongoing journey. We are also a well-funded and profitable company.

We are seeking a Senior Product Designer who can elevate HighLevel's product experiences through exceptional craft, product judgment and strong execution. You have spent 5+ years designing complex digital products and are ready to own meaningful work from early ambiguity through shipped outcomes.
As a senior individual contributor, you will partner closely with product managers, engineers, researchers, data partners and other designers on cross-functional teams that own and improve key product experiences across the HighLevel platform. You will connect customer needs, business goals and technical constraints to clear, useful and highly polished product design.
We expect candidates at this level to demonstrate exceptional visual and interaction design judgment, practical systems thinking and the ability to carry work from discovery through delivery. What You'll Do
Own meaningful product areas from discovery through delivery, translating customer needs, business goals and technical constraints into clear experience direction
Partner with product managers, engineers, researchers, data partners and designers to define, test and ship polished product experiences at scale
Use qualitative and quantitative insight to make design decisions and improve outcomes
Create wireframes, prototypes, high-fidelity designs, interaction specifications and production-ready documentation
Design clear workflows, edge cases and failure states that help customers complete complex tasks with confidence
Strengthen design-system adoption and help teams use shared patterns across surfaces, devices and locales
Lead through ambiguity by iterating quickly, using feedback well and raising quality through critique, pairing and clear rationale
Support junior designers and partner teams with practical design guidance
Collaborate effectively across US and India time zones in a 100% remote environment
What We Are Looking For
5+ years of relevant product design experience, ideally in B2B SaaS, platform, CRM, workflow-heavy or similarly complex digital product environments
An exceptionally strong portfolio that demonstrates product judgment, systems thinking, customer empathy, high-quality execution and measurable product impact
Proven experience across the design lifecycle, including research, information architecture, interaction design, visual design, prototyping, content design and usability testing
Exceptional visual and interaction design craft, with deep care for hierarchy, layout, typography, grids, spacing, motion, usability, accessibility and product quality
Working knowledge of design systems, accessibility standards, reusable patterns and scalable product experience decisions
Familiarity with AI-assisted design workflows, intelligent interfaces, modern design tooling and fast prototyping practices
Strong cross-functional collaboration skills and the ability to work fluently with product managers, engineers, researchers, data partners and other designers
Clear communication skills, with the ability to explain design decisions, incorporate feedback and persuade through rationale, evidence and craft
Understanding of front-end implementation constraints and the ability to bridge practical gaps between design and code
Curiosity about users, data, systems, new tools, emerging technologies and better ways for teams to work
How You Work
You hold yourself to an unusually high bar for craft, visual sophistication and product quality
You move comfortably from customer insight and product strategy to detailed design execution
You balance speed, detail, scalability and quality without losing sight of the customer
You build trust through warmth, candor, accountability and genuine respect for your teammates as people
You enjoy collaborating across time zones and cultural contexts, including with US- and India-based teammates
You communicate in ways that help distributed teams work with clarity, care and momentum
You advocate for accessibility, inclusion and ethical design

This information is used solely for compliance with government recordkeeping, reporting, and other legal requirements. Providing this information is voluntary and refusal to do so will not affect your application status. This data will be kept separate from your application and will not be used in the hiring decision.

data.descriptionPlain:
ABOUT US
HighLevel is an AI-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate and scale. Today, HighLevel supports SMBs across 150+ countries, fueling community-driven growth rooted in real customer outcomes.
To date, businesses operating on HighLevel have generated over $7 billion in ecosystem value. By centralizing conversations, automation and intelligence into one system, we help businesses move faster, reduce complexity and execute efficiently.
Behind the platform, HighLevel powers more than 4 billion API hits and 2.5 billion message events daily. With 250 terabytes of distributed data, 250+ microservices and over 1 million domain names supported, our architecture is built for performance, resilience and long-term scalability.
OUR PEOPLE
With over 2,000 team members across 10+ countries, HighLevel operates as a global, remote-first organization built for speed and ownership. We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home.
OUR IMPACT
Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1.5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact. We're proud to be a part of that.
ABOUT THE TEAM
The B2C/Creators Product team at HighLevel is focused on building and scaling a world-class learning experience for our customers and their audiences. The platform currently serves over 1.1 million monthly active users, making it one of HighLevel's most widely adopted products. This role offers a unique opportunity to operate at scale while solving B2C-style learner experience problems within a B2B2C product ecosystem.
Events is one of the newest products in HighLevel's Memberships suite, currently in beta and being built from the ground up. It gives our customers a native way to create, publish and sell events — in-person, online and hybrid — with ticketing, RSVPs, paid and free registration, and attendee management, sitting directly alongside the contacts, communities, courses, credentials and automations they already run their business on. Organizers build and run their events from the Memberships admin; attendees live the whole thing inside Client Portal, next to the courses, communities and credentials they already sign in for.
WHAT YOU'LL DO
Own and Shape the B2C & Events Roadmap Partner with product leadership to help shape and execute the roadmap for HighLevel's B2C platform, serving 1.1M+ monthly active learners, with a focus on engagement, completion, and retention in a B2B2C environment.
Close the Table-Stakes Gap, Then Go Past It – Know the category cold. Get the expected capabilities right — ticket tiers, promo codes, capacity and waitlists, recurring and series events, refunds, embeddable widgets, calendar sync, wallet passes — and then decide deliberately where we go further than the incumbents rather than matching them feature for feature.
Take Events from Beta to GA – Own the beta exit criteria: the quality bar, the reliability bar, the feature completeness, and the adoption and revenue signals that tell us this product is ready to be sold broadly. Drive the program that closes those gaps.
Build Ticketing, Checkout and Payments – Lead paid, free and RSVP event types, multi-tier and multi-currency ticketing, checkout conversion, discounts, taxes, refunds and payouts — with the precision and trust a revenue-bearing flow demands, and with fee and payout terms that are a reason to choose us rather than a reason to resent us.
Give Organizers Ownership of Their Audience – Build the capability that most defines us against the category: every registration flows into the organizer's own CRM, segmentable, automatable and theirs to keep. Turn attendee data ownership from a talking point into the product's most obvious advantage.
Own Event-Day Operations – Events are judged on the day they happen. Own check-in and QR scanning, offline resilience at the door, guest lists and comp tickets, on-site sales, capacity enforcement and the operational tooling organizers depend on when things go wrong in real time.
Own the Attendee Experience in Client Portal – Client Portal is where the attendee side of Events lives, and you own it: how members find what is on, register and check out, hold their tickets, receive reminders and joining links, attend in person or online, and look back at what they have been to. Deliver that journey across both web and mobile, make events feel native to the portal rather than bolted onto it, and hold a phone-first bar throughout.
Drive Distribution and Discovery – Shape how events get found and filled: SEO-ready event pages, social and calendar syndication, embeddable listings, the Gokollab Marketplace, and the promotion tooling that turns an organizer's existing audience into attendance.
Open the Platform – Treat APIs, webhooks and integrations as a first-class surface rather than a premium upsell, so agencies and developers can build events into the workflows and client solutions they already sell.
Champion UI/UX Excellence – Partner closely with design and engineering to deliver interfaces that are intuitive, accessible, mobile-friendly and fast — for both the organizer building an event and the attendee registering for one.
Talk to Organizers Constantly – Run discovery with beta organizers, sit in on their setup, watch where they stall, and turn qualitative signal into a prioritized backlog. At this stage, direct customer contact is a primary input, not a supplement.
Experiment and Optimize – Design and analyze experiments across the funnel — event page conversion, registration completion, checkout drop-off, organizer onboarding — and iterate rapidly on evidence rather than opinion.
Support Scale, Reliability and Trust – Drive the platform work a live-event product demands: registration integrity, capacity and waitlist correctness, payment reliability, fraud and listing trust, and graceful behavior under the traffic spikes that come with a popular event going on sale.
Collaborate Cross-Functionally – Work across engineering, design, data, support, marketing and customer-facing teams to launch features, drive adoption, and close the loop on organizer feedback.
Define and Own the Metrics – Establish the success metrics for a product that does not yet have them — organizer activation, time to first published event, repeat-event rate, registration and checkout conversion, attendance rate, gross ticket volume and revenue per organizer — set the OKRs against them, and use them to steer the roadmap.
Deliver Outcomes, Not Just Features – Be accountable for measurable growth in events published, organizers activated, registrations processed and ticket revenue running through the platform.
WHO YOU ARE
B2C Experience – You have built and shipped impactful features for B2C platforms or content products, creating engaging end user experiences that drive activation, completion, and retention at meaningful scale.
An End-to-End Owner – You are comfortable owning the entire life of an event across two connected surfaces: the creator experience in the Memberships admin, where an organizer builds, prices, publishes, promotes and runs their event, and the attendee experience in Client Portal, where a member discovers it, registers, attends and looks back on it. You think in terms of the whole journey and the handoffs between those surfaces, not in terms of screens.
UX-Attentive for Learning – You bring a strong UI/UX sensibility focused on learner journeys, content discovery, progress tracking, and habit formation, with a track record of delivering intuitive and high-quality learning experiences.
Experimentation-Minded – You are comfortable running A/B tests and structured experiments to improve learner engagement and completion rates through rapid, evidence-based iteration.
Learner-Centric – You consistently balance business objectives with learner success, keeping learner needs, motivation, and outcomes at the center of product decisions.
Customer-Obsessed – You seek out organizers directly, run your own discovery, and can translate what you hear into product decisions without waiting for a research team to formalize it.
Strategic and Execution-Focused – You can contribute meaningfully to product vision while staying deeply involved in day-to-day execution to ensure ideas translate into real, measurable impact.
Data-Informed – You rely on behavioral data, funnel metrics, and cohort analysis to prioritize initiatives, validate assumptions, and guide product decisions.
WHAT YOU'LL BRING
7+ years of Product Management experience, with meaningful exposure to events, ticketing, marketplace, commerce or B2B2C SaaS products.
Proven track record of taking a product from early stage to scaled adoption, with clear ownership of the decisions that made it work.
Hands-on experience with monetization mechanics — checkout, pricing and packaging, payments, refunds, payouts and fee structure — and the operational realities that come with them.
Working knowledge of the events and ticketing category, including how platforms such as Eventbrite, Luma, Meetup and Cvent are positioned, priced and differentiated.
Solid understanding of UI/UX principles, with the ability to partner closely with design to deliver intuitive, accessible and high-quality journeys for two distinct user types: organizers and attendees.
Familiarity with SaaS and B2C platform growth levers, including user activation, engagement loops, retention, lifecycle optimization, and audience monetization.
Comfort operating with ambiguity, incomplete data and shifting priorities in a fast-moving, remote-first environment.
Bonus: You have worked on an events, ticketing or community platform and can clearly articulate your personal impact on organizer growth, conversion and revenue.
WHY SHOULD YOU JOIN US?
At HighLevel, we foster an exciting and dynamic work environment driven by a passionate team. We believe in a collective responsibility where no task is considered someone else's job. Our unwavering focus is on providing value to our users, and we achieve this by delivering solutions swiftly through lean principles, allowing us to bring products to market in a matter of weeks rather than quarters.
Every good idea is put to the test, ensuring that we maintain a high standard of innovation. We prioritise the well-being of our team, recognizing that by taking care of them, they can better serve our users. We embrace the concept of continuous and iterative improvement, understanding that progress is an ongoing journey. We are also a well funded & profitable company.
Join us at HighLevel, and you will have the opportunity to learn the intricacies of scaling a B2B SaaS startup and develop impactful products that cater to the needs of our customers.

Role Summary
As the Sr. Product Manager for Commerce Operations, you will own the operational backbone of HighLevel's commerce platform - the interconnected systems that govern how orders are created, tracked, and fulfilled; how subscriptions run across their full lifecycle; how transactions are recorded and reconciled; and how inventory, taxation, coupons, and gift cards function reliably at scale. Like the Product Information Management layer, this role sits at the center of the Commerce team: every commerce surface depends on it, internal teams across the company build on it, and the external developer and marketplace ecosystem consumes it through a public API layer that you will define and own. You will also lead the build of HighLevel's internal accounting layer and design the integration surface for users who operate with third-party accounting tools — positioning commerce operations as both the authoritative source of financial truth and an open, compatible platform.

What You'll Do

● Own the Commerce Operations Roadmap: Define and drive the end-to-end product vision across HighLevel's full operations surface - Orders, Subscriptions, Transactions, Inventory, Fulfillment, Taxation, Coupons, and Gift Cards — ensuring each domain is built as a composable, reliable primitive that serves the platform as a whole.

● Build the Subscription Lifecycle: Own how plans, entitlements, renewals, upgrades, downgrades, pauses, and dunning flows work across the platform - building subscription management that handles the full complexity of real SMB billing, from simple recurring charges to tiered, usage-based, and trial-gated plans.

● Define the Ledger & Internal Accounting Layer: Lead the product definition and build of HighLevel's internal accounting layer — the authoritative system of record for every money-in and money-out event - designed from day one as the foundation for embedded accounting that keeps businesses running their books inside HighLevel.

● Enable Third-Party Accounting Compatibility: Design the integration surface that allows users who prefer external accounting software to sync HighLevel commerce data seamlessly - ensuring field mapping accuracy, reconciliation reliability, and a sync experience that requires zero manual intervention.

● Own Order Management & Fulfillment: Define how orders are created, modified, fulfilled, partially fulfilled, returned, and cancelled - building the state machine and merchant-facing workflows that make order operations reliable across every commerce surface, from storefronts to invoices to subscriptions.

● Build for Variable Granularity: Ensure every operational entity - order, fulfillment event, invoice, subscription, payment — is optional and composable. A business running on invoices alone and a business running a full order-fulfillment-invoice-payment chain must both be fully supported, with frictionless paths between granularity levels.

● Lead Inventory Management: Define the inventory layer - stock levels, reservations, adjustments, multi-location support, and low-stock signals - ensuring the platform correctly tracks physical goods across the full commerce lifecycle and exposes inventory state to every consuming surface.

● Shape Taxation & Compliance Infrastructure: Own the product strategy for tax calculation, tax code mapping, and compliance — across transaction types and geographies - ensuring HighLevel handles tax obligations correctly as merchants operate in multiple regions and as the platform expands internationally.

● Define Coupons, Promotions & Gift Cards: Build the discount and gift card infrastructure - coupon creation and validation, promotion rules, gift card issuance and redemption, balance tracking - ensuring these tools are expressive enough for merchant needs while enforcing correct financial accounting at every step.

● Own the Developer & Marketplace API Surface: Define and own the public API layer that external developers, agencies, and marketplace partners consume - ensuring commerce operations APIs are well-designed, stable, versioned, and expressive enough to support the full range of third-party integration and build use cases.

● Drive Cross-Functional Platform Alignment: Collaborate with the PIM, Documents, Onboarding, and Payments teams to ensure the operations layer exposes the primitives they depend on - and that operational events such as order placement, invoice issuance, and subscription renewal trigger the correct downstream behaviors reliably and consistently.

What We're Looking For

● 7+ Years of PM Experience: Proven track record in platform or infrastructure product management at high-growth SaaS companies, with significant exposure to transactional or financial systems.

● Commerce Operations Depth: Deep familiarity with order management, subscription billing, inventory, fulfillment, and transaction or ledger systems - understanding both the underlying data models and the merchant workflows built on top of them.

● Financial Systems Fluency: Comfort reasoning about ledger mechanics, double-entry accounting concepts, reconciliation requirements, and the data integrity standards of systems that carry financial truth for real businesses.

● API & Developer Platform Thinking: Experience building and owning public APIs consumed by external developers — with a strong grasp of contract design, versioning strategies, stability guarantees, and what makes a developer experience genuinely good.

● Platform-First Mindset: Demonstrated ability to design products as shared infrastructure - defining clear contracts, managing internal teams as stakeholders, and consistently prioritizing long-term extensibility over short-term feature velocity.

● Bias for Ownership: Comfortable holding the thread across a broad, interconnected domain without letting complexity become an excuse for slow decisions. Sets direction and drives execution independently.

What you'll get

● Strategic Centrality: Own the operational core that every other commerce surface depends on - a role with platform-wide impact, visibility across every team building on HighLevel's commerce infrastructure, and a direct line to the company's system-of-record ambition.

● High Ownership, Low Bureaucracy: Join an already-assembled engineering and design team and take full ownership of a mission-critical layer, with the autonomy to define the roadmap and drive execution at the pace HighLevel operates.

● Scale: Build the operational infrastructure that powers commerce for over a million businesses across 150+ countries, and define the accounting and developer API layer that will shape how HighLevel's commerce ecosystem grows over the next decade.

Position: Sr. Revenue Operations Analyst
Department: Revenue Operations
Location: India(Remote)
Shift Timings: 2PM - 11PM IST

About us
HighLevel is an AI-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate and scale. Today, HighLevel supports SMBs across 150+ countries, fueling community-driven growth rooted in real customer outcomes.
To date, businesses operating on HighLevel have generated over $7 billion in ecosystem value, demonstrating the impact of shared infrastructure at scale. By centralizing conversations, automation and intelligence into one system, we help businesses move faster, reduce complexity and execute efficiently.
Behind the platform, HighLevel powers more than 4 billion API hits and 2.5 billion message events daily. With 250 terabytes of distributed data, 250+ microservices and over 1 million domain names supported, our architecture is built for performance, resilience and long-term scalability.

Our people
With over 2,000 team members across 10+ countries, HighLevel operates as a global, remote-first organization built for speed and ownership. We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home.

Our impact
Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1.5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact. We’re proud to be a part of that.

Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts
Who You Are: 
You are a player-coach with genuine analytical depth and a builder's instinct. You do not wait to be asked — you surface what matters before it becomes urgent and bring recommendations, not just observations. You are comfortable walking into a room of experienced GTM leaders and challenging their thinking with data. You see broken workflows as problems to fix, not facts of life, and you have the operational credibility to implement the fix yourself. You thrive on unstructured problems and ambiguity is your baseline, not your blocker.
About the Role
We're looking for a Sr. Revenue Operations Analyst  team. In this role, you'll own analytics, reporting, and process for a dedicated segment of the revenue org  becoming the go-to person who turns raw performance data into the reporting, programs, and workflows that team runs on day to day. This is a hands-on, high-ownership role for someone who's equally comfortable building a dashboard, designing a process from scratch, and troubleshooting a broken workflow, and who wants a direct line of sight into how their work moves the business.
What You'll Do
Analytics & Reporting
Own and manage all performance analytics and reporting for your assigned segment, giving leadership a clear, real-time view of how the business is performing
Build, maintain, and continuously improve dashboards and recurring reports that leadership relies on to make decisions
Own program attribution — the tracking, operations, and reporting that connect activity to outcomes
Process & Program Development
Design, build, and optimize end-to-end processes for your segment, from initial concept to rollout and iteration
Own pipeline/workflow management for your segment, identifying bottlenecks and driving improvements
Strategic Initiatives & Performance
Track performance against goals and KPIs for your segment, flagging gaps early and calling out what's working
Identify growth opportunities by digging into the data  where conversion is leaking, where capacity is underused, where a small change could move a big number
Build the business case for new initiatives: scope the opportunity, size the impact, and get leadership buy-in
Execute initiatives end-to-end, from planning through rollout, adjusting as you go based on what the data shows
Report on initiative outcomes against the original goals, and use those learnings to shape what you tackle next
Tools, Systems & Automation
Build, own, and maintain the backend workflows and automations that power your segment's day-to-day operations in the HighLevel’s CRM
Leverage AI solutions for reporting, dashboards, and analysis
Stakeholder Partnership
Act as the analytics and operations partner to your segment's leadership — meeting with them regularly (e.g., weekly) to review progress, surface issues, and align on priorities
Support onboarding, training, and change management when new processes or tools roll out
Fulfill ad hoc requests from leadership, prioritizing and scoping work independently
What We're Looking For
5+ years of experience in business/revenue analysis, sales/marketing operations, or a related analytical or operational field
Advanced proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets and SQL; experience with a BI tool (Tableau, Looker, Power BI) strongly preferred
Hands-on experience with a CRM (Salesforce preferred) and comfort building within or alongside GTM systems and automation platforms
Proven ability to build a process or program from scratch — scoping it, standing it up, and iterating based on results
Experience building or maintaining backend workflows, automations, or internal tools (no-code/low-code platforms, Zapier, workflow builders, etc. are a plus)
Strong attribution/tracking instincts — comfortable connecting activity data to outcomes and building reporting that holds up to scrutiny
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to distill complex analysis into a clear narrative for leadership audiences
A track record of operating independently in ambiguous situations, troubleshooting systems issues, and driving work to resolution
Bachelor's degree in Business, Economics, Statistics, or a related quantitative field, or equivalent practical experience
Experience with Python or R for data analysis is a plus, not a requirement

Reporting to the Sr. Corporate Tax Manager, as our Sr. Tax Accountant, you join a team of highly skilled tax professionals and will specifically support Corporate Income tax. You won't just be crunching numbers, you will be the go-to technical expert developing and facilitating our U.S. federal and state corporate income tax compliance, quarterly and annual ASC 740 income tax provision, and estimated payments, all while keeping pace with a high-growth SaaS business. Operating in our high-volume SaaS environment means owning our provision and compliance workflows, applying strong technical tax research and analysis to complex issues, maintaining SOX-compliant internal controls over income tax reporting, and ensuring our tax positions are well-documented, defensible, and scalable. If you thrive in a fast-paced setting and love turning complex tax data into streamlined, automated processes, you'll fit right in.

In this role, you will drive collaboration across three key pillars:

  • Internal Teams: Partner with Accounting, FP&A, Treasury, and Legal to seamlessly integrate income tax provision and compliance into our financial reporting and forecasting workflows.

  • External Partners: Collaborate with external preparers, advisors, and auditors to thoroughly verify, document, and assist in defending our global income tax positions.

lists.content:
• Compliance & Filing: Facilitate the end-to-end preparation, review, and timely filing of U.S. federal and state corporate income tax returns, quarterly estimated payments, and extensions, in accordance with SOX-documented processes and deadlines.

  • Tax Provision (ASC 740): Prepare or review quarterly and annual income tax provision calculations, including current and deferred tax computations, effective tax rate reconciliations, and related financial statement disclosures, ensuring each step is supported by compliant workpapers and evidence.

  • Technical Research & Legislative Tracking: Perform technical tax research and analysis on federal and state tax law changes, apportionment methodologies, and evolving income tax nexus standards, documenting conclusions to an audit-ready standard as HighLevel expands.

  • Audit Defense: Support the team through federal and state income tax audits by efficiently managing information document requests (IDRs) and partnering with leadership to advocate for and defend established tax positions.

  • SOX Controls & General Ledger Reconciliation: Own and execute key SOX controls over the income tax close process; prepare or review monthly and quarterly tax account reconciliations, including deferred tax assets/liabilities and income tax payable accounts, within NetSuite.

  • Cross-Functional Advisory: Partner with Accounting, FP&A, Treasury, and Legal to evaluate the income tax and SOX control impact of new entities, intercompany transactions, and transfer pricing arrangements.

• Experience: 5 years of progressive experience in direct/corporate income tax (federal & state), preferably with a mix of public accounting and corporate experience.

  • Technical Tax Acumen: Solid working knowledge of ASC 740 and U.S. federal/state corporate income tax fundamentals, with growing ability to research tax issues and help document clear, well-supported conclusions.

  • SOX & Internal Controls: Hands-on experience operating within a SOX-controlled environment or knowledge of, including designing, executing, and documenting income tax controls, and supporting control testing with internal and external auditors.

  • SaaS Industry Expertise: Familiarity with tax issues common to fast-growing, multi-state SaaS companies, including apportionment, and state modernization of income tax rules.

  • Tech Stack Mastery: Familiarity with industry-standard ERPs and financial data systems (e.g., NetSuite, SAP, Oracle), along with tax provision and compliance platforms such as the Thomson Reuters ONESOURCE suite or Corptax.

  • Analytical Muscle and AI-Enabled Process Improvement: Advanced Excel skills (pivots, VLOOKUPs, data manipulation) required to handle massive, high-volume transactional datasets; familiarity with Power BI, Alteryx, or other various dashboard and data manipulation tools is a plus. Identify opportunities to leverage or automate processes and surface insights, helping unlock team capacity for high-impact analysis. 

  • Education: Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field. CPA designation or Master of Taxation degree is a major plus.

  • Agility & Growth Mindset: Ability to pivot quickly when priorities change and navigate fast organizational growth as an exciting challenge rather than a roadblock.

  • Data-Driven Problem Solving: Proven track record of digging into data to not only identify tax issues but actively propose and execute automated solutions.

  • Clear & Cross-Functional Communication: Skilled at translating complex tax provision and compliance concepts into plain English for non-finance stakeholders, alongside strong documentation skills for future reference and audit support.

Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact. We’re proud to be a part of that.
Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts
Role Overview
HighLevel processes payments at significant scale for the businesses that run on our platform and yet only a fraction of the businesses we serve have adopted payments at all. The constraint is structural rather than one of awareness: adoption is decided by the agencies who serve these businesses, and they have never had a commercial reason to act. We are hiring a Senior Product Manager - Commerce Growth to close that gap and make payments adoption the fastest-compounding line in our Commerce business.
This role owns the adoption and monetisation charter for Commerce end to end. It spans partner incentive design, the growth mechanics that move a business from signing up to transacting consistently, the partner-facing surfaces those programmes live in, and the commercial model underneath them. It is a general-management role as much as a product one, you will own the unit economics, the programme budget, and the evidence that the investment is working.
This role is ideal for product managers who have built growth or partner programmes at scale, who are comfortable being measured on a commercial outcome rather than a feature list, and who bring the analytical rigour to distinguish growth that was genuinely caused from growth that would have happened anyway.
What You'll Do
Own the payments adoption charter end to end - the strategy, roadmap and operating plan that take adoption and transacting volume to a multiple of today's levels, and the commercial targets attached to them.
Design, launch and iterate partner incentive programmes that make adoption commercially compelling for the agencies who drive it including eligibility models, qualification logic, payout mechanics and the controls that keep the programmes durable and abuse-resistant.
Own the partner-facing product surfaces where these programmes are discovered, understood and acted on progress, earnings and next-best-action, designed to scale to tens of thousands of partners without manual support.
Own the unit economics: customer acquisition cost, payback period, contribution margin and programme budget - modelled, forecast, and defensible to Finance and leadership.
Build a disciplined experimentation practice - randomised tests, holdout groups and incrementality measurement so that pricing and programme decisions are evidence-led rather than intuition-led.
Apply growth-hacking rigour across the adoption funnel: segmentation, lifecycle triggers, in-product prompts and targeted campaigns, in partnership with Lifecycle Marketing, Community and Support.
Lead commercial conversations with our largest agency partners, where bespoke arrangements rather than self-serve programmes are what move the number.
Own the monthly performance narrative - adoption, retention, cost efficiency and programme health and the decision to scale, hold or retire each initiative.
Partner with Analytics, Finance, Risk and Commerce platform engineering on the measurement, controls and infrastructure the charter depends on.
What Success Looks Like
Payments adoption grows at a multiple of its current rate, with the uplift demonstrably attributable to the work rather than to underlying trend
Incentive investment pays back inside its target window, measured on contribution rather than headline revenue
Partners understand what they have earned and why, without needing to contact support
Programme abuse remains negligible and is contained by automated controls rather than manual review
Programme spend tracks forecast, with variance understood and explained
Minimum Qualifications
8–10 years of product management experience
Experience owning a growth, partner, referral or incentive programme where the commercial mechanic itself was the product
Comfort owning a commercial outcome end to end acquisition cost, payback, contribution margin and defending it to a finance audience
A track record of running controlled experiments and drawing the right conclusion from them, including the unwelcome one
Experience with payments, fintech, marketplaces or another business where unit economics are the product strategy
Preferred Qualifications
Experience in partner, reseller or franchise ecosystems where a third party not the end user makes the adoption decision
Familiarity with payment economics: processing rates, take rate, volume tiers, and how payment method mix affects platform monetisation
Experience designing abuse and fraud controls for a rewards, referral or affiliate programme
Background in vertical SaaS or platform businesses that monetise payments alongside subscriptions
Who This Role Is For
Product managers who think in unit economics, and who will hold the line when an initiative is popular but does not pay for itself.
PMs who treat commercial programmes as product surfaces with an interface, a rulebook and a feedback loop rather than a spreadsheet handed to marketing.
People energised by a very specific problem: getting tens of thousands of independent businesses to act on your behalf, repeatedly, at a price that makes sense.
Why Should You Join Us?
At HighLevel, we foster an exciting and dynamic work environment driven by a passionate team. We believe in a collective responsibility where no task is considered someone else's job. Our unwavering focus is on providing value to our users, and we achieve this by delivering solutions swiftly through lean principles, allowing us to bring products to market in a matter of weeks rather than quarters. Every good idea is put to the test, ensuring that we maintain a high standard of innovation. We prioritise the well-being of our team, recognizing that by taking care of them, they can better serve our users. We embrace the concept of continuous and iterative improvement, understanding that progress is an ongoing journey. We are also a well funded & profitable company.
Join us at HighLevel, and you will have the opportunity to learn the intricacies of scaling a B2B SaaS startup and develop impactful products that cater to the needs of our customers.

Role Overview

HighLevel processes payments at significant scale for the businesses that run on our platform and yet only a fraction of the businesses we serve have adopted payments at all. We are hiring a Senior Product Manager - Commerce Growth to close that gap and make payments adoption the fastest-compounding line in our Commerce business.

It spans partner incentive design, the growth mechanics that move a business from signing up to transacting consistently, the partner-facing surfaces those programmes live in, and the commercial model underneath them. It is a general-management role as much as a product one, you will own the unit economics, the programme budget, and the evidence that the investment is working.

  • Lead commercial conversations with our largest agency partners, where bespoke arrangements rather than self-serve programmes are what move the number.

  • Own the monthly performance narrative - adoption, retention, cost efficiency and programme health and the decision to scale, hold or retire each initiative.

  • Partner with Analytics, Finance, Risk and Commerce platform engineering on the measurement, controls and infrastructure the charter depends on.

What Success Looks Like

  • Payments adoption grows at a multiple of its current rate, with the uplift demonstrably attributable to the work rather than to underlying trend

  • Incentive investment pays back inside its target window, measured on contribution rather than headline revenue

  • Partners understand what they have earned and why, without needing to contact support

  • Programme abuse remains negligible and is contained by automated controls rather than manual review

  • Programme spend tracks forecast, with variance understood and explained

  • PMs who treat commercial programmes as product surfaces with an interface, a rulebook and a feedback loop rather than a spreadsheet handed to marketing.

  • People energised by a very specific problem: getting tens of thousands of independent businesses to act on your behalf, repeatedly, at a price that makes sense.

At HighLevel, we foster an exciting and dynamic work environment driven by a passionate team. We believe in a collective responsibility where no task is considered someone else's job. We embrace the concept of continuous and iterative improvement, understanding that progress is an ongoing journey. We are also a well funded & profitable company.

Join us at HighLevel, and you will have the opportunity to learn the intricacies of scaling a B2B SaaS startup and develop impactful products that cater to the needs of our customers.

About the Team
The Marketing OS – LeadGen Team owns the products and platform capabilities that help agencies attract, engage, capture, qualify, and understand leads across digital and offline customer journeys.
The team is responsible for:
Forms and form-building experiences
Surveys and customer data-collection workflows
Quizzes, assessments, and interactive lead-generation experiences
QR Codes and offline-to-online lead acquisition
Chat Widget and conversational lead capture
External Tracking across third-party websites and digital properties
Lead capture, submission, attribution, and behavioral analytics
Templates, integrations, embeddable experiences, and extensibility
These products are critical entry points into the HighLevel Marketing OS. They connect customer interactions across websites, landing pages, physical locations, campaigns, and external properties with HighLevel's CRM, automation, analytics, and communication capabilities.
Why Join HighLevel?
Ownership: It is never somebody else's job.
Customer focus: We are passionately focused on adding value for our users.
Speed: We use lean principles and go to market in weeks rather than quarters.
Experimentation: Good ideas are tested quickly, measured, and improved iteratively.
Growth: You will help scale a global B2B SaaS platform and build products used by millions of businesses.
People: We take care of our team so our team can take care of our users.
Role Overview
As Senior Product Manager – Marketing OS, LeadGen, you will help shape the future of lead generation at HighLevel.
You will own product strategy, roadmap, and execution across a portfolio that includes Forms, Surveys, Quizzes, QR Codes, Chat Widget, External Tracking, and adjacent lead capture and attribution capabilities.
Your mandate will be to evolve these products into a cohesive LeadGen experience that enables agencies and SMBs to create high-converting acquisition journeys, collect better-quality data, understand visitor behavior, and activate every lead through HighLevel's CRM and automation ecosystem.
This is a senior individual contributor role. You will work closely with Engineering, Design, and Data on your portfolio, partner with adjacent product teams on shared foundations, and help shape how HighLevel competes in lead generation, conversational engagement, behavioral tracking, and marketing attribution.
Your work will directly impact product adoption, lead volume, lead quality, engagement, conversion, retention, and overall platform growth.
Your Responsibilities
Own the LeadGen roadmap: Define and execute the product strategy and roadmap across Forms, Surveys, Quizzes, QR Codes, Chat Widget, and External Tracking.
Build cohesive experiences: Drive consistency across builders, templates, publishing, data models, integrations, analytics, and reporting.
Improve lead capture: Ship capabilities that increase visitor engagement, completion rates, lead quality, qualification, routing, and follow-up.
Connect the customer journey: Partner with CRM, Workflows, Conversations, Analytics, and Payments teams to connect interactions with downstream business outcomes.
Drive External Tracking: Define how HighLevel captures visitor behavior, conversions, identity, attribution, and campaign activity across third-party websites.
Strengthen analytics foundations: Contribute to consistent event taxonomies, instrumentation standards, and reporting across the LeadGen portfolio.
Drive AI-assisted creation: Deliver AI-powered creation, copy generation, logic recommendations, qualification, insights, and conversion optimization.
Improve cross-device experiences: Ensure creation and consumption experiences are intuitive, responsive, accessible, and performant across desktop, mobile, and tablet.
Partner on technical decisions: Work with Engineering on builders, embeddable widgets, APIs, submission pipelines, tracking scripts, identity resolution, and event infrastructure.
Drive cross-functional execution: Align Product, Engineering, Design, Data, AI, Security, Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, and Partnerships around shared outcomes.
Support go-to-market: Contribute to product positioning, pricing, packaging, messaging, launches, enablement, onboarding, and customer education.
Operate hands-on: Write PRDs and strategy documents, conduct discovery, analyze data, validate concepts, prioritize initiatives, and resolve ambiguity.
Own measurable outcomes: Drive improvements in adoption, activation, publishing, engagement, completion, conversion, attribution coverage, and retention.
Experience
7+ years of Product Management experience, ideally in B2B SaaS, MarTech, CRM, analytics, growth, or customer-engagement platforms.
Experience owning a customer-facing product or product area end to end, from discovery through launch and iteration.
Experience defining and executing a roadmap across multiple related product areas.
Strong understanding of lead generation, customer acquisition, conversion optimization, qualification, and growth loops.
Experience with products such as forms, surveys, quizzes, chat widgets, analytics, attribution, tracking, or interactive content.
Familiarity with behavioral tracking, including page views, clicks, scrolls, field interactions, submissions, abandonment, and conversion events.
Understanding of event taxonomies, analytics instrumentation, data pipelines, experimentation, and marketing attribution.
Exposure to embeddable products such as widgets, scripts, SDKs, forms, or externally hosted experiences.
Familiarity with APIs, webhooks, CRM integrations, field mapping, workflow automation, and identity resolution.
Experience partnering with Engineering on frontend, backend, data, and infrastructure systems.
Strong product judgment, analytical ability, and UI/UX sensibility.
Ability to influence cross-functional partners and drive alignment without direct authority.
Excellent written and verbal communication, decision-making, and stakeholder management skills.
Nice to Have
Experience with AI- or LLM-powered creation, conversational, or optimization products.
Experience building form builders, survey platforms, chat products, interactive content, or behavioral analytics tools.
Experience with first-party tracking, customer identity, attribution, consent management, or data governance.
Exposure to high-volume event ingestion, real-time analytics, experimentation, or personalization systems.
Experience building products for marketing agencies, SMBs, creators, or multi-location businesses.
Prior experience working in a remote, globally distributed product organization.

You will own product strategy, roadmap, and execution across a portfolio that includes Forms, Surveys, Quizzes, QR Codes, Chat Widget, External Tracking, and adjacent lead capture and attribution capabilities.

Your mandate will be to evolve these products into a cohesive LeadGen experience that enables agencies and SMBs to create high-converting acquisition journeys, collect better-quality data, understand visitor behavior, and activate every lead through HighLevel's CRM and automation ecosystem.

This is a senior individual contributor role. You will work closely with Engineering, Design, and Data on your portfolio, partner with adjacent product teams on shared foundations, and help shape how HighLevel competes in lead generation, conversational engagement, behavioral tracking, and marketing attribution.

Your work will directly impact product adoption, lead volume, lead quality, engagement, conversion, retention, and overall platform growth.

Your Responsibilities

  • Own the LeadGen roadmap: Define and execute the product strategy and roadmap across Forms, Surveys, Quizzes, QR Codes, Chat Widget, and External Tracking.

  • Build cohesive experiences: Drive consistency across builders, templates, publishing, data models, integrations, analytics, and reporting.

  • Improve lead capture: Ship capabilities that increase visitor engagement, completion rates, lead quality, qualification, routing, and follow-up.

  • Connect the customer journey: Partner with CRM, Workflows, Conversations, Analytics, and Payments teams to connect interactions with downstream business outcomes.

  • Drive External Tracking: Define how HighLevel captures visitor behavior, conversions, identity, attribution, and campaign activity across third-party websites.

  • Strengthen analytics foundations: Contribute to consistent event taxonomies, instrumentation standards, and reporting across the LeadGen portfolio.

  • Drive AI-assisted creation: Deliver AI-powered creation, copy generation, logic recommendations, qualification, insights, and conversion optimization.

  • Improve cross-device experiences: Ensure creation and consumption experiences are intuitive, responsive, accessible, and performant across desktop, mobile, and tablet.

  • Partner on technical decisions: Work with Engineering on builders, embeddable widgets, APIs, submission pipelines, tracking scripts, identity resolution, and event infrastructure.

  • Drive cross-functional execution: Align Product, Engineering, Design, Data, AI, Security, Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, and Partnerships around shared outcomes.

  • Support go-to-market: Contribute to product positioning, pricing, packaging, messaging, launches, enablement, onboarding, and customer education.

  • Operate hands-on: Write PRDs and strategy documents, conduct discovery, analyze data, validate concepts, prioritize initiatives, and resolve ambiguity.

  • Own measurable outcomes: Drive improvements in adoption, activation, publishing, engagement, completion, conversion, attribution coverage, and retention.

Experience

  • 7+ years of Product Management experience, ideally in B2B SaaS, MarTech, CRM, analytics, growth, or customer-engagement platforms.

  • Experience owning a customer-facing product or product area end to end, from discovery through launch and iteration.

  • Experience defining and executing a roadmap across multiple related product areas.

  • Strong understanding of lead generation, customer acquisition, conversion optimization, qualification, and growth loops.

  • Experience with products such as forms, surveys, quizzes, chat widgets, analytics, attribution, tracking, or interactive content.

  • Familiarity with behavioral tracking, including page views, clicks, scrolls, field interactions, submissions, abandonment, and conversion events.

  • Understanding of event taxonomies, analytics instrumentation, data pipelines, experimentation, and marketing attribution.

  • Exposure to embeddable products such as widgets, scripts, SDKs, forms, or externally hosted experiences.

  • Familiarity with APIs, webhooks, CRM integrations, field mapping, workflow automation, and identity resolution.

  • Experience partnering with Engineering on frontend, backend, data, and infrastructure systems.

  • Strong product judgment, analytical ability, and UI/UX sensibility.

  • Ability to influence cross-functional partners and drive alignment without direct authority.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication, decision-making, and stakeholder management skills.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with AI- or LLM-powered creation, conversational, or optimization products.

  • Experience building form builders, survey platforms, chat products, interactive content, or behavioral analytics tools.

  • Experience with first-party tracking, customer identity, attribution, consent management, or data governance.

  • Exposure to high-volume event ingestion, real-time analytics, experimentation, or personalization systems.

  • Experience building products for marketing agencies, SMBs, creators, or multi-location businesses.

  • Prior experience working in a remote, globally distributed product organization.

Even a simple configuration error can lead to significant unintended usage. At HighLevel, we aim to build robust systems that protect our customers and the platform from accidental surges and intentional abuse alike. • Database architecture: Redesign and optimize data models, queries, and indexing strategies across MongoDB, Firestore, and ElasticSearch
  • Search at scale: Own ElasticSearch reliability — ingestion, indexing, shard strategy, and query performance for billions of documents
  • Reliability & performance: Eliminate bottlenecks, improve replication health, and enforce predictable query and index latency
  • System design: Define data flow and integration boundaries between storage, cache, and APIs with clear contracts and fault isolation
  • Observability: Build visibility into every data path — metrics, traces, slow query logs, replication lag, and cluster health dashboards
  • Testing & quality: Make testing non-negotiable — enforce unit, integration, and load testing standards across all backend modules
  • Engineering culture: Drive RFCs, ADRs, and design reviews that push clarity and precision. Codify patterns that make good engineering repeatable
  • Hands-on leadership: Write code, design systems, and debug production issues. Lead by technical example, not by delegation
  • Mentorship & influence: Level up engineers around you — reviews that teach, feedback that sticks, and systems that outlive individuals

• Heavyweight Engineering Pedigree: 8+ years of experience building high-scale, mission-critical backend systems where p99 regressions are unacceptable.
  • Distributed Systems Mastery: Deep expertise in concurrency, event-driven architectures, and consistency primitives (CAS, atomic dry-runs, idempotency).
  • Financial Rigor: Experience with systems where code correctness has direct financial impact—metering, ledgers, or payment gateways.
  • Operational Instinct: A track record of technical leadership through influence, driving architecture for multi-team platforms from design to production.
  • Experience with systems where correctness has financial consequences — metering, ledgers, billing, reservations, or comparable transactional domains
  • Strong experience with relational and NoSQL data models (especially with complex transactional data), plus working knowledge of streaming and analytical stores for time-windowed aggregation
  • Experience designing policy- or rules-driven systems that change through configuration rather than deploys — versioning, safe rollout, and rollback of behavioural change
  • Sound judgement on the enforcement trade-off: how to set thresholds and actions that stop real harm without punishing legitimate customers, and how to measure whether you got it right
  • Familiarity with monitoring, SLOs, and root-cause analysis in production environments
  • Familiarity with hallucination mitigation strategies (e.g., code constraints, test scaffolding, embeddings, context injection)
  • Track record of technical leadership without formal authority — driving cross-team architecture to a decision, writing designs others build from, and lifting the engineering standard around you
  • Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills, including with Finance, Risk and Support stakeholders
  • A pragmatic, hands-on engineer who balances long-term vision with iterative execution

• Experience with ElasticSearch cluster management, multi-tenant indexing, or lifecycle policies
  • Familiarity with ClickHouse or other OLAP systems for analytics
  • Background in event-driven systems, data pipelines, or message brokers
  • Contributions to open-source or public technical writing on database performance or systems design

• Abuse & Fraud Expertise: Experience building rules engines, velocity checks, or adversarial defense systems at massive scale.
  • Modern Data Stack: Hands-on with high-throughput tools like Go, Redis (Lua), ClickHouse, and Flink for real-time aggregation.
  • Hyper-Growth Scaling: Experience navigating the transition from early architecture to load-bearing platform at scale.
  • Exposure to stream processing at scale (Flink, Kafka Streams, Beam) and columnar analytical stores (ClickHouse, BigQuery) for real-time aggregation
  • Hands-on experience with Node.js and Go in production services, particularly on latency-sensitive or high-throughput paths
  • Experience working with AI Tools, Billing & Metered Systems
  • Contributions to open-source tools, internal platforms, or engineering blogs

We're hiring a Staff Data Scientist, Core Revenue Retention to own one outcome — keeping and growing revenue from existing customers — across every team that shapes it. Revenue retention isn't the property of a single product: it spans CPaaS (phone, SMS, email, WhatsApp) as our largest MRR surface, add-on monetization including emerging AI features, the Customer Success motions that protect accounts, and Finance's forecasts.

This is a broad, cross-functional role. You'll work closely with Communications/CPaaS, Customer Success, the AI teams pursuing add-on revenue, Finance, and other revenue-driving product teams; you report centrally to Product Analytics & Data Science for craft and standards and carry the revenue-retention outcome across organizational boundaries. You'll build the retention/value model, separate real churn signal from data-maturity and mix artifacts, and turn diagnosis into a prioritized, evidence-based retention and add-on-monetization agenda. You'll work amid a data foundation still being built, consuming governed sources rather than rebuilding them, and raising the bar as you go. This is a hands-on, direction-setting Staff role — you advise Customer Success, Finance, and CPaaS leaders and set retention-measurement standards that analysts on adjacent teams adopt, with a path to grow a pod as the mandate scales.

• Own the causal read on core revenue retention and add-on monetization — gross and net revenue retention, MRR churn (voluntary vs involuntary), attach and usage of add-ons — across CPaaS, AI add-ons, and other revenue surfaces
  • Quantify add-on revenue opportunity across CPaaS and emerging AI features, and the drivers behind attach and consumption
  • Apply rigorous causal inference (matching, diff-in-diff, survival/hazard, synthetic control) where clean experiments aren't feasible — separating real signal from selection bias, seasonality, and mix
  • Partner with Finance/RevOps on single-source-of-truth definitions and forecasting inputs; drive the revenue-retention insights 
  • Partner with the Product Strategy & Growth org on the TTP/churn charter, and with the Experimentation lead to test retention interventions rigorously
  • Act as a trusted analytical advisor to Customer Success, Finance, and Communications/CPaaS leaders, and set the analytical standards that DS and analysts on adjacent teams adopt — raising the bar without direct authority
  • Set the technical direction for how revenue retention is measured company-wide — own the canonical GRR/NRR, churn, and add-on metrics on governed, certified data that other teams build on; shape the taxonomy retention analytics depends on with Analytics Engineering
